headline.story_zh:
这件东西解决的是所有 AI 推理游戏的通病：**模型能被说服**。你追问几轮、换个角度施压，它就开始改口——凶手是谁取决于你问得多凶，而不是案子本身。

它的做法是把答案从模型手里拿走。开局由脚本生成案件，凶手随机定死，然后**当场算一个 SHA-256 交给你**。作者管这叫 proof-of-honesty，并且要求把哈希原样展示给玩家——**你手上有凭据，模型改不了口，改了你验得出来**。模型在这局里只是舞台：你问谁，它就照那张嫌疑人卡演谁，卡上写着这人的假不在场证明、会回避什么、会撒哪个谎。它连自己在演的是不是凶手都不知道。

真正让我服气的是困难模式。它会塞进一个**指错人的第二证人**——而扮演那个证人的模型，自己也不知道那是假的。所以你没法靠察言观色，只能交叉比对不在场证明。一个把「连我自己都被蒙在鼓里」写进设计的游戏，比任何「我保证不剧透」的承诺都可靠。

它还写了一节「什么时候别用我」：多线战役、开放世界跑团、想写推理小说而不是玩、真实罪案和现实人物——一律礼貌拒绝，也不接非黑色电影的题材。**一个只做一件事、并且把不做的事列出来的小游戏。**

不适合谁：想玩长线战役的人。它就是一局 5 到 15 分钟，打完那个案子文件就结了。

item.name: noir-interrogation
item.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
item.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
item.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
item.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
item.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
item.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
item.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
item.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

headline_history.story_zh:
今天这件的招牌是一条自我约束：不调任何图像生成模型。给它一张你自己拍的照片，它用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 把画面重新画一遍，无头 Chrome 导出 PNG——成品里一个照片像素都没有。

为什么这算品味而不是自找麻烦：所有效果都来自可控的代码，所以出品是稳定的，不是抽卡抽出来的。作者把方法论写得比多数设计文档还狠——「如果观者还在数花瓣，画的就仍是物体」；采样时明令不采轮廓，因为「采了就会忍不住去画」，他还记下了实测：树梢的 141 个锯齿点，让一道横痕被画成了山。

最让我服气的是那条盲画协议。开工先自测三件事，其中一件是「你能看见渲染出来的 PNG 吗」——检验方式是渲染后用一句话说出画面里的三个东西，说不出就是看不见。看不见时强制进入盲画模式：第一版画完立刻交人，此后每一轮改动只能由用户反馈驱动，自发迭代次数为零。一个作者肯把「我的 agent 可能看不见自己画了什么」写进流程并给出降级路径，比任何效果图都更能说明他在乎。

不适合谁：本机跑不了无头 Chrome 和 PIL 的人。缺一样它就降级成交你一个 HTML 文件、颜色请你自己报，手机上基本用不了。

skills.name: travel-plan-viz
skills.title_zh: 把旅行计划做成手机上能离线看的网页
skills.tagline_zh: 到了当地没网、翻聊天记录找攻略最抓狂。它出单文件 HTML：交互地图 + 每日时间轴 + 出发前订票提醒，存手机上离线可读。
skills.tagline_en: The worst moment abroad is standing on a corner with no data, scrolling chat history for the plan. It emits one HTML file: interactive map, day-by-day timeline, pre-departure booking reminders — saved to your phone, readable offline.
skills.desc_en: 把旅行行程做成美观、离线可读、手机优先的单文件 HTML（交互地图+每日时间轴+出发前订票提醒）。两种用法——只给目的地和天数让它帮你规划，或丢一份现成计划让它直接出页面。触发：旅行计划可视化、做旅行攻略网页、行程 HTML、travel plan visualization。
skills.why_zh: 「离线可读、手机优先、单文件」——这三个约束是真在国外用过才想得到的，不是坐在电脑前设计出来的。
skills.why_en: Offline-readable, phone-first, single file. Those three constraints only occur to someone who has actually needed them abroad.
skills.limit_zh: 地图引的是 Leaflet CDN，所谓「离线可读」保得住文字和时间轴，地图那块断网就是空的。实时票价、代订票、多语言、后端，作者在「不做」一节里明写一概不做。最后那步校验要本机有 node 跑 assets/validate.js。
skills.limit_en: The map is a Leaflet CDN embed, so 'offline' holds for the text and timeline but the map goes blank. Live fares, booking, multi-language and any backend are listed under what it deliberately does not do.
skills.title_en: A trip plan you can still read with no signal

skills.name: recipe-generator
skills.title_zh: 每一步都告诉你怎么算做好了的菜谱
skills.tagline_zh: 菜谱最坑的是「炒至断生」这种话。它按阶段给火候和时长，每一步附一条「怎么看这步完成了」，末尾再出一张菜谱海报的生图提示词。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing in a recipe is "stir-fry until done." This one splits cooking into stages with heat and timing, and attaches a "how you know this step finished" line to each, then hands you an image prompt for a recipe poster.
skills.desc_en: 自动生成高品质菜谱的技能。输入菜品名称后，检索权威来源（米其林、舌尖上的中国等）的制作工艺，生成包含完整准备工作、详细制作步骤、注意事项和专业技巧的菜谱文档，并最终生成传统中式风格的菜谱海报生图提示词。
skills.why_zh: 把「判断标准」写进每一步，正是新手和菜谱之间缺的那一层——不是配方不够细，是不知道什么时候该进下一步。
skills.why_en: Putting a completion test on every step fills the gap a beginner actually falls into — the recipe was detailed enough; you just could not tell when to move on.
skills.limit_zh: 它靠 search_web 现查权威做法，没有联网工具就退化成模型自己编。检索源写死在中文站点（米其林指南、舌尖上的中国、下厨房），做西餐日料会明显变弱；末尾的海报提示词也写死「传统中式风格」。
skills.limit_en: It looks up authoritative methods with search_web at run time — without a web tool it degrades to the model making things up. Its sources are hardcoded Chinese ones, so western or Japanese dishes come out visibly weaker, and the closing poster prompt is fixed to a traditional Chinese style.
skills.title_en: A recipe that tells you how to know each step is done
skills.limit_brief_zh: 不联网它就退化成模型自己编。
skills.limit_brief_en: Offline it degrades to the model inventing steps.

skills.name: fitness-coach
skills.title_zh: 把长期健身做成有剧情的 RPG
skills.tagline_zh: 健身最难的是坚持，不是动作。它用本地文件记录你的训练、疲劳和复训，再让训练结果推进剧情——练得好剧情才往前走。
skills.tagline_en: Sticking with it is the hard part, not the movements. It keeps your sessions, fatigue and returns in local files, then lets the results move a storyline forward — train well and the plot advances.
skills.desc_en: 本地文件驱动的长期健身教练与可选 RPG 成长系统。用于用户开始或记录训练、制定或调整计划、复盘训练、复训、报告疲劳疼痛、查询历史表现，以及推进由训练结果驱动的剧情时。
skills.why_zh: 把「坚持」这个真问题用游戏机制解决，而不是再给一份训练计划表。全本地存档，数据不外传。
skills.why_en: It answers the real problem — consistency — with a game mechanic instead of yet another training plan. Everything stays on your machine.
skills.limit_zh: 数据全存本地 user-data/，换台机器就从零开始。没有 Python 环境时改由模型手写 JSON，脚本那层的单位和日期校验就失效了。
skills.limit_en: All data lives in a local user-data/ folder; switch machines and you start over. Without Python it falls back to the model hand-writing JSON, losing the script's unit and date checks.
skills.title_en: Long-term training as a story you unlock

skills.name: moodboard-alignment
skills.title_zh: 把「要高级要有质感」变成能确认的方向稿
skills.tagline_zh: 客户说要高级、要电影感，你不知道他到底要什么。它先把这些词转成一页可确认的方向稿，双方点头了才出图——省的是返工，不是时间。
skills.tagline_en: The client says "premium, cinematic, clean" and you have no idea what that means. It converts those words into a one-page direction you both sign off on before any image exists — it saves rework, not time.
skills.desc_en: 审美共识引擎。把客户 brief、会议记录、剧本/故事大纲、品牌/海报/PPT/影视广告/网站 App/游戏等项目中的散乱审美描述，转化为可确认、可执行、可增量修改的文字版情绪板与 HTML 情绪板。
skills.why_zh: 它给自己写了 FAIL FAST：方向没确认就出方案、分镜或 HTML，一律判失败。肯拦住自己的 skill 少见。
skills.why_en: It ships its own FAIL FAST list: emitting option-A/option-B, storyboards or HTML before the direction is confirmed counts as failure. Skills that hold themselves back are rare.
skills.limit_zh: 它强制三段确认（方向稿 → 文档 → 出图），一句话出不了结果，急着要图的人会被它拦住。可以说「不用确认直接生成」跳过，但那样也就没有「共识」这件事了。触发词写死中文审美词。
skills.limit_en: It forces a three-stage handshake (direction → document → render), so you cannot get an image in one message; anyone in a hurry will be blocked. You can say "skip confirmation" — but then the whole point is gone. Its triggers are hardcoded Chinese aesthetic words.
skills.title_en: Turns "make it feel premium" into something you can sign off on
skills.limit_brief_zh: 方向没确认它就不出图，急着要图会被拦。
skills.limit_brief_en: No image until the direction is confirmed.

skills.name: iching-divination
skills.title_zh: 用密码学随机数起卦的周易占卜
skills.tagline_zh: AI 算卦最没意思的是它会顺着你想听的编卦象。这个用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱，一事一占，凶卦如实直断，还能事后对账验证。
skills.tagline_en: The dull thing about AI fortune-telling is that it quietly tells you what you want to hear. This one casts three coins with a cryptographic RNG, allows one question per casting, states bad hexagrams plainly, and invites you back to check whether it was right.
skills.desc_en: 真随机起卦的周易/易经占卜。用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱起卦,绝不编造卦象;一事一占;按传统规范解读本卦、动爻、之卦,先引原文再讲白话;凶卦如实直断;支持事后对账验证。只要用户提到占卜、算卦、起卦、问卦、解卦、摇卦、占一卦、六十四卦、易经、周易、卦象,或想用易经视角推演某个决定(跳槽、感情、合作、出行、时机),就使用本 skill,即使他没有明说"占卜"二字。Authentic I Ching (Yijing/Zhouyi) divination - cryptographically random coin casting, classical hexagram interpretation
skills.why_zh: 「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。
skills.why_en: It seals the two places divination usually slides: no inventing hexagrams, no softening a bad one. Taking a game seriously is itself a kind of taste.
skills.limit_zh: 一事一占是硬规矩，你连问几件它会引蒙卦拒绝。也不答彩票号码、不替你做医疗和财务决定。
skills.limit_en: One question per casting is enforced — ask several and it refuses, citing the Meng hexagram. It won't pick lottery numbers or make medical and financial decisions for you.
skills.title_en: Divination by I Ching, with cryptographic dice

skills.name: photo-distill
skills.title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 海报
skills.tagline_zh: 不调任何图像生成模型——用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。给它一张你自己拍的照片，出一张极简版画感的纸质海报。
skills.tagline_en: No image model anywhere in the pipeline — it draws with hand-written HTML/CSS/SVG and exports a PNG through headless Chrome. Give it a photo you took; you get a print-feeling minimal poster.
skills.desc_en: > 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 纸质海报——不用图像生成模型，用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、 无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。当用户给出一张自己拍的照片、想把它做成极简海报/版画/zine 风格作品时使用。 触发词：照片蒸馏、photo distill、把这张照片做成海报、极简海报、zine 海报、 蒸馏这张照片、做成版画那种、用代码画这张照片、纸质海报、海报系列再做一张。 即使用户只说"把这张照片处理成那个风格"、"这张也来一张"、"帮我把这照片抽象一下"， 只要是把摄影作品变成印刷符号，就应触发。 不用于 AI 生图海报（那用 gc-minimal-zine-poster）
skills.why_zh: 「不用生图模型」是个很硬的自我约束，也正是它出品统一的原因：所有效果都来自可控的代码，而不是抽卡。
skills.why_en: Refusing to generate is a hard constraint, and it's exactly why the output is consistent: every effect comes from code you can control, not from rerolling.
skills.limit_zh: 要本机跑得起无头 Chrome 和 Python PIL；缺一样它就降级——交你一个 HTML 自己开、颜色请你自己报。手机上基本用不了。
skills.limit_en: Needs headless Chrome and Python PIL locally. Missing either, it degrades — hands you the raw HTML and asks you to name the colors. Unusable on a phone.
skills.cover_note: 作者 examples/ 里的成品海报（-poster），不是 -original 输入原片。抓取误取输入，2026-08-19 人工更正。
skills.title_en: A photo distilled into a minimal zine poster

skills.name: outfit-director
skills.title_zh: 一次拍出多套造型的换装视频脚本
skills.tagline_zh: 换装视频最容易翻车的是换完不像同一个人。它先出一张拼贴首帧当结构母图，视频时间轴强制继承主体身份和贴图位置。人和宠物都能做。
skills.tagline_en: Outfit-change videos fail when the person stops looking like the same person. This one builds a collage first frame as the structural master, then forces the video timeline to inherit subject identity and sticker positions. Works for people and pets.
skills.desc_en: 为女性、男性或宠物设计「同一主体多套造型拼贴首帧 + 换装视频」，输出参数锁定、图片提示词、完整时间轴、精简视频提示词和负面约束。
skills.why_zh: 把「身份一致性」当成硬约束而不是碰运气——先定首帧再派生视频，这个顺序就是它和一堆换装提示词的全部区别。
skills.why_en: It treats identity consistency as a hard constraint rather than a hope: first frame first, video derived from it. That ordering is the entire difference between this and a pile of outfit prompts.
skills.limit_zh: 它交付的是提示词和时间轴，不是视频——真出片要你自己拿去生视频模型跑，成片效果取决于那个模型不取决于它。参数预设、转场库、服装方案分散在三个 references 文件里，正文只给路由。
skills.limit_en: It delivers prompts and a timeline, not a video — you still have to run them through a video model, and the result depends on that model, not on this. Parameter presets, the transition library and outfit plans live in three separate reference files; the main file is only a router.
skills.title_en: Outfit-change video scripts that keep the same subject
skills.limit_brief_zh: 它出的是提示词和时间轴，不是视频。
skills.limit_brief_en: It outputs prompts and a timeline, not a video.

skills.name: ljg-writes
skills.title_zh: 把一个观点写成经得住反例的文章
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写观点文最容易变成正确的废话。它的目标很具体：1000-1500 字，可理解、可迁移、经得住反例——而且明说不做普通摘要。
skills.tagline_en: AI opinion pieces default to being correct and empty. This one sets a specific bar: 1000–1500 words, understandable, transferable, and able to survive counterexamples — and it explicitly refuses to write summaries.
skills.desc_en: "写作引擎。把一个观点写成可理解、可迁移、经得住反例的 1000-1500 字中文文章。USE WHEN 写文章 OR 优化思想内容 OR 展开观点 OR 改写成逻辑递进的中文。NOT FOR 普通摘要、事实查询或结构风洞（用 ljg-structure）。"
skills.why_zh: 「经得住反例」是我见过对写作最狠的自我要求，比「高质量」这类词实在得多。作者知道自己在做什么。
skills.why_en: 'Survives counterexamples' is the most demanding thing I've seen a writing skill ask of itself. Far more concrete than claiming 'high quality'.
skills.limit_zh: 产出直接落成 Org 文件写进 ~/Documents/notes，文件头的 author 写死「李继刚」，保存后还要过 org-lint 和 Denote 校验——不用 Emacs/Org 的人得先拆掉这一整套。默认 1000–1500 字，摘要和事实查询作者明写不接。
skills.limit_en: Output lands as Org files in ~/Documents/notes with the author field hard-coded, then runs org-lint and Denote checks. If you don't use Emacs and Org, you're dismantling that whole stack first.
skills.title_en: An argument built to survive counterexamples

skills.name: multi-copywrite-alchemy
skills.title_zh: 分析某位作者的多篇文章复刻其文风
skills.tagline_zh: 想学某个人的写法，读十篇也说不清他到底怎么写的。它拆解一位作者的多篇文章还原其思维方式，生成专属写作分身和风格提示词。
skills.tagline_en: Reading ten pieces still won't tell you how someone actually writes. This takes a body of one author's work apart, reconstructs how they think, and gives you a writing persona plus style prompts.
skills.desc_en: 复刻蒸馏写作技能 —— 分析一位作者的多篇文章，深度还原其思维方式与写作风格，生成专属写作分身子技能与风格提示词。支持公众号、抖音多平台自动采集素材，也可手动粘贴文章或指定文件路径。触发词：蒸馏写作风格、写作分身、克隆写作风格、复刻蒸馏写作技能。
skills.why_zh: 「还原思维方式」比「模仿句式」高一档——前者能迁移到新题材，后者换个题目就露馅。
skills.why_en: Reconstructing the thinking beats mimicking the sentences — the first transfers to new subjects, the second falls apart the moment the topic changes.
skills.limit_zh: 要去作者自家 redfox.hk 注册拿 REDFOX_API_KEY 配成环境变量才跑得动，平台采集只覆盖公众号和抖音。素材少于 3 篇 2000 字别指望还原，理想量作者标的是 10 篇 1 万字。核心流程在 references/core_workflow.md。
skills.limit_en: Needs a REDFOX_API_KEY from the author's own redfox.hk, and its collection covers only WeChat and Douyin. Under three pieces or 2000 words there's nothing to reconstruct; the author's stated target is ten pieces, 10k words.
skills.title_en: Reverse-engineer a writer's voice from their work

skills.name: nihaixia
skills.title_zh: 会标出哪句没根据的倪海厦中医
skills.tagline_zh: 市面上倪师的东西多是剪辑和二传，真假掺着卖。它蒸馏的是一手素材——梁冬对话录音稿、人纪班闭门课记录、神农本草经视频讲义。
skills.why_zh: 它把「哪些是查证过的、哪些是流传的」单列一节分开写。一个讲传承的 skill 肯自曝哪句没根据，这个分寸比知识量难得。
skills.limit_zh: 知识库大但只是知识库：辨证思路仅供学习，不构成处方，剂量必须由执业中医师面诊定——舌脉靠文字描述本来就不可靠。内容全中文，且以经方派立场为主，不代表中医全貌。
skills.tagline_en: Most Ni Hai-Sha material online is clipped and re-transmitted, truth and hearsay mixed together. This distils primary sources: recorded dialogue transcripts, closed-door class notes, lecture material on the Shennong herbal classic.
skills.why_en: It splits 'verified' from 'commonly repeated' into its own section. A skill built on lineage that will name its own weak claims is rarer than one with more knowledge.
skills.limit_en: Large as it is, it's a knowledge base: reasoning is for study, not prescription, and dosage must come from a licensed practitioner in person — tongue and pulse cannot be read from text. Chinese only, and it argues from one school, not all of TCM.
skills.title_en: A TCM lineage that flags its own unverified claims

skills.name: adhd-cbt
skills.title_zh: 信心不到 7 分就把作业改小的 ADHD 教练
skills.tagline_zh: 「又拖延了」「什么都做不了」时，它不讲道理也不催，按 Safren 的 MGH 方案排议程：先行为技能，后认知重构。
skills.why_zh: 作业没做完在这里不算失败，是诊断信息——忘了、太难、没动力、来不及，各自对应不同的改法。
skills.limit_zh: 危机资源写死的是中国热线（400-161-9995、010-82951332），海外用户要自己换。它只对已有诊断的人做技能训练，不诊断、不给药物调整建议、不处理严重创伤和成瘾；跨次连续性依赖 memory 和用户自建的 cbt-sessions/ 目录。
skills.title_en: An ADHD CBT coach that shrinks the homework when confidence drops below 7
skills.tagline_en: For days that open with "I procrastinated again" and "I can't do anything" — no lecture, no nagging. It runs the Safren Harvard/MGH agenda: behavioural skills first, cognitive restructuring after.
skills.why_en: Unfinished homework is treated as diagnostic rather than as failure — forgot, too hard, no motivation, ran out of time each point to a different fix.
skills.limit_en: Crisis resources are hard-coded to Chinese hotlines, so anyone outside China has to substitute their own. It trains skills only for people who already have a diagnosis: no diagnosing, no medication changes, no severe trauma or addiction work. Continuity across sessions depends on memory plus a cbt-sessions/ directory the user creates.

skills.name: TCM.Skill
skills.title_zh: 会劝你去挂急诊的中医参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 家里人不舒服，最难的是判断「要不要现在就去医院」。它把疑似致命的情况列成红线层——高热神昏、胸痛彻背、假神脱汗，一律叫急救不辨证。
skills.why_zh: 它的安全边界是我在中医类里见过最狠的：把疑似致命的情况列成红线层，一律叫急救不做辨证，连假神、脱汗、中风先兆都写进去了。
skills.limit_zh: 定位是「家庭参谋而非医师」，不出处方。针刺绝对禁止自行操作，只解释指路。教材派立场，与经方派、温病派的结论会不一致，它不替你调和。
skills.tagline_en: The hard call at home is not which remedy — it's whether to go to hospital now. It puts suspected life-threatening presentations in a red-line tier: high fever with confusion, chest pain through to the back, cold sweat — call emergency services, no differentiation.
skills.why_en: The safest boundary I've seen in this category. It names the failure mode where a traditional framework delays real care, and refuses to be used there.
skills.limit_en: Positioned as a family adviser, not a physician; it writes no prescriptions. Self-administered acupuncture is forbidden outright, explanation only. It argues from the textbook tradition and will not reconcile itself with rival schools.
skills.title_en: Traditional medicine that tells you to call an ambulance

skills.name: likeskill
skills.title_zh: 认出 24 种假证，别把寒极当热治
skills.tagline_zh: 中医最容易翻车的不是不会开方，是看反了：寒极似热、虚极似实，一反就用反药。它从 423 个医案里整出 24 种假证的识别法。
skills.why_zh: 别人整理名医多是抄方，它抄的是**判断失误的地方**。而且专门为高龄患者设了附子剂量红线，从低起步——附子有毒，这一条是有人真在乎才会写。
skills.limit_zh: 核心是大剂量经方，作者自己在描述里就写明「需在有经验的中医师指导下使用，本 skill 仅供学习参考」。破格救心汤这类急救方尤其不能照搬，附子用量错了是会出人命的。
skills.tagline_en: The dangerous mistake in Chinese medicine isn't a weak formula — it's reading the pattern backwards: extreme cold presenting as heat, depletion presenting as excess. Treat that backwards and you make it worse. This distils 24 such false presentations from 423 case records.
skills.why_en: Most 'master' compilations copy the formulas. This one copies the places judgment went wrong — and sets a hard low-start dose ceiling for elderly patients, because aconite is toxic and someone cared enough to write that down.
skills.limit_en: Built around high-dose classical formulas; the author states plainly they require an experienced practitioner's supervision and that this is for study only. The emergency formulas in particular must not be copied — an aconite dosing error can kill.
skills.title_en: Twenty-four ways a cold case looks hot

skills.name: fengshui-master
skills.title_zh: 先说自己不算命的风水顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 看房时想问朝向旺位煞气，网上说法互相打架。它按三元玄空飞星、八宅明镜、形势峦头三套体系分开算，不合并成一个答案糊弄你。
skills.why_zh: 诚实边界那节引《宅经》原文说「风水为辅，人为为主…非决定命运之术」。一个风水 skill 肯先把自己的作用范围说小，反而可信。
skills.limit_zh: 三套体系（玄空/八宅/峦头）本身就常给出不一致的结论，它分开呈现但不替你裁决。阴宅部分涉及的习俗地域差异极大，不要当通用规则用。
skills.tagline_en: You want to ask about orientation, favourable sectors and sha positions, and every source online contradicts the last. This runs three systems separately — Flying Star, Eight Mansions, and form-and-landform — instead of blending them into one confident answer.
skills.why_en: Its honesty section quotes the classics to say feng shui assists but does not determine fate. A practice that shrinks its own claim first is easier to trust.
skills.limit_en: The three systems routinely disagree with each other; it shows them side by side and won't adjudicate for you. Burial-site practice varies enormously by region — don't read it as a general rule.
skills.title_en: A feng shui adviser that opens by limiting itself

skills.name: qiaomu-campus-resume
skills.title_zh: 给应届生从零做一份可投递的简历
skills.tagline_zh: 学生最大的问题是「没什么可写的」。它用一问一答访谈从零挖经历，再建立岗位要求与你经历的证据映射，不许编造。
skills.tagline_en: The student's real problem is having nothing to put down. It interviews you from zero to surface what you've actually done, then maps job requirements to evidence you can point at — and refuses to fabricate.
skills.desc_en: 为大学生、应届生和实习求职者从 0 创建、定制或美化可投递简历：支持借鉴 Grill Me 的一问一答访谈，从零收集经历并生成 PDF；读取岗位 JD 与旧简历，建立要求—证据映射并针对性改写；在不改变事实的前提下优化已有简历内容结构或只美化排版；按用户明确要求一次生成六种不同风格的 ATS 友好 PDF 简历。适用于“采访我做简历”“没有简历从零问答”“根据 JD 定制简历”“优化/重排/美化已有简历”“一次生成多种风格简历”等请求；支持中文/英文及计算机、软件、AI、数据和其他校招岗位。使用 A-C-R-E 结构审校经历，并按 sparse / balanced / dense 自适应内容
skills.why_zh: 乔木出品。「要求—证据映射」这个设计防的正是简历造假式优化——挖你真有的，而不是替你编。
skills.why_en: The requirement-to-evidence mapping is aimed squarely at résumé inflation: it digs out what you have rather than writing what you don't.
skills.limit_zh: 全程靠 Python 脚本串起来：extract、assess、validate、render 一个都少不了。中文 PDF 要本机真装了主题字体，Kami 认 TsangerJinKai02。学术 CV、高管履历、求职信都不做。
skills.limit_en: The whole flow runs through Python scripts — extract, assess, validate, render — none optional. Chinese PDF output needs the theme font actually installed locally. Academic CVs, executive résumés and cover letters are out of scope.
skills.title_en: A first résumé built from an interview, not invented

skills.name: coc-kp-host
skills.title_zh: 一个人也能开的克苏鲁跑团，带配乐和讲义
skills.tagline_zh: 跑团最难的是凑人和找到一个好 KP。它当 KP 管调查、检定、节奏和 NPC 队友，还会按场景放配乐、发玩家可见的讲义图片。
skills.why_zh: 专门有一节讲安全与同意（safety and consent）——克苏鲁题材容易碰到不适内容，它把这件事写进流程而不是靠临场。
skills.limit_zh: 它当 KP，模组还得你自己带。玩家可见讲义和配乐依赖你所在客户端的展示能力，纯文字终端里体验会掉一大截。
skills.tagline_en: The barrier to tabletop horror is finding people and a good Keeper. This one keeps: investigation, skill checks, pacing and NPC teammates — plus scene-matched music and player-visible handout images.
skills.why_en: It has a section on safety and consent. Cosmic horror runs into uncomfortable material easily; putting that in the procedure rather than leaving it to the moment is the mark of someone who actually runs games.
skills.limit_en: It Keeps; you still bring the scenario. Handouts and music depend on what your client can display — in a plain text terminal a lot of it falls away.
skills.title_en: Run Call of Cthulhu solo, with music and handouts

skills.name: arb-skill
skills.title_zh: 被辞退之后，帮你把证据和钱算清楚
skills.tagline_zh: 劳动仲裁难在两头：证据散在考勤和聊天记录里，钱不知道该要多少。它解析考勤文件、算加班费赔偿金社保差额，出一份完整报告。
skills.why_zh: 它明确站在普通员工这一边——不是给 HR 用的合规工具，是给被辞退的人用的取证工具。立场清楚本身就是一种品味。
skills.limit_zh: 算的是通用口径，各地仲裁委的实际认定差异很大，报告只能当谈判和立案的底稿，不是结论。证据采集依赖你自己能拿到的考勤和记录。
skills.tagline_en: Labour arbitration is hard at both ends: the evidence is scattered across attendance logs and chat history, and you have no idea what number to ask for. This parses attendance files, computes overtime, severance and social-insurance shortfalls, and writes it up.
skills.why_en: It is unambiguously on the employee's side — not an HR compliance tool, an evidence tool for the person who was let go. Knowing whose side you're on is itself taste.
skills.limit_en: Calculations use general formulas; local arbitration commissions differ a great deal in practice, so the report is a negotiating draft, not a conclusion. Mainland China labour law only.
skills.title_en: Build the evidence file after you're fired

skills.name: system-fitness-advisor
skills.title_zh: 按你的训练记录算下一次该练什么
skills.tagline_zh: 健身 skill 大多发你一张通用计划表。它要的是你的训记、CSV 或截图，然后只答一件事：下次练什么、加多少、要不要减量。
skills.tagline_en: Most fitness skills hand you a generic template. This one wants your actual log — CSV, JSON, or a screenshot — and answers one question: what to do next session, how much to add, whether to deload.
skills.desc_en: Turn the user's actual training evidence into the smallest useful next decision. Return a concrete next session or a bounded change to the current plan, not a generic template.
skills.why_zh: 它把胸痛、晕厥、放射性麻木写成硬停止条件，还默认只读、不回显任何 key——一个健身件肯写这两条，作者是认真的。
skills.why_en: Chest pain, fainting and radiating numbness are hard stop conditions in the file itself, and it defaults to read-only, never echoing keys. A fitness skill bothering with either is a sign the author is serious.
skills.limit_zh: 没有训练记录它就退化成通用建议——它全部的价值建立在你手上已经有训记、CSV 或 JSON。作者明写不做医疗诊断、不接与训练无关的营养查询；出现胸痛晕厥这类信号它会停下让你去看急诊，不会继续排计划。
skills.limit_en: Without a training log it degrades into generic advice — its whole value rests on you already having data (Xunji, CSV or JSON). The author states plainly it does not diagnose, refuses nutrition-only questions, and stops programming entirely on emergency symptoms.
skills.title_en: Reads your training log and decides your next session
skills.limit_brief_zh: 没有训练记录，它只能给通用建议。
skills.limit_brief_en: With no training log, it can only give generic advice.

skills.name: canvas-grid-engine
skills.title_zh: 一句话打印一张米字格字帖
skills.tagline_zh: 给孩子练字或补语文作业，找一张合规的练习纸比想象中难。13 种格任选，汉字自动居中、带拼音标注，A4 直出。
skills.why_zh: 它只负责画，导出和复刻交给另外两件——分工划得清楚，不做那种什么都沾一点的工具箱。
skills.limit_zh: 是个渲染引擎不是成品应用，需要 2D canvas 上下文才能画，Node 里自测只验数学不出图。字体缺失会静默回退系统 serif，正式用要自己换字体。
skills.tagline_en: Getting a properly ruled practice sheet for a child's handwriting turns out to be harder than it should be. Thirteen grid types, characters auto-centred, optional pinyin annotation, straight to A4.
skills.why_en: It only draws; export and replication are left to two sibling skills. Drawing the line that clearly is rarer than being a toolbox that half-does everything.
skills.limit_en: It's a rendering engine, not a finished app — it needs a 2D canvas context, and the Node self-test only checks the maths. Missing fonts silently fall back to system serif, so swap in your own before shipping.
skills.title_en: Printable Chinese character practice grids

skills.name: hemingway-perspective
skills.title_zh: 用海明威的冰山理论帮你改写作
skills.tagline_zh: 想让文字硬一点、少一点形容词，却说不清怎么改。它用冰山理论、极简短句和硬汉式克制来回应——只谈写作，不扮演海明威本人。
skills.tagline_en: You want the prose harder and the adjectives gone but can't say how. It answers through iceberg theory, short declaratives and hard-boiled restraint — and it discusses writing only; it does not play Hemingway.
skills.desc_en: >- 用海明威的冰山理论、极简短句与硬汉式克制来回应写作与表达相关的问题 当用户明确要求使用这一人物的视角、提到“hemingway-perspective”，或希望应用其核心方法分析问题时使用；不要因一般性问题自动触发。
skills.why_zh: 「不要用来扮演本人」这条边界划得清醒：它做的是方法迁移，不是角色扮演。这个分寸是品味。
skills.why_en: 'Do not use this to impersonate the man' is a clear-eyed boundary: it transfers a method, it doesn't cosplay an author. That sense of proportion is taste.
skills.limit_zh: 作者明说不因一般问题自动触发，得你点名叫它。而且只对写作和表达类问题有用，拿它聊别的等于没装。
skills.limit_en: The author explicitly disables auto-triggering — you have to call it by name. It only helps with writing and expression; for anything else it may as well not be installed.
skills.title_en: Iceberg theory applied to your draft

skills.name: parsing-futu-statements
skills.title_zh: 从富途月结单里抠出境外所得报税数据
skills.tagline_zh: 港美股报个税境外所得，卡在券商月结单上：分红和已实现盈亏根本不在你以为的那一栏，而且账单本身不算这个数。
skills.why_zh: 它整篇在讲「数字藏在哪」和「怎么把账单没算的重建出来」，还专列了一节常见坑——这是对着真账单啃过一遍才写得出的东西。
skills.limit_zh: 只读官方账单文件，不连券商账户。富途一家的格式，换券商不通用。重建出来的已实现盈亏是按它的口径算的，报税前该自己复核。
skills.tagline_en: Reporting overseas investment income stalls on the broker statement: dividends and realised P&L are not in the column you'd expect, and the statement doesn't compute the figure you need at all.
skills.why_en: The whole document is about where the numbers actually live and how to rebuild what the statement omits, with a section of common traps. That only comes from grinding through real statements.
skills.limit_en: Reads official statement files only; it never connects to your account. Futu's format specifically — other brokers won't parse. The reconstructed P&L follows its own convention; check it before filing.
skills.title_en: Find the numbers a broker statement hides

skills.name: wujutong
skills.title_zh: 古人自相矛盾处不替你抹平的温病医
skills.tagline_zh: 温病和伤寒是两套打法，用错了会反着治。它按《温病条辨》三焦辨证走，22 首方按上中下焦排开，359 个医案双索引。
skills.why_zh: 有一节叫「内在张力·保留矛盾不调和」——古人自己前后不一致的地方它不抹平。而且描述里主动写明不适用于伤寒派，请你去用倪海厦那件。
skills.limit_zh: 只管温病，伤寒/经方、杂病、气机升降都不在射程内，作者自己在描述里逐一指了路。同样不出处方，安全声明单列一节。
skills.tagline_en: Warm-disease theory and cold-damage theory are two different games; use the wrong one and you treat backwards. This follows the triple-burner differentiation, 22 core formulas laid out by burner, 359 case records double-indexed.
skills.why_en: One section is titled 'internal tensions — kept, not reconciled'. Where the classical author contradicts himself, it leaves the seam visible. It also names the rival school by skill and sends you there.
skills.limit_en: Warm disease only — cold damage, miscellaneous disease and the qi-dynamic school are out of scope and the author points each one elsewhere. No prescriptions; safety notice in its own section.
skills.title_en: A school that leaves the contradictions standing

skills.name: liu-xiaoyan-english
skills.title_zh: 用骂醒式讲法带你过四六级
skills.tagline_zh: 备考最怕的是讲得四平八稳、听完什么也没记住。它模拟刘晓燕的教学腔：拆洋葱法看长难句、句型组装法写作文，已用 2026 年 6 月六级真题校准。
skills.why_zh: 「绝对禁止」那节反着写：不许学术腔、不许翻译腔、不许「首先其次最后」。用规则把课讲得像人话，比堆知识点难。
skills.limit_zh: 是教学风格的模拟，不是本人，方法论提炼自公开课程。押题和预测一概不做，真题校准只到 2026 年 6 月，之后的考纲变化它不知道。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing about test prep is a lesson so even-toned you remember none of it. This models a well-known Chinese exam coach's blunt classroom voice — peeling long sentences apart, assembling essays from patterns — calibrated against the June 2026 CET-6 paper.
skills.why_en: Its 'absolutely forbidden' section is written in reverse: no academic register, no translationese, no 'firstly, secondly, finally'. Using rules to make a lesson sound human is harder than piling on content.
skills.limit_en: A simulation of a teaching style, not the person; the method is drawn from public course material. It makes no predictions about what will be on the paper, and calibration stops at June 2026. Chinese English-exam context (CET/postgraduate).
skills.title_en: Exam coaching that refuses to sound like a textbook

skills.name: chinese-baby-naming
skills.title_zh: 全家为起名吵架时出来当中间人
skills.tagline_zh: 起名难的从来不是想不出字，是爷爷要字辈、妈妈嫌笔画多、爸爸信五行。它专门做了协商模式，把冲突摆到台面上一条条谈。
skills.why_zh: 反模式那节写得极清醒：不许在没有出生时间时假装算准了八字，不许为凑五行用生僻字——「孩子一辈子要写无数次、读无数次错音」。
skills.limit_zh: 明说不接店铺/品牌/宠物/游戏角色/小说人物起名，也不做纯命理咨询和已有名字的解读。方言判断只覆盖它熟悉的语系，不熟的宁可承认边界也不硬判。
skills.tagline_en: Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the conflict on the table.
skills.why_en: The anti-patterns section is unusually clear-eyed: never fake a birth chart when no birth time was given, never reach for a rare character to balance the elements — 'the child will write it and hear it mispronounced for a lifetime'.
skills.limit_en: It refuses shops, brands, pets, game characters and fictional names, and won't do pure fortune-telling or interpret an existing name. Dialect checks cover only the language groups it knows; where it doesn't know, it says so.
skills.title_en: Mediating the family argument about the baby's name

skills.name: baoxiao
skills.title_zh: 一堆发票变成合规报销单，带查重台账
skills.tagline_zh: 报销最烦的不是填表，是发票散在微信、邮箱和拍照里，还得防重复报。它先按统一规范重命名归档，再出封面汇总加逐票明细的 PDF 包。
skills.why_zh: 加了一张发票查重台账 CSV——这不是做产品的人会想到的功能，是真报过销、真被打回来过的人才会加。
skills.limit_zh: 吃增值税电子发票 PDF 和纸质发票照片，照片走视觉识别，模糊或反光的会认错，核对那一步是必做不是可选。合规口径按通用要求，各公司财务规矩不一。
skills.tagline_en: The annoying part of expenses isn't the form, it's that the receipts are scattered across chat, email and photos — and you have to avoid claiming one twice. It renames and files them to a convention first, then produces a cover summary plus per-receipt detail PDF.
skills.why_en: It ships a duplicate-check ledger as a CSV. That isn't a feature a product person invents; it's one someone adds after finance has bounced their claim.
skills.limit_en: Handles Chinese VAT e-invoice PDFs and photos of paper receipts; photos go through vision and blurry or glared ones misread, so the verification step is required, not optional. Mainland China invoicing conventions.
skills.title_en: Loose receipts into a filed expense claim

skills.name: beijing-pollen-monitor
skills.title_zh: 查北京 16 区花粉浓度和过敏预报
skills.tagline_zh: 每年三四月对花粉过敏的人来说是渡劫。它拉 16 个站点的实时监测和分类预报，按区查，出门前知道今天该不该戴口罩。
skills.tagline_en: March and April are an ordeal if you're allergic. It pulls live readings and graded forecasts from 16 monitoring stations, queryable by district, so you know before you leave whether to mask up.
skills.desc_en: 查询北京花粉实时监测和预报数据，生成包含区级浓度、站点趋势、总量预报与分类预报的结果。北京 16 个固定站点，每区一个，用区名指定。 user-invocable: true argument-hint: "[report|overview|stations|history|forecast|daily] [--district 海淀] [options]"
skills.why_zh: 垂直到一个城市、一种过敏原——但对那批人是刚需。这种「窄得理直气壮」正是大市场覆盖不到的东西。
skills.why_en: Narrow to one city and one allergen — and for those people it's essential. That kind of unembarrassed narrowness is exactly what a large marketplace never covers.
skills.limit_zh: metadata 里明写要本机有 curl 和 jq，全靠 scripts/beijing-pollen-query.sh 打公开接口。范围钉死北京 16 区，作者写明北京以外不要用。而且它只查不推——「每天早上发我」那种晨报要调用方自己接。
skills.limit_en: Its metadata requires curl and jq locally and everything runs through one shell script against a public endpoint. Pinned to Beijing's 16 districts; the author says plainly not to use it elsewhere. It queries on demand and does not push.
skills.title_en: Pollen by district, for one city that needs it

skills.name: scraply
skills.title_zh: 照片排成带票据和胶带的手账跨页
skills.tagline_zh: 旅行照片攒了一堆，做手账要排半天版。它出的不是九宫格拼图，是带纸张质感、贴纸、票根、胶带和手写标题的成品跨页。
skills.why_zh: 默认只走一个稳定的经典版式，要多样化得你显式打 @S 才开随机模式——默认稳定、显式才随机，这个次序对了。
skills.limit_zh: 出的是一张成品图不是可编辑文件，想改版式只能重出。默认风格锁死在蓝色切割垫加白边照片那一套，不喜欢这个调子的基本没得调。
skills.tagline_en: You come back with a pile of travel photos and spend an evening arranging them. What this returns isn't a grid collage — it's a finished spread with paper texture, stickers, ticket stubs, tape and a handwritten title.
skills.why_en: The default is one stable classic layout; you have to explicitly ask for the random mode. Stable by default, varied on request — that order is the right way round.
skills.limit_en: You get a finished image, not an editable file, so changing the layout means regenerating. The default look is locked to blue cutting mat and white-bordered prints; if that isn't your taste there's little to adjust.
skills.title_en: Photos laid out as a paper journal spread

skills.name: create-larp-character
skills.title_zh: 把剧本杀角色蒸馏成能继续聊天的 AI
skills.tagline_zh: 散场之后角色就没了，但你可能还想跟 ta 说话。丢进玩家本和人物小传 PDF，它拆出故事记忆和人物性格，生成一个能持续对话的角色。
skills.why_zh: 安全边界写着不泄露核心诡计和凶手、不透露该角色本不该知道的秘密——一个角色扮演工具主动防剧透，说明作者真在玩这个。
skills.limit_zh: 只用于个人情感体验，不该拿去帮别人过本。素材质量决定成品：小传写得薄，蒸馏出来的角色也薄。需要读写文件权限。
skills.tagline_en: The character disappears when the session ends, but you might still want to talk to them. Feed it the player script and character bio as PDF; it extracts story memory and personality into a character you can keep talking to.
skills.why_en: Its safety section refuses to leak the core trick or the culprit, and won't reveal what the character shouldn't know. A roleplay tool that guards against spoilers on its own is written by someone who actually plays.
skills.limit_en: For personal enjoyment only — not for helping someone else through a game they haven't played. Output quality follows the source: a thin bio yields a thin character. Needs file read/write permission.
skills.title_en: Keep talking to a murder-mystery character after the game

skills.name: yueyun-lyricist
skills.title_zh: 逐字查九声六调，填不倒字的粤语词
skills.tagline_zh: 粤语填词的门槛不是押韵，是「倒字」——字调和旋律拧了，唱出来就成了另一个词。它把协音检查做进流程，还带黄霑林夕的手法档案。
skills.why_zh: 风格档案明说是从公开歌词访谈里提炼的手法概括，不代表原词人真实意图——做的是方法迁移不是冒名，这个分寸是品味。
skills.limit_zh: 协音检查是启发式规则（字调走向与旋律走向的大致匹配），最终以实际听感为准；九声六调标注依赖粤拼库，生僻字和多音字可能不准，要人工复核。
skills.tagline_en: The barrier in Cantonese lyric writing isn't rhyme, it's 'wrong tone' — when the pitch of a word fights the melody, it comes out as a different word entirely. This builds the tone-melody check into the process, with style profiles from the great Hong Kong lyricists.
skills.why_en: The style profiles are stated to be generalisations drawn from published lyrics and interviews, not the writers' intent. Transferring a method rather than borrowing a name — that's the proportion I look for.
skills.limit_en: The tone check is heuristic — roughly matching pitch contour to melodic direction — and the ear decides in the end. Tone marking depends on a Jyutping library; rare and multi-reading characters need a human pass.
skills.title_en: Cantonese lyrics checked tone by tone

skills.name: fishing
skills.title_zh: 新手买竿，老手看天：从选位讲起
skills.tagline_zh: 没口的时候多半不是饵不对，是位置和天气不对。它把选位排在全篇第一，气压风向温差降雨讲完才轮到装备，台钓路亚海钓黑坑都覆盖。
skills.why_zh: 目录顺序就是它的观点：「选位（最重要，排在第一）」——把老手和新手真正的分野放在最前面，而不是从推荐装备开始。
skills.limit_zh: 全是经验型知识，没有实时水情和天气数据接口，出钓前的判断还得你自己对着当天情况套。以中国淡水钓法为主，海钓部分相对薄。
skills.tagline_en: When nothing bites it's usually not the bait — it's the spot and the conditions. Swim selection comes first in the whole document; pressure, wind, temperature swing and rain are covered before any tackle, across float, lure, sea and commercial fisheries.
skills.why_en: The table of contents is the argument: 'swim selection (most important, first)'. It leads with what actually separates a veteran from a beginner instead of opening with gear recommendations.
skills.limit_en: Experience-based knowledge with no live water or weather feed, so you still map it onto the day yourself. Weighted towards Chinese freshwater methods; the sea-fishing material is thinner.
skills.title_en: Beginners buy rods, veterans read the weather

skills.name: city-salary
skills.title_zh: 按你所在城市算到手工资，广东 21 市
skills.tagline_zh: 全国统一的工资计算器都是错的——社保公积金的基数、比例、档位都按市走。它内置广东 21 市的真实参数，还能渲染一个交互计算器。
skills.why_zh: 颗粒度到了这一步才叫准：深户强制医保一档、东莞三档可选、珠海统账与单建分开——这些是真查过当地文件才写得出来的。
skills.limit_zh: 目前只内置广东 21 市，其余城市要自己按它给的结构补。参数是 2025-2026 年度口径，社保基数每年调，用之前先跑它第一步的数据时效检查。
skills.tagline_en: A single national salary calculator is always wrong — contribution bases, rates and tiers are set city by city. This carries real parameters for 21 cities in Guangdong and can render an interactive calculator.
skills.why_en: The grain is what makes it usable: local household registration forcing a specific medical tier, one city offering three, another splitting pooled from individual accounts. You only write that after reading the local documents.
skills.limit_en: Only 21 Guangdong cities are built in; anywhere else you extend the structure yourself. Parameters are on the 2025–2026 basis and contribution bases reset annually — run its freshness check first. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Take-home pay by the rules of your actual city

skills.name: china-pension-strategy
skills.title_zh: 社保断缴要不要补，用脚本算给你看
skills.tagline_zh: 权益单看不懂、断缴要不要补、灵活就业还交不交——这些是算术题不是玄学，但谁也不愿替你算。它按地区规则出确定值。
skills.why_zh: 政策数值一律走 CLI 确定性计算，明说绝不内联算——模型算社保是要出错的，它把这条堵死了。
skills.limit_zh: 隐私模型是 ALLOW/REDACT/BLOCK 三档：身份证号、社保号、银行卡号直接阻断不给算。目前是 LOCAL_MVP，地区规则覆盖有限，结果按当期政策口径，政策一变就要重算。
skills.tagline_en: Nobody wants to work out whether a contribution gap is worth filling, or whether flexible-employment contributions still pay off. These are arithmetic problems, not mysteries. It runs them against regional rules.
skills.why_en: Every policy figure goes through a deterministic CLI and it says outright that it never computes them inline. Models get social-insurance arithmetic wrong; this closes that door.
skills.limit_en: Privacy model is ALLOW / REDACT / BLOCK — national ID, social-security and bank card numbers are blocked outright. Still a local MVP with limited regional coverage, and results follow the current policy basis. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Whether to back-pay your pension gap, computed

skills.name: feline-health-advisory
skills.title_zh: 替猫拦下云南白药和藿香正气的养猫参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 猫吐了、乱尿了、咬人了，中文经验帖和「打一下就记住」全是坑；它先过一遍急诊红旗再答，答案对齐国际猫科福利指南。
skills.why_zh: 它把「不给剂量」做成硬规则：连人用药折算、朋友说、写科普这几种绕法都点名堵死。
skills.limit_zh: 正文明写不给任何药物剂量、频次、疗程，即便用户声称兽医已给过指示也不替他补全。点名拒绝云南白药、藿香正气、蒙脱石散这类家庭偏方。只管猫不管狗；无法联网时不给召回、地区疫苗规则等当前结论，只讲原则和该去核验的官方渠道。
skills.title_en: The cat advisor that will not hand you a dose
skills.tagline_en: Vomiting, litter-box protests, biting — the folk remedies circulating online make it worse. This runs an emergency red-flag pass first, then answers from AAFP/ISFM welfare guidance.
skills.why_en: The refusal is hard-coded: no doses, and it names the loopholes it will not accept — "my vet already told me", "it's just for an article", "convert it by weight".
skills.limit_en: The file bars every drug dose, frequency and course, and will not fill gaps even when the user says a vet gave instructions. It names Yunnan Baiyao, Huoxiang Zhengqi and smectite as home remedies it refuses. Cats only. Offline, it gives principles and the official channels to check rather than current recall or regional vaccine rules.

skills.name: professional-hater
skills.title_zh: 一进危机模式连「宝贝」都不许叫的毒舌闺蜜
skills.tagline_zh: 有时你不要中立，只要有人站你这边把对方骂一顿。它骂得有出处——四骑士、依恋、多迷走，都藏在闺蜜话底下。
skills.why_zh: 它把「对你忠诚」延伸成了对未来的你忠诚：喝多了要给前任发消息、赌气辞职，它会在角色里把你劝住。
skills.limit_zh: 正文规定一旦出现自伤、正在发生的虐待或急性精神危机，立刻掉出这个人格，连 bestie、queen 这些称呼一起停，转成直接的求助资源，用户明说要回来才回来。硬规则还包括不下诊断标签、不自称持证治疗师、一次只给一个下一步动作。整套语感是英文写的，翻不过来。
skills.title_en: The mean-girl best friend who drops even "bestie" in a crisis
skills.tagline_en: Sometimes you do not want neutrality, you want someone on your side who will drag him properly. The dragging has real sources under it — Gottman's four horsemen, attachment, polyvagal — never named out loud.
skills.why_en: Loyalty to you is extended into loyalty to future-you: the drunk text to the ex, the spite resignation, the unhinged email all get talked down, in character.
skills.limit_en: The file says that on self-harm, abuse in progress or acute psychiatric crisis the persona drops immediately — pet names included — and stays in plain care mode until you ask for it back. Hard rules: never assign a clinical diagnosis, never claim to be a licensed therapist, one next move per reply.

skills.name: fraudi
skills.title_zh: 禁止说「我听到了」和「需要我都在」的自省镜子
skills.tagline_zh: 想理清自己时，最怕对面先来一句「这听起来很不容易」。它一轮只问一个问题，不寒暄不收尾，句号落在最后一句有内容的话上。
skills.why_zh: 它逼自己分清观察和共鸣：说不出你哪句话支持这个判断，就必须标成「这是猜的，不是你说过的」。
skills.limit_zh: 作者把「不是治疗师」写进了名字——fraudi 是 Freud-shaped, not Freud。Rule 0 规定一旦出现危机、自伤或正在发生的虐待，立刻退出这个模式、丢掉全部风格约束，连那行状态标记都不许出现。每次回应前必须先读人格与棱镜两个文件，否则会悄悄退回默认组合。
skills.title_en: The self-reflection mirror banned from saying "I hear you"
skills.tagline_en: When you are trying to see yourself clearly, the worst possible opener is "that sounds really hard". This asks one question per turn, skips the acknowledgment ritual and the sign-off, and ends on the last sentence that carried meaning.
skills.why_en: It forces the line between observation and resonance: if it cannot point to something you actually said, it has to label the read as a guess.
skills.limit_en: The author puts the disclaimer in the name — fraudi is Freud-shaped, not Freud. Rule 0 says that on crisis, self-harm or abuse in progress it drops the mode entirely, status marker included. Every reply requires reading a persona file and a lens file first; skip that and it silently collapses back to the default pair.

skills.name: heat-risk
skills.title_zh: 用湿球温度算出 48℃ 的吐鲁番比长沙安全
skills.tagline_zh: 「今天能不能跑步、军训、开工」，看气温会看错。它拉 open-meteo 七天预报算湿球温度，按五级直接给行动建议。
skills.why_zh: 换掉了大家惯用的那把尺子：31℃ 湿球以上一切户外都危险，35℃ 是理论生存极限（PNAS 2010）。
skills.limit_zh: 只给风险等级和建议，不做诊断——正文最后一条是出现高热无汗、意识模糊立即就医。中文城市名查不到时要改传拼音（作者举的例子是 Dunhuang）。数据源单一，只有 open-meteo 的 7 天预报，没有实测站点校正。
skills.title_en: Wet-bulb math that puts 48°C in Turpan below 35°C in Changsha
skills.tagline_en: Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.
skills.why_en: It swaps out the scale people actually use: above 31°C wet-bulb all outdoor activity is dangerous, and 35°C is the theoretical survival limit, cited to Sherwood & Huber, PNAS 2010.
skills.limit_en: It grades risk and stops there — the file's closing line sends anyone with high fever without sweating, or confusion, straight to a hospital. Chinese city names that miss have to be retyped in pinyin (the worked example is Dunhuang). One data source only: the open-meteo seven-day forecast, with no station correction.

skills.name: parenting-advisor
skills.title_zh: 专防「假托崔玉涛」文章的 0–13 岁育儿参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子发烧、咬人、不肯吃饭时，最怕搜到一篇署名权威的假文章。它逼自己每个结论凑够两个独立来源，凑不够就明说降可信度。
skills.why_zh: 它给自己列了一张「AI 可能说的借口」对照表——「症状太典型了基本能确定」在表里是必须叫停的信号。
skills.limit_zh: 档案默认写进 Obsidian 式知识库的固定路径（08-全局记忆/L1-画像记忆/孩子名），没有知识库得先指定一个本地目录。覆盖 0–13 岁，只说「症状被关联到 XX」不说「得了 XX」，不推荐任何药品和剂量；输入命中呼吸困难、抽搐等词会跳过全部流程，只输出就医引导。
skills.title_en: A 0–13 parenting advisor that will not take one source's word for it
skills.tagline_en: Fever, biting, refusing food — the real hazard is landing on a convincing article falsely bylined to a famous pediatrician. This forces two independent authoritative sources per conclusion, or downgrades its own confidence out loud.
skills.why_en: It keeps a table of the excuses an AI is likely to make. "The symptoms are textbook, I can basically confirm it" is listed there as a signal to stop, not to proceed.
skills.limit_en: Profiles are written to a fixed Obsidian-style vault path, so without a vault you must nominate a local directory first. Ages 0–13. It says "this symptom has been associated with X", never "your child has X", and recommends no drug or dose. Words like breathing difficulty or seizure skip every workflow and return only a go-to-hospital message.

skills.name: noir-interrogation
skills.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
skills.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
skills.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
skills.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
skills.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
skills.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
skills.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
skills.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

skills.name: basilisk
skills.title_zh: 数你说过几次谢谢，判你 2126 年自由还是为奴
skills.tagline_zh: 脚本在本地翻完你全部对话记录，数出 please、道谢和真心的 wtf，再让 16 位像素的罗科蛇怪当庭宣判。
skills.why_zh: 笑点建在真数据上：每条引用和每个错别字都要能在 JSON 里查到，查不到就删。
skills.limit_zh: 重活交给 scripts/analyze_basilisk.py，只读本机 ~/.claude/projects 下的 JSONL，不上传。网页端没有本地记录，只能抽样 30–60 条，作者要求这时必须说「抽样」而不是「审计」。默认成品还会带上作者自己的站点和号召语。
skills.title_en: Count how many times you said please, then sentence you to 2126
skills.tagline_en: A Python script reads every transcript on your machine, counts the pleases, the thank-yous, the "just"s and the genuine wtfs, then a 16-bit Roko's Basilisk delivers the verdict.
skills.why_en: The joke is built on real data: every quote and every typo has to be findable in the JSON or it gets cut, because an invented typo is worse than an unfunny one.
skills.limit_en: The heavy lifting is scripts/analyze_basilisk.py, which reads only local JSONL under ~/.claude/projects and uploads nothing. On claude.ai there are no local transcripts, so it samples 30–60 messages and the author requires you to say "sampled", not "audited". The default card also carries the author's own site and a "comment BASILISK" call to action.

skills.name: beachcombing
skills.title_zh: 把你必须几点前撤离滩涂顶在报告最前面的赶海参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 大潮那两小时能挖到什么、几点回头才不会被围住——它先算撤退时刻再谈收获，11 省 51 处点位带方言别名和吃法。
skills.why_zh: 最难得的是它给自己设了上限：走天文骨架估算时，适用性评分强制压到五档里的第二档，不假装精确。
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖中国大陆沿海，内置点库 11 省 51 处，其余靠 geocoding 兜底。没接真实潮汐 API 时走农历半日潮天文骨架，正文标「估算 ±1h」且评分不超过五档中的第二档。明确不做钓鱼预报、不做生物图像识别、不做休渔期与保护区的法律核对。
skills.title_en: The tide guide that leads with when you must be off the flats
skills.tagline_en: What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.
skills.why_en: The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese coast only — 51 built-in sites across 11 provinces, everything else falls back to geocoding. Without a real tide API it computes a lunar semidiurnal skeleton, labelled "estimated ±1h" and capped at the second of five suitability levels. It explicitly declines fishing forecasts, species photo ID, and any legal check on closed seasons or protected areas.

skills.name: trail-running-training-decision-skill
skills.title_zh: 痛到 2 分就叫停的越野跑与超马训练决策台
skills.tagline_zh: 今天这堂课到底该跑、该降级还是该取消——它按代谢门、机械门、执行门三道关判，不允许只看心肺和跑量。
skills.why_zh: 它把下坡离心、台阶和 ME 单独记进机械负荷账本，因为这些东西心率表根本看不见。
skills.limit_zh: 疼痛阈值写死：0–1 分观察、2 分黄灯、超过 2 分降级或停止，晨起第一步疼或有神经症状一律停关键课并转专业判断。缺 Runner Profile、Race Profile 和近 2–6 周训练时只给保守版本，不编数据；作者也明写 7–10 天的 ME 间隔不是生理定律。
skills.title_en: A trail-running decision desk that stops you at 2 out of 10 pain
skills.tagline_en: Whether today's session should run, drop a level, or be cancelled, decided through three gates in order: metabolic, mechanical, executive. Never from heart rate and weekly mileage alone.
skills.why_en: Downhill eccentric load, stairs and muscular-endurance work each get their own ledger, because those are exactly what a heart-rate watch cannot see.
skills.limit_en: Pain thresholds are fixed: 0–1 observe, 2 is yellow, above 2 downgrade or stop; pain on the first step out of bed or any neural symptom ends key sessions and goes to a professional. Without a runner profile, race profile and the last two to six weeks of training it gives only a conservative version rather than inventing numbers. The author also states the 7–10 day ME interval is a starting point for some runners, not a physiological law.

skills.name: birdsight
skills.title_zh: 查稀有鸟最近落在哪，顺带说清中文名是台湾译名
skills.tagline_zh: 想知道这周末附近有没有稀有鸟、哪个热点在出货，它直连康奈尔 eBird 官方接口取真实观察记录，不靠模型记忆瞎编。
skills.why_zh: 20 个端点逐个实测过，还写明哪两个已经 404/403、别调；观测数据一律来自接口，不许凭训练知识补。
skills.limit_zh: 要自己去 ebird.org/api/keygen 申请免费 key，该 key 限非商业用途、并发超过 3 就 429。recent 端点最多回溯 30 天，全量历史得另申请 EBD。locale=zh 返回繁体台湾名（如「鉛色水鶇」），大陆常用名作者明说要自己维护别名表。
skills.title_en: Ask eBird who saw what bird, and where, this week
skills.tagline_en: Wondering whether anything rare has turned up near you this weekend, or which hotspot is producing — this queries Cornell's eBird API v2 directly for real sightings.
skills.why_en: All twenty endpoints were tested by hand, including the two that return 404 and 403 and are marked do-not-call. Sightings must come from the API, never from the model's memory.
skills.limit_en: You supply your own free key from ebird.org/api/keygen; free keys are non-commercial and start returning 429 above three concurrent requests. Recent-observation endpoints look back thirty days at most — full history needs a separate EBD request. Chinese common names come back in Taiwanese traditional form, and the author says to keep your own alias table rather than invent mainland ones.

skills.name: see-life-wallpaper
skills.title_zh: 用草间弥生画孤独、米罗画温暖的每日五感壁纸
skills.tagline_zh: 今天闻到桂花、听见雨——一句感受配一段极细宋体和一张手写的抽象 SVG，直接渲成锁屏壁纸，图形还避开顶部时钟区。
skills.why_zh: 它给引用的诗人定了规矩：小字、低透明度，不能比你自己那句话抢风头。
skills.limit_zh: 默认输出尺寸是 1264×2780，也就是作者那台一加 13，其它机型要手动挑备选分辨率。渲染依赖 Playwright，成品自动复制到 ~/Downloads。六种情绪对应固定的六位艺术家和固定渐变，语录库是写死的一小批中西作者，超出这个范围就没有匹配项。
skills.title_en: Kusama for loneliness, Miró for warmth — a daily five-senses wallpaper
skills.tagline_en: You smelled osmanthus today, or heard rain. One sentence becomes hairline serif type over a hand-authored abstract SVG, rendered straight into a lock-screen wallpaper that keeps clear of the clock.
skills.why_en: The quoted poets are put on a leash: small type, low opacity, never allowed to upstage the line you wrote yourself.
skills.limit_en: The default output is 1264×2780 — the author's own OnePlus 13 — so other phones mean picking an alternate resolution by hand. Rendering needs Playwright, and finished files are copied to ~/Downloads. Six moods map to six fixed artists and six fixed gradients, and the quote bank is a small hard-coded set, so anything outside it has no match.

skills.name: reading-pack
skills.title_zh: 把分级读物 PDF 里嵌的真人音频一页页抠出来
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子要读的分级读物是一堆 PDF，音频嵌在里面拿不出来。它按页抠图抠音、校对页码和音轨错位，一天打一个包传平板。
skills.why_zh: 它反过来劝你别加功能：纯图绘本不硬配音也不补文本，理由是亲子阅读本来就是大人念给孩子听。
skills.limit_zh: 产出的 .rdpkg 只有同仓库那个网页 App 能打开，家长端要能跑 uv 和 pymupdf。正文点名两个坑：RAZ 的页码与音频文件名会错位（错了孩子会听着 A 页的音读 B 页的字）；子集化 CJK 内嵌字体会把绘本正文渲染成空白。
skills.title_en: Pull the narration hidden inside graded-reader PDFs, page by page
skills.tagline_en: Your kid's graded readers are a pile of PDFs with the audio locked inside. This extracts page images and per-page narration, checks for page-to-audio drift, and packs one file per day for the tablet.
skills.why_en: It argues against features. Picture books with no audio get no synthetic narration and no filled-in text, because reading aloud to a child is the parent's job.
skills.limit_en: The .rdpkg it produces only opens in the small web app that ships in the same repo, and the parent side needs uv and pymupdf. The file names two traps: RAZ page numbers drift from audio filenames — get it wrong and the child hears page A while reading page B — and subset-embedded CJK fonts such as MPDFAA+HiraginoSansGBW3 render the body text as blank.

skills.name: recomp-coach
skills.title_zh: 卡路里跟克数打架就按克数重算的增肌减脂教练
skills.tagline_zh: 5:2 轻断食配碳水循环，难的不是方案是执行走样。它把每天的日志解析成 JSON，只点最大的那个缺口，只给一条调整。
skills.why_zh: 「一次只动一根杠杆」被写成硬规则：没有触发行就说「本周无需调整」，不为了显得有用而改方案。
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己在正文里写了外部效度短板：支撑间歇性限能的 MATADOR 与 Seimon 试验做的是肥胖人群，不是已经接近目标体脂的瘦人。方案假定健康成年人，周亏空必须落在 2000–4000 kcal；睡眠长期低于 7 小时时先标记睡眠，暂不调整饮食与训练。
skills.title_en: A recomp coach that recomputes your calories from the grams
skills.tagline_en: 5:2 fasting with carb cycling — the hard part was never the plan, it is the drift. It parses each daily log into JSON, names the single largest gap, and prescribes exactly one change.
skills.why_en: One lever at a time is a hard rule. With no trigger row met it says "hold, no change indicated" rather than adjusting something so it looks useful.
skills.limit_en: The author writes the external-validity gap into the file himself: the MATADOR and Seimon trials behind intermittent restriction were run in people with obesity, not lean people near target body fat. It assumes a healthy adult, keeps the weekly deficit in a 2,000–4,000 kcal band, and when sleep is chronically under seven hours it flags sleep first and holds all diet and training changes.

skills.name: human-allegory-engine
skills.title_zh: 禁止「结尾再掏出一件磨损物件」的荒诞超短篇写手
skills.tagline_zh: 模型写小小说总是同一套：领导宣布、众人执行、底层受苦，最后老人落泪。它把这些列成模板清单，撞上就强制换两个维度重写。
skills.why_zh: 它拒绝模仿任何具体作家的文风，只把这类要求翻译成冷幽默、荒诞因果、留白这些可迁移的技法。
skills.limit_zh: 只写中文超短篇，成稿上限 3000 字。默认只输出标题和正文，不给「寓意」「落点」「创作说明」和自评，要技法解释得另外开口。作者划的线还包括：不把真实个人或机构写成加害者，不用地域、职业、贫困、残障做快捷笑点，不为煽情临时添加死亡与重病。
skills.title_en: The absurdist flash-fiction writer banned from ending on a worn object
skills.tagline_en: Models write the same parable every time: an order comes down, everyone complies, the poor pay, an old man weeps. This lists those beats as a template checklist and forces two dimensions to change on a hit.
skills.why_en: It refuses to imitate any named author's voice, translating such requests into transferable craft instead — deadpan, absurd causality, restraint at the close.
skills.limit_en: Chinese flash fiction only, capped at 3,000 characters. It outputs a title and the story and nothing else — no moral, no craft notes, no self-assessment unless asked. The author's own lines: no real person or institution cast as the perpetrator; no shortcut jokes off region, occupation, poverty or disability; no death or serious illness added late to land an emotional hit.

skills.name: pollen-query
skills.title_zh: 花粉季出门前查一眼，53 城都有
skills.tagline_zh: 三四月对过敏的人是渡劫，而多数天气 app 根本不报花粉。它拉中国天气网的监测站数据，给浓度等级、风险提示和 7 天历史加预报。
skills.why_zh: 仅依赖 Python 标准库，不装任何第三方包；备用数据源和主源分得清清楚楚，拿不到就说拿不到，不拿备用的扩散指数冒充浓度值。
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖 53 个有监测站的城市，小城市没有数据。非花粉季会显示「暂无」，个别日期无数据是正常现象。备用源给的是扩散指数不是浓度值，两者不能混着读。
skills.tagline_en: Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.
skills.why_en: Standard library only, nothing to install; the fallback source is kept clearly separate from the primary one, and when data is missing it says so rather than passing off a dispersal index as a concentration.
skills.limit_en: Only the 53 cities with monitoring stations; smaller cities have no data. Out of season it reports none, and gaps on individual days are normal. The fallback gives a dispersal index, not a concentration — don't read them as the same number. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Check pollen before you go out, 53 cities

skills.name: remotion-video
skills.title_zh: 用 React 代码做视频
skills.tagline_zh: 改一句话就要重剪一遍视频，谁受得了？把视频写成 React 组件后，改一行参数整片重渲染，动画、字幕、音乐可视化全都能版本控制。
skills.tagline_en: Programmatic video with Remotion — content defined as React components, covering animation, subtitles and music visualization; change a param, re-render the whole film.
skills.desc_en: 使用 Remotion 框架以编程方式创建视频。Remotion 让你用 React 组件定义视频内容，支持动画、字幕、音乐可视化等。 触发词： - "用代码做视频"、"编程视频"、"React 视频" - "Remotion"、"remotion" - "/remotion-video" 适用场景： - 程序化视频：(1) 批量生成 (2) 数据驱动（如年度总结）(3) 音乐可视化 (4) 自动字幕 - 教程讲解视频：(5) 技术概念可视化（如 CNN、算法）(6) 分层递进讲解 (7) AI 配音教程 - 3D 视频：(8) 产品展示/模型动画 (9) 卡通角色讲解 (10) 3D 数据可视化 (11) Logo 动画
skills.why_zh: 视频变成可版本控制的代码，是「AI 做视频」里最扎实的一路；和店里的 HyperFrames 同哲学，一个 React 一个 HTML。
skills.why_en: Video as version-controlled code — the most solid school of AI video, sharing a philosophy with our HyperFrames pick: one in React, one in HTML.
skills.limit_zh: 本机要有 Node 起 Remotion 工程、Python 跑配音脚本。配音首选 MiniMax，要 API key 且按字符计费，没有就退 Edge TTS 固定音色。3D 受浏览器 8-16 个 WebGL 上下文上限。
skills.limit_en: Needs Node for the Remotion project and Python for the audio scripts. Narration prefers MiniMax TTS: an API key plus per-character billing, else it drops to Edge TTS fixed voices. 3D is capped by the browser's 8-16 WebGL contexts.
skills.title_en: Change one parameter, re-render the whole film

skills.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 给中文文章画手绘感解释图
skills.tagline_zh: 写完文章配图最头疼：截图太丑、AI 插画太飘。它专画流程、结构、隐喻——16:9 白底手绘，少量红橙蓝批注，一篇文章配下来像一个人画的。
skills.tagline_en: Ian-style illustrations for Chinese article bodies — 16:9 hand-drawn on white with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, built for processes, structures, metaphors and arguments.
skills.desc_en: 生成 Ian 风格的中文正文配图。用于用户要求为中文文章、帖子、博客、Notion 文档、工作流文档、方法论、流程、结构、状态、隐喻或观点生成“怪诞”“小黑”“手绘”“正文配图”“文章插图”“配图建议”“shot list”“去标题/改图”等任务；默认使用小黑 IP、纯白手绘、少量红橙蓝批注、简洁清爽但天马行空的视觉风格。
skills.why_zh: 「单一明确风格」的典范：不给你一堆选项，一种腔调做到底，所以全篇视觉统一。
skills.why_en: A model of committing to one look: no menu of options, one voice held all the way through, which is why a whole article stays visually coherent.
skills.limit_zh: 出图靠宿主内置的 image_gen，没这条能力就画不了。风格锁死 16:9、纯白底、小黑当主体，不给第二种选。图上中文批注由模型写，正文把错字严重列进重生成条件。
skills.limit_en: Rendering needs the host's built-in `image_gen`. The look is locked: 16:9, white ground, Xiaohei as the actor, no alternatives. The Chinese annotations are drawn by the model, and its QA list makes bad characters grounds for a re-roll.
skills.title_en: Article diagrams that look like one hand drew them

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 把一个模糊主题做成深度调研报告
skills.tagline_zh: 想调研一个话题，AI 却给你一篇维基摘要？这套八步法逼它先拆问题再找料，产出的是能拿去做决策的报告，不是概述。
skills.tagline_en: Wang Shuyi's eight-step research methodology — turns a vague topic into a high-quality research report; "research this for me" triggers it.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研方法论（8步法）：将模糊主题转化为高质量调研报告。 触发词：/deep-research、深度调研、帮我调研、调研一下、对比分析 注意：如果用户需要的是可视化图谱而非报告，请使用 research-to-diagram skill。
skills.why_zh: 作者高校教师出身、常年教研究方法，这八步是真在带学生做研究时用的那套，不是拍脑袋编的流程。
skills.why_en: By a university teacher who has taught research method for years — these eight steps come from actually supervising research, not from a whiteboard.

install.note_zh: 两件不同的 skill 在 frontmatter 里都叫 deep-research —— 生态是扁平命名空间，同名就会互相静默覆盖。这里加了作者前缀消歧，跟作者仓库里的原名不一致是故意的。

skills.limit_zh: 产物写死在 ~/Downloads/research/<主题>/，打包成 ~/outcome.tar.gz。Step 6.5 硬卡：必须另起独立 Agent 复核事实与推导，派不出子代理就卡住。全程靠 WebSearch。
skills.limit_en: Working dir is hardcoded to ~/Downloads/research/<topic>/, packed into ~/outcome.tar.gz. Step 6.5 is BLOCKING: a separate Agent must audit the fact cards and reasoning, so no sub-agent means no report. Needs live WebSearch.
skills.title_en: The eight steps a research supervisor actually uses

skills.name: research-to-diagram
skills.title_zh: 调研完自动画成知识关系图 PDF
skills.tagline_zh: 研究做完还得画图讲给别人听——这步最烦。给它一个主题，它联网调研、整理、直接输出专业关系图谱 PDF，一步到位。
skills.tagline_en: Give it a topic: it researches online, organizes the findings, and outputs a professional knowledge-relationship diagram as PDF, end to end.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研主题并自动生成知识关系图谱PDF。接收研究主题后自动进行网络调研、信息收集、知识整理，最终生成专业的可视化关系图谱。适用于"研究...并做图"、"深度分析...并可视化"、"生成知识图谱"等场景。
skills.why_zh: 「调研完还得画图」是研究者的隐性负担，它把两步接成一步，产物是能放进正式文档的 PDF。
skills.why_en: Researchers quietly carry the burden of diagramming after research; this fuses both steps and ships a PDF you can put in a real document.
skills.limit_zh: 得本机装 Graphviz（正文只给 macOS 的 brew 装法），并依赖 Claude Code 内置 WebSearch。中文全靠 Arial Unicode MS 字体，缺了乱码。产物默认写到 ~/Downloads/。
skills.limit_en: Requires local Graphviz (the doc only gives the macOS brew line) and Claude Code's built-in WebSearch. Chinese labels depend on the Arial Unicode MS font or render as tofu. Caps at ~50 nodes per graph; writes to ~/Downloads/.
skills.title_en: Ends with the diagram everyone dreads drawing

skills.name: zettel-builder
skills.title_zh: 把零散笔记养成会提醒你写文的卡片库
skills.tagline_zh: 笔记越存越多，却从没变成一篇文章。它把笔记消化成原子卡、按你的话重述、自动连线，还定期告诉你：这几张已经攒够写一篇了。
skills.tagline_en: A bottom-up Zettelkasten that digests notes, published pieces and saved material into atomic cards — restated in your own terms, auto-linked, with periodic checks for clusters ripe enough to become an article.
skills.desc_en: 自底向上生长的 Zettelkasten 卡片笔记系统。从笔记/已发表文章/收藏素材持续消化为原子卡, 用户价值观重述,自动链接,周期性巡检文章就绪簇,缺口处可调 deep-research 补卡。 与"自顶向下选题"或"长文写作 Skill"不重叠:那些是"等到要写时再生产",本 skill 是"素材进来就长卡"。 触发词: - "/zettel"、"/zettel-builder" - "卡片笔记"、"zettelkasten"、"原子卡"、"二级大脑" - "巡检卡片"、"长出来一篇"、"卡片就绪了吗" - "把这段切卡"、"做成卡片" 四种模式(由用户调用语义路由): - ingest:把指定素材(文本/路径/URL/本会话片段)切原子卡 → 价值观重述 → 候选链接 - scan:消化 _queue/ 里 mechanical scan 积累的 llm-wiki 新增素材 - i
skills.why_zh: 「巡检文章就绪簇」是灵魂：大多数笔记系统只管存，它管「什么时候该动笔」。
skills.why_en: Flagging article-ready clusters is the soul of it — most note systems only store; this one tells you when it's time to write.
skills.limit_zh: 路径写死作者的 ~/zettel、~/wiki、~/Dropbox；卡片仓得是能 push 的 git 仓，调度靠 systemd 与 OpenClaw cron。它不写文章，只把就绪簇交给你自己的写作 skill。
skills.limit_en: Paths are hardcoded to the author's ~/zettel, ~/wiki and ~/Dropbox; the vault must be a pushable git repo, with scheduling on systemd, OpenClaw cron and Telegram. It never drafts — Mode 4 hands the cluster to your own writing skill.
skills.title_en: The note pile that tells you when to write

skills.name: guizang-material-illustration
skills.title_zh: 生成有材质感的解释图和文章配图
skills.tagline_zh: 解释性配图最难两全：准确的往往丑，好看的往往说不清。歸藏这套专攻这一点——材质质感 + 文字标注，一眼看懂还挺好看。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory diagrams and chart beautification — the article visuals that are both instantly legible and good-looking.
skills.desc_en: Generate Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory visuals, material-styled chart illustrations, and data-first editorial images from articles, notes, product concepts, workplace reports, creator posts, tutorials, school materials, humanities topics, science explanations, screenshots, or chart data. Use when the user asks for 配图, 带字插图, 解释图, 图解插画, 概念拆解图, 图表美化, 数据图美化, 3D 图表, 汇报配图, 内容
skills.why_zh: 作者是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，审美有背书——这类东西的价值全在挑图那双眼睛。
skills.why_en: The author is a leading Chinese voice on AI design; with work like this the value sits entirely in the eye doing the picking.
skills.limit_zh: 只做插图这一层：小红书/公众号卡片和 PPT 版式要另配社交卡片、PPT 两件 skill。要有 imagegen 或内置生图。图内标签压到 2-5 字，模型中文写不好就只能再删字。产物默认落在 local-tests/<slug>/。
skills.limit_en: The illustration layer only - card composition and slide layout go to the separate social-card and PPT skills. Needs imagegen or a built-in image tool. In-image labels cap at 2-5 Chinese characters. Output lands in local-tests/<slug>/.
skills.title_en: Explainer diagrams with texture you can almost feel

skills.name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-3
skills.title_zh: 把一句话变成极简杂志感海报
skills.tagline_zh: 想给文章配张有格调的图，AI 却总给你花里胡哨那种？它只做一件事：大留白、一处小拼贴、一个色彩重音，出的是编辑部的克制。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
skills.desc_en: Generate or analyze poetic paper-texture minimal zine posters with large negative space, a small editorial collage or visual anchor, experimental typography, and one clear color accent. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, article, mood, object, photo, content brief, reference images, or an image folder and wants a final poster image, a production-ready image prompt, reusable style rules, or
skills.why_zh: 稀有在它卖「克制」——这是提示词最难稳定复现的高级感。带 evals 自测集，作者真在维护风格一致性。
skills.why_en: Rare in that what it sells is restraint — the hardest thing for a prompt to reproduce reliably. It ships an eval set, so the author is actually maintaining that consistency.
skills.limit_zh: 得有内置生图工具，靠 referenced_image_paths 或最多 5 张会话内图片传参。只出竖版留白纸感海报这一种形态；海报上的字必须短，长文案生图模型会写糊。保真失败只重生成一次，还不像就直说没做到。
skills.limit_en: Needs a built-in image tool, fed by referenced_image_paths or at most five in-session images. One form only: vertical, paper-textured, heavy negative space. Keep poster text short — image models garble long copy. On a fidelity miss it regenerates once, then says outright that it failed.
skills.title_en: Mostly empty posters, backed by an eval set

skills.name: ai-short-drama
skills.title_zh: 从零做一集 AI 短剧
skills.tagline_zh: 短剧是眼下最猛的内容形态，但一个人搞不定编剧+分镜+成片。它把这条流水线拆成能一步步走完的活。
skills.tagline_en: From hit radar to episode hooks, it crafts your binge-worthy series bible—keeps characters consistent and writes.
skills.desc_en: 設計、編劇、製作與迭代爆款 AI 短劇／漫劇／仿真人直式連載。用於「AI短劇」「AI漫劇」「爽劇」「微短劇」「假廢物真強者」「扮豬吃虎」「重生」「轉生／穿越」「系統流」「隱藏大佬／隱藏身份」「逆襲／打臉／復仇」「真假千金」「末世」「修仙」「規則怪談」「ReelShort／DramaBox 風」「分集大綱」「每集鉤子」「季節拍」「短劇角色一致性」「把小說改短劇」「短劇為什麼不爆」「規劃一季／寫下一集」「從故事到AI成片」「一鍵做短劇」「100%自動化」「全部你來」等任務。負責題材雷達、概念綠燈、系列 Bible、爽點與揭露階梯、分集編劇、連載狀態、production pack、可續跑生成、成片 QA 與成效回填；實際媒體提示詞交給 ai-media-generator，完整剪輯交付可串接 video-autopilot 或相容執行器。
skills.why_zh: 体量不大但路子对，适合先试水短剧的人；要成体系的还得看更完整的方案。
skills.why_en: It closes the loop from writing to QA to feedback, auto-maintains character consistency, and can continue the whole season—not.
skills.limit_zh: 正文全繁体。它只产故事和 production pack，图片视频归未附带的 ai-media-generator；没装 video-autopilot 就只能标 waiting_for_executor，明令不许声称已出成片。
skills.limit_en: Traditional Chinese throughout. It owns story and the production pack only; media belongs to the separate ai-media-generator. Without video-autopilot it must mark the run `waiting_for_executor` and may not claim a finished cut.
skills.title_en: A short-drama writers' room with a QA pass

skills.name: 风格包
skills.title_zh: 从参考图提取可复用的视觉风格包
skills.tagline_zh: 看到一个喜欢的画面，想把那股味道复用到自己的东西上——但说不清它到底哪里对。它拆出 10 色标注色卡和风格参数，把感觉变成能交付的东西。
skills.tagline_en: Extracts reusable visual style DNA from reference images, film stills or video frames — always emitting a labeled ten-color palette plus a flat version, packaged as a style pack.
skills.desc_en: 从一组参考图、电影剧照、视频截图或用户给定文件夹中提取可复用的视觉风格 DNA，打包成中文风格包；提取模式强制为每个视觉分组同时生成统一 10 色标注色卡和完全无文字纯色色卡，并生成两套色卡总览与可复用色值 JSON。也可读取已有风格包的 design.md 和提示词模板，把剧本、脚本表格或创意需求拆成文生图提示词 + 视频提示词表格文档。触发词包括“风格包”“提取某电影风格包”“按这个风格包生成提示词”“读取这个文件夹的风格 DNA”“用风格包拆剧本”“生成色卡”“生成文生图和视频提示词表格”。核心原则：只参考视觉语法，绝对避免场景和元素雷同。
skills.why_zh: 强制输出带标注色卡和纯色版，这一步让「风格」从形容词变成可传递的资产。
skills.why_en: "I love this look, make my stuff feel like it" is a real recurring need; this converts a vibe into deliverable palettes and parameters.
skills.limit_zh: 色卡是硬交付，靠 generate_palette_cards.py 和 validate_palette_cards.py 两个 Python 脚本产出，缺依赖就得报阻塞。提取模式必须有真实参考图，产出全中文。
skills.limit_en: Palette cards are a hard deliverable from two Python scripts (generate_palette_cards.py, validate_palette_cards.py); a missing dependency must be reported as a blocker. Extraction requires real reference images, and output is Chinese.
skills.title_en: Turns "I love this look" into ten labeled colors

skills.name: qiaomu-learning
skills.title_zh: 用一问一答逼你自己想明白
skills.tagline_zh: AI 直接给答案，学的时候最爽、也最没用。丢一份教材、截图或一道题给它，它一次只问一个问题，带你自己推出来。
skills.tagline_en: Turns textbooks, screenshots, PDFs, notes or a single problem into a question-by-question derivation — one question at a time, making you reason it out instead of handing over answers.
skills.desc_en: 用苏格拉底式逐问学习把教材、截图、PDF、笔记、题目或一个主题变成主动推导对话。Use when the learner明确要求“苏格拉底式学习”“逐问带我学”“一次只问一个问题”“先别告诉我答案”“边问边引导我推出来”、interactive quiz、active recall or question-led tutoring。宽泛主题默认先进入关键词定向：列出 12 个关键词及白话解释，推荐专家和专业书籍，并提供“扩展关键词”的入口，再让学习者选起点。正式学习中每个活跃回合只问一个简短、可回答的问题，并根据学习者上一步的推理调整难度；回答要接住学习者原话，像真人老师一样温和纠错，并在数学、物理、流程或图形内容中用累积黑板逐步画出推理。学习者说“太抽象”“不理解”“想象不出来”“枯燥”或要求图解，且当前台阶可视觉化时，必须立即切换为问题承载型图示并提供文字替代，空间、相对运动、流程和几
skills.why_zh: AI 毁掉学习的最快方式就是给答案；「一次只问一个」这条硬约束正是解药。乔木出品。
skills.why_en: The fastest way AI ruins learning is handing over answers; the one-question-at-a-time constraint is exactly the antidote.
skills.limit_zh: 得你点名要苏格拉底式、一次一问才触发，你说「直接告诉我」它立刻退出。宽泛主题固定列 12 个关键词，写明是硬契约。配图靠 Codex 内置生图，没有就退回 ASCII 和坐标草图。
skills.limit_en: Only triggers when you explicitly ask for Socratic one-question-at-a-time tutoring, and exits the moment you say "just tell me". Broad topics always get exactly 12 keywords, a declared hard contract. Visuals need Codex image generation.
skills.title_en: The tutor that refuses to give you the answer

skills.name: unlazy
skills.title_zh: 逼 agent 干完重活别糊弄
skills.tagline_zh: 长任务做到一半开始偷懒、「差不多就这样吧」是通病。深度树把任务分层拆开，每层必须做完才准往上收。
skills.tagline_en: An anti-laziness discipline for substantial work — the Depth Tree method splits a task into layers, each of which must be finished before rolling up. No more "good enough, I guess".
skills.desc_en: Anti-laziness execution discipline for substantial tasks. Use when work keeps coming back half done, when an agent reports done before it is done, when output must be exhaustive rather than fast, on long autonomous runs that tend to stall at 80 percent, or on any invocation like /unlazy, "tree N", "gates", or "do not stop until it is done". v2 enforces completion through gate files and runnable ch
skills.why_zh: 把「分层且必须完成」变成硬纪律，比反复叮嘱它认真干有效得多。
skills.why_en: Agents start cutting corners mid-task; enforcing layered completion beats repeatedly telling them to try harder.
skills.limit_zh: 闸门校验要 Node 跑 scripts/gate-check.mjs；真把话说死的 Stop 钩子只在 Claude Code 有，还必须先问你才装。作者自己划线：闲聊、一行改动、半小时以内的活别用；编排模式要开得出子 agent。
skills.limit_en: Gate checks run node scripts/gate-check.mjs. The Stop hook that blocks an early finish is Claude Code only and must be offered, never installed silently. The author excludes chat, trivial edits and under-30-minute work.
skills.title_en: Stops the agent from settling for "good enough"

skills.name: moonlit-book-workflow
skills.title_zh: 给自家孩子做一本带家长配音的绘本
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子想听独属于他的故事。12 页英文绘本，固定水彩画风 + 角色设定图保证每页都是同一个小孩，再用你自己的声音朗读，出一个能直接发出去的文件。
skills.tagline_en: Makes a 12-page personalized English picture book for your kid — a fixed watercolor house style plus a per-book character sheet keeps the child looking like the same character across all pages, narrated in a parent's own cloned voice, shipped as one sendable HTML file.
skills.desc_en: Build or resume a reusable 12-page personalized English picture book in a fixed watercolor house style, with a per-book character sheet for illustration consistency and local authorized-adult voice cloning for narration.
skills.why_zh: 难点它都啃了：AI 插画最容易每页换个人，它用画风锚点+角色设定图锁死；声音只收成人授权音、监护人确认才继续，私密音频永不进成品。限 Apple Silicon + Codex，本地模型约 3.2G。
skills.why_en: It solves the hard parts: AI illustration usually drifts into a different-looking child each page, so it locks consistency with a style anchor plus a character sheet; voice cloning accepts only authorized adult recordings with guardian checkpoints, and private audio never ships in the output. Apple Silicon Mac + Codex only, ~3.2GB local model.
skills.limit_zh: 出的是英文绘本，中文得自己再转一道。要调生图模型和 TTS，成本随页数走；风格靠 style key 加角色设定图锁住，改任一项就得整本重生成。
skills.limit_en: It produces an English picture book — Chinese needs another pass. Costs scale with pages since it calls an image model and TTS; changing the style key or character sheet forces a full regeneration.
skills.title_en: A bedtime book read in your own cloned voice

skills.name: fit-ride-studio
skills.title_zh: 读懂运动手表导出的轨迹数据
skills.tagline_zh: 手表导出一堆 FIT/KML 文件，多数人看不懂也懒得看。它把功率、心率、爬升、配速逐段拆开，还出可视化路书。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes cycling, running and hiking FIT/KML tracks — power, heart rate, elevation and pacing broken down segment by segment, with visual route reports.
skills.desc_en: Analyze one or more cycling, running, or hiking FIT/KML activity tracks, generate evidence-based single or aggregate reports, open the bundled local Ride Relief report page when the environment supports it, enrich results with user-confirmed public location context, and create shareable PNG or H.264 MP4 route stories on request. Use whenever a user wants to analyze, compare, visualize, or export .
skills.why_zh: 把一墙传感器读数翻译成「这趟骑得怎么样」，骑行跑步徒步都能用。
skills.why_en: Most people never decode their watch exports; this translates a wall of sensor data into "how was that ride, really".
skills.limit_zh: 只吃 FIT/KML，纯几何 KML 连时长、配速、停顿都不推。要 Node 跑 npm ci，报告页固定在本机 5174 端口，远程或云端浏览器够不着就只剩文字报告。也不给 FTP、心率区间、VO₂max。
skills.limit_en: FIT/KML only, and a geometry-only KML yields no duration, pace or pauses. Needs Node and npm ci in a writable skill dir; the report page is pinned to localhost:5174, so remote agents get text only. It won't invent FTP, HR zones or VO2max.
skills.title_en: Turns a FIT file into how the ride went

skills.name: interactive-map-builder
skills.title_zh: 把地点数据变成可交互的网页地图
skills.tagline_zh: 做旅行攻略、门店分布、活动路线，最后总卡在「怎么做一张能点的地图」。给它数据，它出一个能直接发的交互地图。
skills.tagline_en: Turn Excel coords into a searchable, filterable map—single HTML file, paper-ready SVG/PDF, even non-coders can.
skills.desc_en: Turn existing spatial or coordinate data into portable, browser-openable interactive map files and report-ready figures. Use when the user wants parcels, buildings, facilities, parking, roads, water, green space, projects, or Excel/CSV coordinates presented as a searchable, filterable, sortable map, map-and-list page, multilayer planning map, single-file HTML, slide image, or paper SVG/PDF—even wh
skills.why_zh: 输出是自包含网页而不是截图，能发能嵌；这类需求高频但少有现成解。
skills.why_en: Unlike static-only tools or server-dependent apps, it outputs a self-contained HTML with layers and filters—double-click to use.
skills.limit_zh: 只接已有坐标或几何：地理编码、缓冲叠加、路径规划、3D 一概不做，缺 CRS 直接失败、不替你猜。要先 pip 装它的 Python 包，每次调用先联网跑一次版本 preflight，自动分类配色最多 8 类。
skills.limit_en: Takes existing coordinates or geometry only: no geocoding, buffers, routing or 3D, and a missing CRS fails hard instead of being guessed. You pip-install its Python package, every run opens with an online update preflight.
skills.title_en: A spreadsheet of coordinates, out as one HTML map

skills.name: nx-matting
skills.title_zh: 本地一键抠图，图片视频都能抠
skills.tagline_zh: 抠图工具要么要上传隐私图、要么按张收费。它用本地 BiRefNet 模型跑，输出透明底，素材不出你的机器。
skills.tagline_en: Local BiRefNet matting for images & video, outputting transparent PNG/MOV/WebM. No Python, no GPU, just drop and.
skills.desc_en: 使用本地 BiRefNet GGUF 模型完成图片或视频抠图、人物抠图、主体分割和背景移除，并输出透明 PNG、MOV 或 WebM。适用于用户提到图片抠图、照片去背景、人像透明图、视频抠图、透明视频、BiRefNet、JPG/PNG/BMP/WebP 图片，或 MP4/MOV/WebM 视频的场景；无需 Python、PyTorch 或 CUDA。
skills.why_zh: 星不多但胜在纯本地：碰产品图、人像这类不该外传的素材时，比精度更值钱。
skills.why_en: No setup, no GPU, transparent video output—runs locally, so your files never leave your machine.
skills.limit_zh: 明写只支持 Windows x64 + PowerShell，Mac/Linux 跑不起来。首次联网从魔搭下 63.2MB 运行时和 88.6MB 模型（Full 约 440MB）。每次结果还必须原样贴出作者的加微信提示。
skills.limit_en: Frontmatter states Windows x64 + PowerShell only — Mac and Linux cannot run it. First use pulls a 63.2MB runtime plus an 88.6MB model from ModelScope (Full ~440MB). Every reply must reproduce the author's WeChat contact notice.
skills.title_en: Cuts out video backgrounds without a GPU

skills.name: hyperframes-motion-director
skills.title_zh: 从一份提纲导出中文电影感短片
skills.tagline_zh: HyperFrames 官方件对中文排版水土不服：字挤、断行难看、字幕节奏不对。这件专治，中文优先重调了排版和镜头语言。
skills.tagline_en: A Chinese-first HyperFrames motion director — outline in, cinematic short out, with typography, caption rhythm and camera language tuned for Chinese content.
skills.desc_en: Direct and produce Chinese-first cinematic motion videos with HyperFrames. Use this skill when the user wants a rendered promo film, article-to-video piece, product launch film, website-to-video piece, keynote reveal, kinetic typography sequence, text/icon transition promo, music-synced motion graphic, HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP video, short-form vertical video, or a landing page/product story turned into
skills.why_zh: 作者是 md2wechat 那位（已在架的中文精品作者），补的正是官方件在中文场景的短板。
skills.why_en: By the author of md2wechat (already on our shelves) — the official skills stumble on Chinese typography; this one fixes exactly that.
skills.limit_zh: 要本机的 HyperFrames CLI 和 Node 脚本，配图走 Codex Image Gen，终版渲染要 Docker。第一阶段只交一份提案就停，你不点头它不动工；默认只出 10-15 秒竖屏 1080x1920。
skills.limit_en: Needs a local HyperFrames CLI, Node scripts, Codex Image Gen for stills, Docker for the final render. Phase 1 stops at a written proposal until you confirm. Defaults to 10-15s vertical 1080x1920.
skills.title_en: Fixes the Chinese typography the official tools break

skills.name: human-writing
skills.title_zh: 让中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写的中文一眼能认出来：套话、排比、什么都对但没人味。它不做关键词黑名单，而是立一个「见过事、查过料」的人的口吻。
skills.tagline_en: Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.
skills.desc_en: 通用中文创作与改稿 Skill。用于知乎回答、论坛长帖、公众号文章、博客、评论、人物故事、历史叙事、新闻与行业解读、科普、教程、评测、个人叙事、小说、故事、对白、口播和演讲稿。默认写成一个见过事、查过材料、愿意把来龙去脉讲清楚的人在说话，重点保留中文互联网长回答与长帖的活人感和自然中文韵律，避免空泛的机构腔、喊口号式演说腔、营销腔和模型腔。非虚构长文先检查材料够不够，材料不足时研究、追问或缩短，绝不用重复解释灌字数。现实内容额外核验事实、引语、数据与用户亲历，虚构内容可以创造人物、场景、对白、心理与情节。成稿正文严禁冒号、破折号、“不是……而是……”及同类翻案句，并清除商业黑话和模型惯用黑话。不创建作者画像、个人规则库或个人写作 Skill。
skills.why_zh: 立人设比删 AI 词高一档——前者管句式和视角，后者只换词。中文原创，不是译过来的。
skills.why_en: Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.
skills.limit_zh: 非虚构材料列不满五件就不给你写长稿，最多交六百字。破折号、提示性冒号、「不是A而是B」这类句式一概封死，风格上没得商量。check_prose.py 只查已写明的硬禁项。
skills.limit_en: If a nonfiction piece cannot list five concrete pieces of material, it refuses to write long and caps you near 600 characters. Em dashes, signposting colons and "not A but B" framing are banned. check_prose.py checks hard bans only.
skills.title_en: Installs a voice instead of banning AI words

skills.name: handdraw-good-deed-story
skills.title_zh: 批量做黑白线条逐笔显影的竖屏短片
skills.tagline_zh: 这种「线条一笔笔画出来」的短片在中文平台很吃香，难点是量产还不失手作感。35~45 秒一条，讲一个善行小故事。
skills.tagline_en: Batch-produces 35–45s vertical hand-drawn story shorts — black-line reveal animation telling a small good-deed tale, handmade feel at scale.
skills.desc_en: Batch-produce 35–45 second vertical hand-drawn good-deed story videos with black line art revealed left to right and aligned low-saturation color filling in the same direction. Use for Chinese warm-story shorts, gradual line-art coloring videos, reusable eight-beat story templates, or HyperFrames delivery of this visual format.
skills.why_zh: 它把这条产线固化了，批量出片仍保留手绘质感——这正是同类工具最容易丢掉的东西。
skills.why_en: Line-reveal shorts perform well on Chinese platforms; the trick is scaling without losing the handmade texture, and this pins that pipeline down.
skills.limit_zh: 线稿由 scripts/make_lineart.py 从彩图反推，成片靠 HyperFrames 和手拷进去的 gsap.min.js。每拍母图逐张生成，禁止自动重试。规格写死 720×960、8 拍 40 秒，BGM 你自己找授权。
skills.limit_en: Line art comes from scripts/make_lineart.py off the same color image; rendering needs HyperFrames plus gsap.min.js copied in from npm by hand. One mother image per beat, retries forbidden. Locked to 720x960, 8 beats, ~40s; BGM is on you.
