skills.title_en: Vertical shorts drawn line by line, made in batches

skills.name: qiaomu-cut
skills.title_zh: 做可复现可验收的视频剪辑工程
skills.tagline_zh: AI 剪的视频改一版就得重新抽卡，交付时也说不清素材哪来的。它做素材治理、双语字幕、品牌包装，每步留痕，重跑结果不变。
skills.tagline_en: Turns a one-line brief into a reproducible, reviewable video project — governed sourcing, bilingual subtitles, brand packaging and traceable renders.
skills.desc_en: 把一句话需求转成可复现、可验收视频工程的乔木智能剪辑导演。Use when the user asks to create, plan, edit, remix, explain, narrate, subtitle, animate, composite, or render a video; build English-learning movie mixes, person profiles, explainers, product launch videos, cinematic shorts, social clips, course/PPT videos, AI image/video/TTS/music-assisted stories, stock-footage stories, or multi-source montage. Routes across 33台词, C
skills.why_zh: 「可复现 + 可验收」在 AI 视频里很少见：改一版不用碰运气，交付时每一帧都有出处。
skills.why_en: Reproducible and reviewable are rare words in AI video — revisions don't re-roll the dice, and you can account for every frame.
skills.limit_zh: 渲染要 ffmpeg-full，随附的安装脚本只写了 macOS 和 Homebrew。台词库与 ListenHub 各要自己单独装的 CLI，还会耗积分。片尾硬性带「向阳乔木」和 @vista8，规则里不许省。
skills.limit_en: Rendering needs ffmpeg-full and the bundled bootstrap script is Homebrew/macOS only. The movie-line search and ListenHub each need their own separately installed CLI and burn credits. Every outro must carry the author's name and @vista8.
skills.title_en: Video edits that don't re-roll the dice

skills.name: darwin-skill
skills.title_zh: 让你写的 skill 自己迭代变强
skills.tagline_zh: skill 写完就定死了，好不好用只能凭感觉。它跑「评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚」的闭环，改坏了自己退回去，2.0 还接了微软研究院的九维评测。
skills.tagline_en: An autonomous skill optimizer running evaluate → improve → test → keep-or-rollback, with Microsoft Research's nine-dimension SkillLens wired into v2.0.
skills.desc_en: Darwin Skill 2.0 (达尔文.skill 2.0): autonomous skill optimizer, v2.0 integrates Microsoft Research SkillLens (arXiv 2605.23899) 9-dim rubric + SkillOpt (arXiv 2605.23904) validation-gated design + human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Evaluates SKILL.md files using a 9-dimension rubric (structure + effectiveness + meta-skill blacklists), runs hill-climbing with git version control, spawns independent judge
skills.why_zh: 带回滚的进化循环才算真自动优化；接学术评测体系这一步说明作者不是随口说进化。
skills.why_en: An evolution loop with rollback is real self-optimization — a bad change reverts itself; wiring in an academic eval suite shows the author means it.
skills.limit_zh: 保留还是回滚要 spawn 三个独立 judge 做配对比较，跑不了子 agent 就退成干跑，作者自己写明干跑超 30% 评估即失效。它在 git 分支上直接改你的 SKILL.md，每支改完都停下等你点头。
skills.limit_en: Keep-or-revert needs three independent judge subagents doing paired comparison; with no subagents it falls back to dry runs, which the author says invalidate scoring past 30%. It edits your SKILL.md on a git branch and halts for sign-off.
skills.title_en: The skill that rewrites itself, and rolls back

skills.name: travel-hacking-toolkit
skills.title_zh: 用现金里程积分四路比价找最省的飞法
skills.tagline_zh: 同一趟航线，行家和小白的票价能差几千块。它搜奖励座位、算兑换比、盯放票，把泡论坛才学得会的手艺自动化。
skills.tagline_en: Finds the cheapest way to fly across cash, points, miles and award tickets — searching award seats, computing redemption value and watching availability.
skills.desc_en: AI-powered travel hacking and search with cash, points, miles, and award flights. Drop-in skills and MCP servers for Cla
skills.why_zh: 里程兑换门道深、信息碎，这类知识差价最大——它把差价那部分变成了工具。
skills.why_en: Award travel is deep and fragmented — experts and novices can pay thousands apart for the same seat; this automates craft you'd otherwise learn on forums.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

skills.limit_zh: 48 件几乎全是欧美体系——美航、西南、Chase、Amex、Bilt、德铁、北欧铁路，一件亚洲航司或国内银行积分都没有。装法是 /plugin marketplace add；六个 MCP server 里 LiteAPI 那个要自己申请 key。
skills.limit_en: All 48 skills sit in the US/EU ecosystem — American, Southwest, Chase, Amex, Bilt, Deutsche Bahn — with no Asian carrier or Chinese bank program. Installs via /plugin marketplace add; of six MCP servers, LiteAPI needs your own key.
skills.title_en: The same seat, thousands apart in price

skills.name: hyperframes
skills.title_zh: 用写 HTML 的方式渲染出视频
skills.tagline_zh: 剪辑软件里改一版要重来一遍。HeyGen 这套把视频变成代码：动画、字幕、转场、配音全能写，改一帧不用重剪，还能进 git。
skills.tagline_en: HeyGen's video engine: write HTML, render finished video — built for agents, with 16 skills covering animation, captions, seams and voiceover.
skills.why_zh: 「AI 做视频」目前最扎实的一条路：视频成了可版本控制的代码，能精确改一帧，而不是对着黑箱重新抽卡。
skills.why_en: The most solid path yet for AI video — footage becomes version-controlled code an agent can edit frame-precisely, not a black box you re-roll.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

skills.limit_zh: 真正干活的是 npm 上的 hyperframes CLI（node ≥22），skill 只是给 agent 的调用说明。仓库 32 份 SKILL.md 只对应 26 个名字——.agents 和 .claude 底下那 6 件是 skills/ 的宿主副本。
skills.limit_en: The work is done by the hyperframes npm CLI (node ≥22); the skills are just agent-facing call notes. 32 SKILL.md files map to 26 names — the six under .agents and .claude are host copies of ones in skills/.
skills.title_en: Video you can diff instead of re-roll

skills.name: hyperframes-cli
skills.title_zh: 用命令行批量出片
skills.tagline_zh: 一条视频好做，一百条要命。init/add/capture/render 一条龙，把出片变成能脚本化的构建流程，重复劳动交给机器。
skills.tagline_en: The HyperFrames CLI dev loop — init, add, catalog, capture, lint and render; the backbone for batch production and automation.
skills.desc_en: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render fai
skills.why_zh: 榜单上 33.6 万安装那件。批量做内容的人靠它把「一条一条手工做」变成流水线。
skills.why_en: The 336K-install piece from the leaderboard — video as a scriptable build process, so batch creators hand repetition to the machine.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Node 22+ 和 FFmpeg。catalog 检索只认英文，中文查询直接零结果；语义那一档要先下 33MB 模型，默认不开。云渲染单项目上传上限 200MB，渲染前必须停下等你批准。
skills.limit_en: Needs Node 22+ and FFmpeg. Catalog search indexes English only — a Chinese query returns nothing; the meaning tier needs a 33MB download and is off by default. Cloud render caps upload at 200MB, and it pauses for approval before rendering.
skills.title_en: Video as a build process, lint step included

skills.name: huashu-nuwa
skills.title_zh: 把任何人的思维方式做成一个能装的 skill
skills.tagline_zh: 想让 AI 像某个高手那样思考，你却说不清他到底怎么想。给它一个名字，它自动深度调研、提炼决策框架，当场造出一个能用的人物 skill。
skills.tagline_en: Give it a name or even a vague need: it researches deeply, distills the mental framework, and mints a working persona skill on the spot.
skills.desc_en: 女娲造人：输入人名/主题/甚至只是模糊需求，自动深度调研→思维框架提炼→生成可运行的人物Skill。 两种入口：(1)明确人名→直接蒸馏 (2)模糊需求→诊断推荐→再蒸馏。 触发词：「造skill」「蒸馏XX」「女娲」「造人」「XX的思维方式」「做个XX视角」「更新XX的skill」。 模糊需求也触发：「我想提升决策质量」「有没有一种思维方式能帮我...」「我需要一个思维顾问」。 English triggers: "distill [person]", "nuwa", "create a [person] perspective skill", "how does [person] think", "I need a thinking advisor".
skills.why_zh: 店里的张雪峰、X 导师都是它造出来的——「用 skill 造 skill」这条路上目前最成气候的一个。
skills.why_en: Several skills on our own shelves came out of it — the most mature take yet on skills that build skills.
skills.limit_zh: 作者原话：顶级模型跑一次完整蒸馏可消耗数十美元；单次能累到 50 万 token，20 万窗口的模型得分三段会话续跑。知乎、微信公众号、百度百科被永久列入信息源黑名单。
skills.limit_en: The author's own number: a full distillation on a top model can burn tens of dollars and 500k+ tokens, so 200k-window models must split it across three sessions. Zhihu, WeChat public accounts and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources.
skills.title_en: Turns a person's thinking into an installable skill

skills.name: guizang-ppt-skill
skills.title_zh: 做能双屏演讲的网页版 PPT
skills.tagline_zh: 上台讲的时候最想要演讲者视图和观众屏同步，普通 AI 做的 PPT 一概没有。它出的是单文件网页 deck，带 WebGL 流体背景和章节幕封。
skills.tagline_en: Single-file web decks with WebGL fluid backgrounds, presenter view, audience-screen sync and chapter covers — in editorial-magazine or Swiss-international styles.
skills.desc_en: 生成横向翻页网页 PPT（单 HTML 文件），含 WebGL 背景、演讲者视图、观众屏同步、讲稿备注、章节幕封、数据大字报、图片网格等模板。提供两种风格：① "电子杂志 × 电子墨水"（衬线 + 流体背景 + 暖色） ② "瑞士国际主义"（无衬线 + 网格点阵 + IKB/柠檬黄/柠檬绿/安全橙高亮）。当用户需要制作分享 / 演讲 / 发布会风格的网页 PPT，或提到"杂志风 PPT"、"瑞士风 PPT"、"Swiss Style"、"horizontal swipe deck"时使用。
skills.why_zh: 演讲者视图和双屏同步这种细节，市面上的 AI PPT 工具基本没人做，歸藏把它塞进了一个 HTML。
skills.why_en: Presenter view and second-screen sync are details almost no AI deck tool bothers with, and this one folds them into a single HTML file.
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己划的禁区：大段表格图表、培训课件、多人协作编辑都别用它，成品就是一份静态 HTML。主题只能从预设 5 套/4 套里挑，不收自定义 hex；两套风格类名互斥不能混。校验脚本要 Node，渲染实测还要 Playwright。
skills.limit_en: The author rules out dense tables, courseware and collaborative editing - the artifact is one static HTML file. Themes come from the 5 or 4 presets, no custom hex, and the two styles' class names cannot be mixed. Validators need Node.
skills.title_en: Presenter view and dual screens, in one file

skills.name: x-mastery-mentor
skills.title_zh: 读过 X 开源算法再教你写推文的增长教练
skills.tagline_zh: 蒸馏 Nicolas Cole、Sahil Bloom、Hormozi 等六位顶级创作者的方法论,加上对 X 开源算法的分析,给出选题—写作—增长的完整操作手册。
skills.tagline_en: Distills the playbooks of six top creators — Nicolas Cole, Sahil Bloom, Hormozi and more — plus analysis of X's open-sourced algorithm into a topic-to-growth manual.
skills.desc_en: $10K/hr级X/Twitter运营导师。基于Nicolas Cole、Dickie Bush、Sahil Bloom、Justin Welsh、 Dan Koe、Alex Hormozi六位顶级创作者的方法论 + X开源算法深度分析 + AI/科技赛道专精策略， 提炼6个核心心智模型、10条决策启发式、完整的选题-写作-增长操作手册。 通用方法论为底座，AI/科技赛道为专精。 当用户提到「X运营」「推特」「Twitter」「怎么写推文」「怎么涨粉」「X策略」「推特选题」「tweet」「thread」「X算法」时使用。 即使用户只是说「这条推文怎么写」「帮我想个X内容」「推特增长」「发推」「write a tweet」「X account」「grow on X」也应触发。
skills.why_zh: 少见地把「创作者方法论」和「平台算法机制」两头都吃透:知道写什么,也知道平台为什么推它。
skills.why_en: Rare in covering both sides — what to write and why the platform amplifies it, methodology married to algorithm.
skills.limit_zh: 算法那部分停在 2026 年 4 月的 X 开源数据，作者自陈方法论以英文市场为主、中文传播规律未必相同。账号诊断要 computer-use 或 Chrome 扩展去抓推文，抓不到就得你自己导 CSV。
skills.limit_en: Its algorithm reading is frozen at the April 2026 open-source X data, and the author notes the methodology is English-market first. Account diagnosis needs computer-use or a Chrome extension to scrape tweets, else you export CSV by hand.
skills.title_en: Six creators' playbooks, plus the algorithm's source code

skills.name: zhangxuefeng-perspective
skills.title_zh: 用张雪峰的框架分析升学和职业选择
skills.tagline_zh: 高考志愿、考研、转行——这类决定影响十年，家里人给的建议却常常凭感觉。它基于他 5 本书、15 篇深访提炼出的心智模型和决策启发式来拆。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes education and career choices through Zhang Xuefeng's frameworks — five mental models and eight decision heuristics distilled from five books and 15+ interviews.
skills.desc_en: 张雪峰的思维框架与表达方式。基于5本著作、15+篇权威媒体深度采访、 30+条一手语录、11个关键决策记录和完整人生时间线的深度调研， 提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。 用途：作为思维顾问，用张雪峰的视角分析教育选择、职业规划、阶层流动等问题。 当用户提到「用张雪峰的视角」「张雪峰会怎么看」「张雪峰模式」「雪峰视角」时使用。 即使用户只是说「帮我用张雪峰的角度想想」「如果张雪峰会怎么说」「切换到张雪峰」也应触发。
skills.why_zh: 调研扎实，不是拿网红名字贴标签；请不到本人，就请一份他的思维方式。
skills.why_en: College and career decisions are high-stakes for Chinese families; if you can't hire him, hire his reasoning — and the research behind it is real, not name-dropping.
skills.limit_zh: 适用面它自己划得很死：普通家庭、就业导向的升学选择；家境宽裕、想走学术或创业的人，正文说这套建议可能反而是束缚。语料截至 2026-04-05，碰院校专业数据必须现搜。
skills.limit_en: It draws its boundary hard: ordinary families making employment-driven education choices. For well-off, academic or entrepreneurial paths it says the advice may become a constraint. Research ends 2026-04-05; school data is searched live.
skills.title_en: Eight decision rules from China's bluntest college counselor

skills.name: home-assistant-manager
skills.title_zh: 用对话管理智能家居的自动化配置
skills.tagline_zh: Home Assistant 的 YAML 改错一行，整屋自动化就哑掉。它带安全校验再部署，还能排查设备失联——终于不用手写配置了。
skills.tagline_en: Manage all of Home Assistant by conversation — safely edit automation YAML, deploy scripts and blueprints, debug offline devices. No more hand-written config.
skills.desc_en: Manage Home Assistant configuration safely and fast — edit and deploy YAML (automations, blueprints, scripts, scenes, templates, MQTT), validate with ha core check, deploy via git or rapid scp, reload-vs-restart correctly, verify changes from logs, traces and entity state, and build Lovelace dashboards. Use for any Home Assistant config, automation, template, or dashboard work over SSH/hass-cli/MC
skills.why_zh: 「校验后再部署」这个设计，是敢让 AI 碰真设备的前提。
skills.why_en: HA's YAML is the smart-home hobbyist's shared pain — one wrong line silences the house; this validates before deploying, so letting AI touch real devices is safe.
skills.limit_zh: 默认你有 SSH，且手上这个仓库就是 git 连着实例的 /config；改完还要 ssh 进去 git pull 才生效。hass-cli 的 HASS_TOKEN 得在会话启动前就设好，否则它会转向 localhost 报错。
skills.limit_en: Assumes SSH access and that the repo you edit is the HA /config dir wired to the instance by git; edits go live only after you ssh in and git pull. hass-cli needs HASS_TOKEN set before the session starts, or it hits localhost.
skills.title_en: Rewrites the YAML that can silence your whole house

skills.name: anti-autoresearch
skills.title_zh: 核查一篇论文是不是 AI 编的
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写的论文越来越多，数据对不上、引用编造、结论超出证据。它做实质性诚信取证，专查这类漏洞。
skills.tagline_en: Runs a substantive-integrity forensic sweep on a paper, aimed at AI-generated research — mismatched data, fabricated citations, conclusions outstripping evidence.
skills.desc_en: End-to-end substantive-integrity forensic sweep of a research paper (especially autoresearch / AI-Scientist-style output). Orchestrates the whole pipeline: ingest (arxiv-id | pdf | dir → working dir + pdftotext for L0) → /evidence-ledger (artifact manifest + observability level L0/L1/L2 + span-anchored claims.json) → fan out the integrity auditor skills (consistency, citation, baseline, experiment
skills.why_zh: 立意站在学术诚信这边，做法也具体——反向取证的工具比生成工具少得多。
skills.why_en: AI-written papers keep multiplying while integrity forensics stays rare; this stands on the right side and does it concretely.
skills.limit_zh: 得在它自己的仓库里跑（tools/adjudicate_findings.py），还要 codex MCP 调 gpt-5.6-sol 复核；没有就只剩确定性检查，那种模式永远给不出 CLEAN。只有 PDF 时够不着代码级造假。
skills.limit_en: Must run inside its own checkout (tools/adjudicate_findings.py) and needs codex MCP with gpt-5.6-sol for cross-model review; without it only deterministic checks run, and that mode can never return CLEAN. A PDF alone can't reach code fraud.
skills.title_en: Forensics for papers whose citations were never written

skills.name: skills-janitor
skills.title_zh: 给你装的技能库做体检和减法
skills.tagline_zh: 装得越多上下文越挤，还不知道哪个在偷偷吃 token、哪个藏着提示注入。它左滑扔掉浪费的、扫风险、给诚实的 token 账单。
skills.tagline_en: A health check for your installed skills — swipe away context wasters, scan for prompt injection, get an honest token bill. It calls itself Tinder for skills.
skills.desc_en: Tinder for your Claude Code skills. Swipe away what wastes context, scan for prompt injection, get honest token costs. 6 commands, zero dependencies, Claude Code + Codex.
skills.why_zh: 这个生态罕见的「减法」工具：装得多不等于装得好，它同时管省上下文、防注入、看清成本。
skills.why_en: More installed isn't better: it handles context waste, injection risk and real cost at once — a rare subtractive tool in this ecosystem.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

skills.limit_zh: 它会真动手删：左滑就把那个 MCP server 从配置文件里移除，只留一个带时间戳的 .bak。判断依据是本机会话记录里的调用次数——刚装没多久的 skill 天然显示成「没用过」，容易误杀。安全扫描作者写明是启发式。
skills.limit_en: It actually deletes: swipe left and the MCP server is removed from your config file, leaving a timestamped .bak. Its verdict comes from call counts in your local transcripts, so anything installed recently reads as 'never used'. The security scan is explicitly heuristic.
skills.title_en: Swipe left on the skills quietly billing you tokens

skills.name: diagram
skills.title_zh: 自动选对图表类型再画出来
skills.tagline_zh: 多数人卡在「该用泳道图还是时序图」，不是不会画。它先按需求选型，再从 29 种里出符合规范的 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.
skills.desc_en: 专业图表生成技能：根据需求自动选择合适的图表类型，生成符合设计规范的 PNG 图表。 覆盖 29 种图表：结构图（流程图、泳道图、时序图、架构图、状态图、ER图、类图、思维导图、甘特图、Kanban、Git Graph 等） 和统计图（柱状图、折线图、饼图、雷达图、热力图、散点图、桑基图、漏斗图、瀑布图、矩形树图、柱线混合图等）。 统一工具：HTML/SVG + 内联 JS 布局计算。ER/类图使用 ELKjs 布局引擎。 所有图表遵循统一的设计规范（配色/字体/组件/间距），风格现代简洁。 支持三种输出：PNG（默认）、HTML（富文档嵌入）、DSL（Mermaid 文本，嵌入 MD 文档）。 触发词：画图、画一个、生成图表、流程图、架构图、时序图、柱状图、对比图、关系图。 即使用户没有说"画图"，只要需求中涉及可视化展示（流程、架构、数据对比、关系），都应触发此技能。 被 deep-r
skills.why_zh: 先选型后出图这个顺序，比丢给你一堆模板实用得多。
skills.why_en: Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.
skills.limit_zh: 出 PNG 必须跑 scripts/capture.py 和 bridge.py（内部调 Playwright），正文禁止你手动截图。雷达、热力、散点、漏斗、瀑布不支持 Mermaid 文本输出，只能留 PNG。
skills.limit_en: PNGs only come out of scripts/capture.py and bridge.py, which drive Playwright internally — screenshotting by hand is forbidden. Radar, heatmap, scatter, funnel and waterfall get no Mermaid text output, only PNG.
skills.title_en: Decides which of 29 diagram types you actually meant

skills.name: tufte
skills.title_zh: 按塔夫特原则画极简数据图
skills.tagline_zh: 默认图表总是花里胡哨：网格、阴影、图例挤成一团。它砍掉一切多余装饰、拉高数据墨水比，出的图有种克制的高级感。
skills.tagline_en: Turns "make me a chart" into a Tufte-compliant one — max data-ink, zero junk, distilled from his three foundational books.
skills.desc_en: Apply Edward Tufte's principles to any data visualization, chart, dashboard, or infographic. Use when the user asks to produce, design, critique, or improve a chart, graph, dashboard, KPI tile, table-with-data, sparkline, small multiple, time series, distribution plot, choropleth, or any other visual that communicates quantitative or categorical information. Also triggers on words like "visualize"
skills.why_zh: 数据可视化的品味天花板就是塔夫特，它把「少即是多」变成可执行规则，而不是口号。
skills.why_en: Tufte is the ceiling of data-viz taste; this makes "less is more" executable — restrained, high-end charts instead of rainbow clutter.
skills.limit_zh: 产物只有两条路：自包含 HTML/SVG，或 React 的 Recharts/D3；matplotlib、Excel、PPT 里的图它不管。饼图和双轴在 kill-list 上，你不明说它就不画。
skills.limit_en: Output is limited to self-contained HTML/SVG or React (Recharts, with D3 for slopegraphs and small multiples) — no matplotlib, Excel or PowerPoint charts. Pie and dual-axis charts sit on the kill list and appear only if you override.
skills.cover_note: 原封面 vdqi-cover.svg 是 Tufte《The Visual Display of Quantitative Information》的书封——不是产出物，且有用图权问题。撤图，走无图卡。
skills.title_en: Tufte's three books, enforced like a linter

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram
skills.title_zh: 生成手绘白板风格的示意图
skills.tagline_zh: 讲思路时精确框图显得冷，手绘草图更让人愿意看。它出真正的 Excalidraw 文件，画完你还能自己拖着改。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Excalidraw hand-drawn diagram JSON for workflows, architectures and concepts — that whiteboard-sketch warmth, still editable on import.
skills.desc_en: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, or concepts.
skills.why_zh: 产物是可编辑源文件而不是截图——这一点决定了它能进日常工作流，而不只是配图。
skills.why_en: Hand-drawn beats rigid boxes for explaining ideas warmly; real Excalidraw files you keep editing after.
skills.limit_zh: 必做的渲染校验要用 uv 装 Playwright 和 Chromium。正文禁止写脚本生成、禁止转交别的 agent，只能一段段手敲 JSON，再渲染—看图—改，通常来回 2-4 轮。
skills.limit_en: The mandatory validation step renders through uv, Playwright and Chromium. The skill forbids writing a generator script or handing the job to a coding agent: you hand-write JSON section by section, then loop render-view-fix 2-4 times.
skills.title_en: Generated diagrams that look hand-drawn and stay editable

skills.name: obsidian-cli
skills.title_zh: 用命令行让 agent 读写你的 Obsidian 库
skills.tagline_zh: 笔记都在 Obsidian 里，AI 却看不见。装上它 agent 能直接读写笔记、搜索、改属性和任务——作者就是 Obsidian 的 CEO。
skills.tagline_en: Drive your Obsidian vault from the CLI — read, create, search notes and manage tasks and properties. Built by kepano, Obsidian's own creator.
skills.desc_en: Interact with Obsidian vaults using the Obsidian CLI to read, create, search, and manage notes, tasks, properties, and more. Also supports plugin and theme development with commands to reload plugins, run JavaScript, capture errors, take screenshots, and inspect the DOM. Use when the user asks to interact with their Obsidian vault, manage notes, search vault content, perform vault operations from
skills.why_zh: 一手权威：没人比作者更懂这个库的数据模型，比任何第三方封装都可靠。
skills.why_en: Written by Obsidian's CEO — nobody knows the vault data model better; your agent can finally read and write your second brain properly.
skills.limit_zh: 要装 obsidian 命令行，而且 Obsidian 必须开着，关掉就全断。命令清单以 obsidian help 为准，这里只列了常用几条。不写 vault= 时动的是最近聚焦的那个库。
skills.limit_en: Requires the obsidian CLI and a running Obsidian instance; close the app and everything stops. The command list here is partial, with `obsidian help` as the authority. Without vault=, commands act on whichever vault was focused last.
skills.title_en: Obsidian's own creator handed your agent the vault keys

skills.name: code-walkthrough
skills.title_zh: 带你读懂一个陌生代码库
skills.tagline_zh: 接手别人的项目，难点从来不是看不懂语法，而是不知道各部分为什么这样连。它从架构到核心流程到关键决策分层讲。
skills.tagline_en: A guide for unfamiliar codebases — architecture, then core flows, then key design decisions, answering why the code is written this way instead of listing files.
skills.desc_en: 代码导读技能：帮助快速理解不熟悉的项目或模块，建立心智模型。 从全局架构到核心流程再到关键设计决策，分层递进地梳理代码。 不是简单地读文件列目录，而是提炼出"这段代码在做什么、为什么这么做、和其他部分怎么连接"。 触发词：帮我梳理一下、这块代码怎么运作的、导读、接手项目、看看这个模块、代码走读、walkthrough。 触发场景：接手新项目、进入不熟悉的模块、重构前理解现状、Code Review 需要理解上下文。 即使用户没有说"导读"，只要意图是"理解一段不熟悉的代码"，都应触发此技能。
skills.why_zh: 目标定得对：它要给你的是心智模型，不是文件清单。
skills.why_en: Building a mental model is the right goal — reading code is hard not because of syntax but because you can't see why parts connect.
skills.limit_zh: 它只回答「这是什么、怎么运转」；「改这里会动到哪儿」作者明说归另一件 dependency-map，那件不在包里。全程没脚本，靠现读 ls 和 git log，长导读落在 docs/guides/。
skills.limit_en: It answers "what is this and how does it run"; the author routes "what breaks if I change it" to a separate dependency-map skill that isn't bundled. No scripts at all — it reads ls and git log live and drops long write-ups in docs/guides/.
skills.title_en: Reads a strange codebase for why, not what

skills.name: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm
skills.title_zh: 把公众号视频播客一股脑喂进 NotebookLM
skills.tagline_zh: 想让 NotebookLM 帮你消化一堆资料，光是把内容搬进去就够烦。公众号、网页、YouTube、小宇宙、PDF 丢给它，自动整理上传，还能出播客和思维导图。
skills.tagline_en: WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, podcasts, PDFs — dump them in, auto-processed into NotebookLM as podcasts, slides and mind maps.
skills.desc_en: 多源内容智能处理器：支持微信公众号、网页、YouTube、播客（小宇宙/喜马拉雅）、PDF、Markdown等，自动上传到NotebookLM并生成播客/PPT/思维导图等多种格式。支持深度分析模式和飞书文档自动创建
skills.why_zh: 乔木出品。它吃透了中文内容源（公众号、小宇宙），这块国外工具基本不管。
skills.why_en: By Qiaomu — fully automates feeding multi-source material into NotebookLM, with real fluency in Chinese sources (WeChat, Xiaoyuzhou).
skills.limit_zh: 公众号那条要手动把 wexin-read-mcp 写进 ~/.claude/config.json 再重启；小宇宙、喜马拉雅、B站的转写另需 Get笔记 API key 和 tokens.json。还得先 notebooklm login。
skills.limit_en: The WeChat path needs wexin-read-mcp hand-registered in ~/.claude/config.json plus a restart; Xiaoyuzhou, Ximalaya and Bilibili transcripts need a separate Get-Note API key pair and tokens.json. And `notebooklm login` before anything.
skills.title_en: Feeds NotebookLM the Chinese sources it can't read

skills.name: swiftui-pro
skills.title_zh: 用 SwiftUI 权威的标准审你的 iOS 代码
skills.tagline_zh: SwiftUI 变化快，AI 常拿过时 API 糊你。作者是 Hacking with Swift 的 Paul Hudson，全球 iOS 开发者的教科书作者——现代 API、可维护性、性能逐项过。
skills.tagline_en: A SwiftUI code-review expert from Paul Hudson — modern APIs, maintainability and performance checked; an authority in your pocket for iOS UI.
skills.desc_en: Comprehensively reviews SwiftUI code for best practices on modern APIs, maintainability, and performance. Use when reading, writing, or reviewing SwiftUI projects.
skills.why_zh: 权威性拉满：评审意见是真行家的话，不是训练记忆里的旧写法。
skills.why_en: By Paul Hudson of Hacking with Swift — the iOS world's textbook author; maximal authority, real-expert review.
skills.limit_zh: 它只读代码写意见，不编译、不跑测试、不替你改。基线写死 iOS 26 与 Swift 6.2，你要兼容旧系统它照样按最新 API 判。默认回避 UIKit，也不主动引第三方框架。
skills.limit_en: It reads and reports only — no compiling, no tests, no edits applied. The baseline is hardwired to iOS 26 and Swift 6.2+, so older deployment targets get judged against the newest APIs. It avoids UIKit and adds no third-party frameworks.
skills.title_en: Paul Hudson reviews your SwiftUI, line by line

skills.name: claude-to-im
skills.title_zh: 从手机指挥电脑里跑着的 agent
skills.tagline_zh: 长任务要跑一小时，你却得出门。把会话桥到 Telegram、飞书、微信，手机上发一句就能远程派活，干完还推给你。
skills.tagline_en: Bridges your live agent session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ or WeChat — command the Claude running on your computer straight from your phone.
skills.desc_en: Bridge THIS Claude Code or Codex session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ, or WeChat so the user can chat with Claude from their phone. Use for: setting up, starting, stopping, or diagnosing the claude-to-im bridge daemon; forwarding Claude replies to a messaging app; any phrase like "claude-to-im", "bridge", "消息推送", "消息转发", "桥接", "连上飞书", "手机上看claude", "启动后台服务", "诊断", "查看日志", "配置". Subcommand
skills.why_zh: 歸藏出品，解决的是真痛点：agent 的时间和人的时间从此不用绑在一起。
skills.why_en: By Guizang — solves the real pain of long tasks while you're away; command remotely from your phone, get pinged when done.
skills.limit_zh: 本机得一直开着：桥是常驻 Node 进程，装完还要在 skill 目录 npm install 和 build。微信只能扫码绑一个号，没有内联授权按钮和流式预览，语音只收微信自己转的文字。飞书要两轮发版加管理员审批。
skills.limit_en: Your machine must stay up: the bridge is a resident Node daemon, and its dir needs npm install plus build. WeChat is QR-login, one account only, no inline permission buttons or streaming, voice only via WeChat's own transcript.
skills.title_en: Runs on your desk, takes orders from your phone

skills.name: aso-appstore-screenshots
skills.title_zh: 从代码反推卖点生成 App Store 截图
skills.tagline_zh: 独立开发者最不擅长又最影响下载量的就是商店截图。它先读你的代码库找出核心卖点，再生成 ASO 优化的展示图。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes your app's codebase to surface core benefits, then generates ASO-optimized App Store screenshots — the download page that actually converts.
skills.desc_en: Generate high-converting App Store screenshots by analyzing your app's codebase, discovering core benefits, and creating ASO-optimized screenshot images using Nano Banana Pro.
skills.why_zh: 从代码反推卖点，比对着空白页想文案聪明——素材来自产品本身而不是想象。
skills.why_en: Store screenshots are what indies do worst and download rates need most; deriving benefits from code beats guessing at copy.
skills.limit_zh: 检测不到 Gemini MCP（npm i -g gemini-mcp）它就直接停手不生成；裁切那步调的是 macOS 专有的 sips。尺寸只给 iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 三种，没有 iPad，模拟器截图还得你自己拍。
skills.limit_en: It refuses to generate unless the Gemini MCP server (npm i -g gemini-mcp) is present, and the crop/resize step shells out to macOS-only sips. Ships iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 sizes only, no iPad — and you supply the simulator screenshots yourself.
skills.title_en: Reads your source code to write App Store screenshots

skills.name: translate-book
skills.title_zh: 把整本书翻译成任何语言
skills.tagline_zh: 一本书几十万字，串行翻要等到天荒地老。它用并行子 agent 分块同时翻，保留原书排版，输出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB。
skills.tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
skills.desc_en: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
skills.why_zh: 并行是关键：把几小时压到几十分钟，而且排版不散——这才让「翻整本书」从设想变成可做的事。
skills.why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.
skills.limit_zh: 本机要有 python3 和 pandoc，DOCX/EPUB/PDF 还得装 Calibre，缺了只剩 HTML。默认放 8 个子 agent 并发，整本书的 token 你自己付；术语表只从 5 个抽样块里提。
skills.limit_en: Needs python3 and pandoc locally; DOCX/EPUB/PDF conversions require Calibre, otherwise you only get HTML. Default 8 parallel sub-agents, so the whole book is billed as tokens, and the glossary is extracted from only 5 sampled chunks.
skills.title_en: Translates a whole book in parallel, layout intact

skills.name: x-article-publisher
skills.title_zh: 把 Markdown 直接发成 X 长文
skills.tagline_zh: X 的长文编辑器手动排版极其难受，复制过去格式必崩。它把 Markdown 到 X Articles 这一步自动化，写完直接发。
skills.tagline_en: Publishes Markdown articles straight into X's Articles editor with formatting preserved — no manual copy-paste, no broken layout.
skills.desc_en: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.
skills.why_zh: 王树义出品。解决的是发布环节那个没人愿意干的脏活。
skills.why_en: By Wang Shuyi — X's Articles editor is painful to format by hand; this automates Markdown-to-X-Articles so you just publish.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Playwright MCP、一个 X Premium Plus 账号，和 Python 的 Pillow/pyobjc（Win 换 pywin32）。表格和 Mermaid 得先转 PNG，分割线只能走 Insert 菜单。只存草稿。
skills.limit_en: Needs Playwright MCP, a logged-in X Premium Plus account, and Python-side Pillow/pyobjc (pywin32 on Windows). Tables and Mermaid must become PNGs first, dividers go through the Insert menu, and it only saves a draft — you publish.
skills.title_en: Markdown into X's Articles editor without the reformatting

skills.name: math-modeling
skills.title_zh: 三天赛程里做完数学建模竞赛全流程
skills.tagline_zh: 建模竞赛最难的是三天内同时搞定建模、编程、写论文。它按三阶段分工推进，每阶段还有独立质检 subagent 把关。
skills.tagline_en: A full-pipeline assistant for math-modeling contests — modeling, solving in code, visualization and paper writing, with an independent QA subagent per stage.
skills.desc_en: 当用户要求数学建模、建模竞赛、建模分析、代码求解、结果可视化或生成数学建模论文时使用。支持完整三阶段流程、单独执行任一角色，以及在关键节点使用独立 Subagent 进行阶段内质检；默认只启用质检 Subagent，用户可明确选择额外协作。
skills.why_zh: 按竞赛真实节奏设计的，不是把「数学建模」当学科名词做个通用助手。
skills.why_en: Contest pain is doing modeling, coding and writing in three days; this splits the roles and adds QA gates — designed to the real contest rhythm.
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己写明产出的论文不能直接当作品交，格式还得对当届官方模板。运行环境派不出 Subagent 时，M1/P1/P2/W1/W2 五道门禁只能标 BLOCKED；LaTeX 分支缺编译引擎会直接阻塞。
skills.limit_en: The author states the paper is not a directly submittable entry, and formatting must follow the current year's official template. Without Subagents the M1/P1/P2/W1/W2 gates can only be marked BLOCKED; LaTeX blocks without a compiler.
skills.title_en: A three-day contest team with its own QA critic

skills.name: email-marketing-bible
skills.title_zh: 做邮件营销的顾问

skills.desc_en: Data-backed email marketing skill for AI agents. Use when building or running email automation, driving an ESP from an agent (MCP/connectors), diagnosing deliverability, writing or de-slopping email copy, designing emails, choosing a platform, or pulling benchmarks. skills.title_en: 908 sources of email marketing, installed as one consultant

skills.name: dnd
skills.title_zh: 一个人也能玩的 D&D 地下城主
skills.tagline_zh: 跑团最难的是凑人和一个好 DM。它管战役、角色卡、战斗轮次和 NPC，还带可选的影院式画面，一个人也能沉浸开团。
skills.tagline_en: An on-call D&D 5e Dungeon Master — persistent campaigns, character sheets, combat tracking and NPCs, with an optional cinematic display. Solo-play ready.

Invoke with /dm:dnd followed by a subcommand, or just speak naturally once a campaign is loaded.

skills.limit_en: Campaign data lives locally under ~/.claude/dnd - a new machine starts empty. Only the 5e SRD dataset ships; published modules you import yourself. The cinematic display is a local/LAN Flask app. Default roll_mode never auto-rolls your PC.
skills.title_en: A dungeon master for a table of one

skills.name: punk-ip-article-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 生成专属你的 IP 角色并贯穿每篇文章
skills.tagline_zh: 文章配图每篇风格都不一样，读者记不住你。上传一张照片生成专属 IP 角色（含四视图设定板），之后每篇都是同一个「你」在演。
skills.tagline_en: Upload one photo to mint your own IP character (with a four-view sheet), then send that character into every article you write — retro flat-3D vignette style, image count auto-scaled to article length.
skills.desc_en: Punk 出品的完整个人 IP 插图工作流：从用户上传的人物照片创建、修订、确认并持久化可复用角色，也可直接启用内置 Punk 角色；角色确认后读取完整文章、Markdown、网页、帖子或观点，自动决定数量并生成复古彩色扁平 3D 小剧场正文插图。适用于创建个人 IP、角色设定板、切换角色、文章自动配图、长文多图、流程拆解图和核心动作图等连续任务。
skills.why_zh: 戳中自媒体的辨识度护城河：不是又一个文章配图，而是先立住视觉人格再篇篇复用。照片不上传、不推断敏感属性。
skills.why_en: Nails a real creator pain — not another article-illustrator, but a way to establish your own visual persona first, then reuse it across every piece. One consistent "you" running through all your content is a recognition moat. Photos stay local; no sensitive-attribute inference.
skills.limit_zh: 角色要你亲口说「确认」才解锁配图，draft 状态不许激活，给了文章也不提前画。宿主没有生图能力时它只交提示词和保存计划，不出图。角色包只存本地运行目录。
skills.limit_en: The character stays locked until you explicitly confirm it — drafts can't be activated, and handing it an article won't skip that gate. With no image tool on the host it returns prompts instead of pictures. Character packs stay local only.
skills.title_en: One photo, then that character appears in every article

skills.name: positioning-and-story
skills.title_zh: 把产品叙事改写成开发者当英雄的故事
skills.tagline_zh: 文案听起来像在介绍功能而不是解决痛点，转化就上不去。它重写成「开发者是英雄、某个真实趋势是反派」的结构。
skills.tagline_en: Rewrites your product narrative into a story where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain — reach for it when your copy describes the product instead of the pain.
skills.desc_en: Build a positioning and narrative where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain. Use when the messaging describes the product instead of the problem, sounds like every competitor, or has no urgency because nothing is at stake.
skills.why_zh: 英雄 vs 反派这个框架把干巴巴的功能列表变成有代入感的故事——技术人最不擅长、又最影响转化的一环。
skills.why_en: The hero-vs-villain frame turns a dry feature list into a story people enter — the piece technical folks are worst at and that most moves conversion.
skills.limit_zh: 整份反派清单和例子都长在开发者工具语境里（构建慢、YAML 泛滥、云成本、流水线不稳），面向非开发者的产品套不上。它两次把你转去同仓库的 talk-to-users，那件不在包里。
skills.limit_en: Every villain and example lives in dev-tool land — slow builds, YAML sprawl, cloud-cost sprawl, flaky pipelines — so it won't transfer to a non-developer audience. Twice it hands you to a sibling talk-to-users skill that isn't bundled.
skills.title_en: Gives your product story a hero and a villain

skills.name: university-exam-prep
skills.title_zh: 对着真实课本和考纲突击复习
skills.tagline_zh: 考的是老师的 PPT 和课本，AI 却按通用知识给你讲。它强制你先传真材料，再用苏格拉底式提问带你想，不灌答案。
skills.tagline_en: Built for textbook-and-slides exams — it makes you upload the actual materials first, then Socratically questions you toward understanding instead of spoon-feeding.
skills.desc_en: 大学备考苏格拉底式学习助手，专为应对"面向课本和PPT考试"设计。当用户说"帮我复习"、"准备考试"、"备考"、"期末复习"、"模拟学习"、"突击复习"等时触发。核心特点：(1)强制要求用户上传课本/PPT/考纲等原始材料——没有材料就无法有效辅导；(2)使用苏格拉底式提问法，不直接灌输而是引导思考；(3)专注于应用型和理解型内容，而非纯概念记忆；(4)模拟真实考试场景进行针对性练习；(5)分析材料识别高频考点和重难点。适用于大学各科目期中期末考试备考、突击复习、考前模拟。
skills.why_zh: 「没材料就不辅导」这条硬约束很诚实：逼你对着真考纲学，而不是听 AI 编一套。
skills.why_en: The no-materials-no-tutoring rule is honest — it forces study against the real syllabus, not a generic AI-invented one.
skills.limit_zh: 没传课本/PPT/考纲它就只要材料，不开讲。PDF、Word 得另借 docx/pdf skill 提取。正文全中文，射程锁在大学期中期末，脚本只有 analyze_material.py 和 generate_questions.py。
skills.limit_en: With no textbook, slides or syllabus uploaded it only asks for material and refuses to tutor. PDFs and Word files need a separate docx/pdf skill to extract. The body is all Chinese and scoped strictly to university midterms and finals.
skills.title_en: Refuses to tutor you without the actual syllabus

skills.name: hotclip
skills.title_zh: 把长视频切成竖屏爆款短片，全程本地
skills.tagline_zh: 切片工具满地都是，但敢把未发布的素材传上去吗？它端侧转写、LLM 找高光、9:16 重构、卡拉OK字幕，每条还打病毒潜力分，全程不出你的机器。
skills.tagline_en: Cuts long videos and livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe, karaoke captions, per-clip virality scores.
skills.desc_en: Turn long videos & livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts, 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe with karaoke captions, and a per-clip render-QA report. Use when the user asks to clip / cut / 切片 / 剪 a long video, podcast or stream replay into short clips, find highlights / 爆点 in a video, or transcribe a media file. Footage never leaves the machine.
skills.why_zh: 「100% 本地」是它最狠的点：碰未公开素材时，这一条比精度更值钱。
skills.why_en: Fully local, nothing uploaded — clip tools are everywhere, but few will touch your unreleased footage without phoning home.
skills.limit_zh: 装 skill 还不够：得先 git clone 仓库再 pnpm install，首次跑自动下约 1GB 的 ASR 模型。高光检测要一个 OpenAI 兼容端点，接云端时转写文本会出机器（媒体文件不会），本地则要自己起 Ollama。
skills.limit_en: Installing the skill is not enough: git clone the repo and pnpm install, and the first run pulls a ~1GB ASR model. Highlight detection needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint — with a cloud one the transcript text does leave the machine.
skills.title_en: Cuts viral verticals without your footage leaving the laptop

skills.name: punk-cover
skills.title_zh: 把文章一句话变成封面图
skills.tagline_zh: 每篇文章都要封面，找图配字最耗时。11 种精调风格（商业杂志头版、复古手撕拼贴、巨型透视中文标题…），每种都标了适合什么内容。
skills.tagline_en: Turn any article, note or tweet into a cover image in one line — 11 finely tuned styles (magazine front page, torn-paper collage, giant Chinese title…) for Xiaohongshu, WeChat and X.
skills.desc_en: Generate cover images and reusable image prompts from the shared Punk style library for articles, Xiaohongshu notes, WeChat public account posts, X posts, topic drafts, and requests for covers, social cover images, poster prompts, style-template-based image prompts, or image generation from long-form text. Use this skill to analyze source content, confirm platform/aspect ratio and visual style, sa
skills.why_zh: 风格库真下过功夫：选风格像点菜一样准，出的封面有编辑部气质而不是 AI 糊图。
skills.why_en: The style library is genuinely crafted — each one tagged with what content it fits, so picking feels like ordering off a menu; covers land with editorial polish, not AI mush.
skills.limit_zh: 没告诉它平台和风格，它就停在提问那一步，不会先出一版给你看。预置比例只有小红书 3:4、公众号 2.35:1、X 5:2；一次一张、不给多版对比，也不许两种风格混用。
skills.limit_en: Without a platform and a style it stops at the question and won't draft anything first. Preset ratios cover only Xiaohongshu 3:4, WeChat 2.35:1 and X 5:2. One image per run — no side-by-side options, and mixing two styles is forbidden.
skills.title_en: Eleven cover styles, ordered off a menu

skills.name: gtm-cofounder
skills.title_zh: 给独自做产品的技术创始人当 GTM 合伙人
skills.tagline_zh: 技术能做出来，卖不出去。定位、找首批用户、发布、定价——它先访谈你一次，之后所有建议都基于你的真实业务。
skills.tagline_en: The GTM co-founder you don't have — for solo technical AI/dev-tool founders: positioning, first users, launch and pricing, open-source and forged from real deals.
skills.desc_en: The GTM co-founder you don't have. Open-source GTM Agent Skills for technical AI/dev-tool founders building alone: positioning, first users, launch, pricing. Built from real dev-tool GTM experience, sharpened by Frankl & Czakon. MIT.
skills.why_zh: 「先访谈再建议」这个设计诚实：不套教科书，而是长在你的业务上。
skills.why_en: Technical founders lack GTM instinct most; this turns that gap into an executable process. The "interview you once, then ground every later suggestion in your real business" design is refreshingly honest, not textbook.

skills.limit_en: The 18 skills are a numbered chain (00-start-here → 17-review-the-work); pulling one out gets you half a map. All English, templates included. Scoped to dev-tool and AI-product founders.
skills.title_en: Interviews you once, then stops giving generic advice

skills.name: comfyui-mcp
skills.title_zh: 用自然语言指挥 ComfyUI 出图
skills.tagline_zh: ComfyUI 的连线劝退过无数人。装上它用说话就能生成图/视频/音频、搭工作流、改你正在跑的节点图，全程本地不上传素材。
skills.tagline_en: A local-first control plane for ComfyUI — an MCP server plus sidebar agent that generates media, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in plain language.
skills.desc_en: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.
skills.why_zh: 把「拖节点」变成「说人话」，而且本地跑——碰私密素材时这点关键。
skills.why_en: ComfyUI's node-wiring scares people off; this turns dragging nodes into plain talk, fully local, nothing uploaded.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

skills.limit_zh: 本体是 npm 上的 MCP server（node ≥22），39 件 skill 挂在 plugin/skills 底下给它当外围。前提是有一台跑着 ComfyUI 的机器，本地、局域网、VPS 都行——没有 ComfyUI，这一整包一件都用不上。
skills.limit_en: The product is an npm MCP server (node ≥22); the 39 skills under plugin/skills are its periphery. You need a running ComfyUI — local, LAN, VPS or Comfy Cloud. Without one, none of it does anything.
skills.title_en: Rewires your ComfyUI graph by talking to it

skills.name: design-review
skills.title_zh: 给 Go 代码库做地道性评审
skills.tagline_zh: Go 里「能跑」和「地道」差得远。命名、结构、一致性、接口、错误处理逐维打分，还附可执行的修法。
skills.tagline_en: Deep design review for Go codebases — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces and error handling scored, with fixes.
skills.desc_en: Deep design review of Go codebase — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces, error handling. Scores each dimension and provides actionable fixes.
skills.why_zh: 按维度打分让评审意见特别可落地，不是笼统说「建议重构」。
skills.why_en: In Go, "works" and "idiomatic" are far apart; per-dimension scoring makes the feedback actionable.
skills.limit_zh: 正文明说单个 PR 或未提交 diff 不归它管，那要另一件 code-review。而且末尾嵌着 pi-go 这个项目自己的检查项（ADK、internal/provider/、禁 init()），换仓库得先删。
skills.limit_en: The text excludes single PRs and uncommitted diffs (it points you to a separate code-review skill). It also carries a hardcoded "Project-Specific Checks (pi-go)" block - ADK, internal/provider/, no init() - other repos must strip.
skills.title_en: Scores your Go on idiomatic, not on working

skills.name: kinocut
skills.title_zh: 有护栏的 AI 视频剪辑
skills.tagline_zh: 让 AI 直接剪素材，最怕一刀把原片剪废。它先规划后执行、每步可回溯，FFmpeg 操作、字幕、音频、成片改编都管。
skills.tagline_en: Guarded AI video editing — FFmpeg ops, media analysis, subtitles, audio and repurposing, every step source-backed.
skills.desc_en: Use Kinocut for guarded video editing, source-backed planning, FFmpeg operations, media analysis, subtitles, audio workflows, Hyperframes rendering, repurposing packages, and release checkpoints through an MCP server, Python client, or CLI. Trigger when an agent needs to inspect, plan, edit, render, validate, or package local media safely.
skills.why_zh: 「guarded」是它的灵魂：剪辑指令可追溯、可回退，敢让 agent 碰真素材。
skills.why_en: The guardrails are the soul — plan-then-execute, traceable cuts, no irreversible butchery of your footage.
skills.limit_zh: 本体是要装的 kinocut CLI（uvx + FFmpeg），先跑 kino doctor。只碰本地文件，上云要另开 egress 审批。360 只吃拼好的等距 MP4，.insv 直接拒。图层合成不当 NLE 用，音频合成 fail-closed。
skills.limit_en: Drives an installed CLI (uvx kinocut + FFmpeg); run kino doctor first. Local files only - cloud needs a separate egress approval. 360 wants a pre-stitched equirect MP4, .insv rejected. Not an NLE: audio compositing fails closed.
skills.title_en: Video editing that plans before it cuts anything

skills.name: trading-design
skills.title_zh: 按专业交易软件的规范设计盯盘界面
skills.tagline_zh: 交易界面是设计里的特种兵：红绿语义、毫秒级信息密度、面板布局都有讲究，一般设计规范完全不管。
skills.tagline_en: A design system for trading software — panel layouts, data density, market color semantics and interaction rules.
skills.desc_en: Professional trading UI design system. Load when designing or implementing panels, layouts, typography, color, data display, or interactions for trading applications.
skills.why_zh: 成体系的交易 UI 资料极其罕见，做行情类产品时这块知识很难自己攒。
skills.why_en: Trading UI is special-forces design — color semantics, millisecond density; systematic references are rare.
skills.limit_zh: 只给规则不给 token：具体颜色和像素值要你自己的设计系统补，正文没有一行组件代码。深色是设计靶心，浅色只是把层级反过来。硬到「圆角一律为零、彩色只准两个」，跟通用仪表盘规范会打架。
skills.limit_en: Rules only, no tokens — exact colors and pixel values stay in your own design system, and no component code ships. Dark is the target; light is a reversed adaptation. Hard rules: zero border radius everywhere, exactly two chromatic hues.
skills.title_en: Design rules for screens where color means money

skills.name: ppt-master
skills.title_zh: 生成能直接改的 PowerPoint 文件
skills.tagline_zh: AI 出的 PPT 多半是图片，想改一个字都得重做。它产出原生可编辑的 PPTX，还能建品牌/风格工作区反复复用。
skills.tagline_en: An AI-driven editable-PPTX pipeline — build brand/style/layout workspaces, fill native templates, enhance finished decks; real, editable PowerPoint out.
skills.desc_en: AI-driven presentation workflow for generating editable PPTX decks, creating reusable Brand/Style/Layout/Deck workspaces, filling native PPTX templates, and enhancing finished PPTX files. Use when the user asks to create, regenerate, template, fill, or enhance a presentation, or mentions ppt-master.
skills.why_zh: 分工清楚：它管「可编辑可交付」，图片式那些管好看；做系列演示时工作区复用很省事。
skills.why_en: A clear division of labour: native editable PPTX rather than exported images, with reusable workspaces that pay off across a deck series.
skills.limit_zh: 每次启动先跑 scripts/attribution_guard.py 署名校验，返回非零就整件立刻停摆，且明令不许你检查、修复或绕过。真流程在 workflows/ 里，沿途多个阻塞点要你逐个确认。
skills.limit_en: Every run starts with `python3 scripts/attribution_guard.py`; a non-zero result halts the skill and you may not inspect, repair, or bypass that gate. The real procedure lives in workflows/, and each blocking step waits on your confirmation.
skills.cover_note: 原封面 gcdn.moonshot.cn/growth-cdn/sponsor/kimi-en.png 是 Kimi（月之暗面）的赞助商广告，托在第三方 CDN 上，却被标成 cover_kind=artwork + cover_real=true——详情页图注会写「这就是它做出来的东西」。covers.json 里此件无任何备选图，故置空走无图卡，不换图也不改 kind。2026-08-19 人工更正。
skills.title_en: Generates PowerPoint files your colleagues can actually edit

skills.name: writing-agent
skills.title_zh: 从选题到发布的去 AI 味中文写作系统
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写的文章一眼假，改起来比自己写还累。它强制注入人类观点和细节，配读者测试评估和自动图文排版，全流程走完。
skills.tagline_en: A full-stack Chinese writing system on Claude Code that strips AI-flavor — forces human viewpoint and detail, with reader-test evals and auto layout, from topic to publish.

skills.why_zh: 游戏素材是独立开发最大的坑之一，它把「画小人」变成了一句话的事，产物直接进引擎。
skills.why_en: Art is indie dev's biggest wall; this turns "draw me a sprite" into a one-liner with engine-ready output.
skills.limit_zh: 生成那步要本机装好 codex 或 grok CLI 并登录。脚本只认仓库自建的 .venv，缺 NumPy 就在 import 处硬报错——作者明写没有纯 Python 降级。正文大半是韩文。
skills.limit_en: Generation shells out to the codex or grok CLI with their OAuth logins. Scripts run only from the repo's own .venv; the entry point hard-errors without NumPy and the text states there is no pure-Python fallback. Much of the doc is Korean.
skills.title_en: One line in, an engine-ready sprite sheet out

skills.name: vox-director
skills.title_zh: 给一个主题，出一支 Vox 式纸拼贴解说视频
skills.tagline_zh: 一个主题进去，一支 Vox 风纸拼贴解说视频出来：脚本、拼贴关键帧、配音、剪辑全自动跑完。
skills.tagline_en: One topic in, a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer out — script, collage keyframes, voiceover and edit, all automatic.
skills.desc_en: Turn ONE topic into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer / ad video, end to end on the Atlas Cloud API + local ffmpeg — script, collage keyframes, motion, voice-over, music, captions, all automated. Use this whenever the user wants a "Vox style" video, a paper/torn-paper collage animation, a "motion collage", a narrated explainer or short ad built from AI-generated collage posters, a scrap
skills.why_zh: Vox 的拼贴美学是解说视频的天花板之一，这件把整个片场压进了一条命令。
skills.why_en: Vox's collage aesthetic is explainer royalty; this compresses the whole studio into a command.
skills.limit_zh: 整条链只跑 Atlas Cloud 一家，没有 ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY 就只剩一份提示词清单让你自己去粘。本机还要 ffmpeg 和 Pillow。真人和品牌 Omni 会拒，得改用 Kling。
skills.limit_en: Every media call goes to Atlas Cloud; without ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY you get only a manual prompt pack to paste elsewhere. Needs local ffmpeg and Pillow. Omni and Seedance refuse real people and brand logos, so those runs must switch to Kling.
skills.title_en: Explainer videos in Vox's paper-collage style

skills.name: AnythingButLaw
skills.title_zh: 不装律师，只把合同逐条翻成人话再决定签不签
skills.tagline_zh: 合同、条款、律师函——让它逐条翻成人话，把义务、期限和风险点标出来，全看明白了再决定这个字签不签。
skills.tagline_en: Contracts, clauses and lawyer letters translated into plain speech, clause by clause — obligations, deadlines and risks flagged before you sign.
skills.desc_en: 法外功夫 — Non-legal business skills for lawyers. Decision analysis, game theory, contract design, accounting, finance, microeconomics, law & economics, statistics, and regression analysis distilled into deep, actionable frameworks for legal practice. Each domain includes formulas with LaTeX notation, worked examples, adversarial checklists, and book-aligned structure. | 律师必备的非法律商业技能深度参考：决策分析、博弈论、合同设计
skills.why_zh: 不装律师，只做「看懂」这一件事：逐条解释加风险点标注，普通人签字前过一遍很安心。
skills.why_en: Doesn't play lawyer — just makes you understand: clause-by-clause explanation with flagged risks.
skills.limit_zh: 正文是给律师的九门商科参考库——决策、博弈、会计、金融、统计，路由表里没有「把合同逐条讲成人话」这一路。判例与检验全是美国法语境：Daubert、Hand 公式、SSNIP/HHI。公式用 LaTeX 写。
skills.limit_en: The body is a nine-domain business reference for lawyers — decision analysis, game theory, accounting, finance, statistics. No route covers plain-language clause-by-clause explanation, and its cases and tests are US: Daubert, Hand, SSNIP.
skills.title_en: Reads the contract clause by clause before you sign

skills.name: story-deslop
skills.title_zh: 把翻译腔和排比堆砌洗掉，别被平台查出 AI 味
skills.tagline_zh: 检测并清除网文里的 AI 写作痕迹：模板化开头、翻译腔、排比堆砌，让文字回归人写的自然感。
skills.tagline_en: Detects and scrubs AI fingerprints from web fiction — template openings, stilted phrasing, parallelism piles — back to human.
skills.desc_en: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。
skills.why_zh: 网文读者对 AI 味极其敏感，平台也在查；这是全家桶里最保命的一件。
skills.why_en: Web-fiction readers (and platforms) smell AI instantly; this is the pack's survival tool.
skills.limit_zh: 只对中文网文有用，禁用词表和脚本都是照网文口味调的。文件模式要 Node 跑 check-ai-patterns.js 等三个脚本，没有就只剩肉眼判断。默认把正文里的 …… 和 —— 全清掉，不吃这套排版口味的别装。
skills.limit_en: Chinese web-novel prose only — the banned-word list and scripts are tuned for it. File mode needs Node for check-ai-patterns.js and two sibling scripts. By default it strips ellipses and em dashes, and promises no detector score.
skills.title_en: Scrubs the AI fingerprints readers can smell

skills.name: video-shotcraft
skills.title_zh: 照着 106 张分镜配方卡，把一句话拍成产品宣传片
skills.tagline_zh: 用 Remotion 拍电影感产品视频：106 张分镜配方卡、161 个运镜预设，一句话描述产品就能出一支成片。
skills.tagline_en: Cinematic product videos via Remotion — 106 shot recipe cards and 161 motion presets; describe the product in one line, get a finished film.
skills.desc_en: Create cinematic product videos from shot recipe cards, a validated template, and code/audio assets (Remotion + real page screenshots + 2.5D camera moves + beat-synced cuts + sound design). Use when the user asks to turn a frontend project or webpage into a product video, says "use video-shotcraft to make a video/promo", names the Ink Press template or asks to reproduce its effect, or wants a sing
skills.why_zh: 把「拍产品宣传片」这种要外包的活变成了本地技能，分镜卡的设计尤其讲究。
skills.why_en: Turns "hire a studio" into a local skill; the shot recipe cards are unusually well crafted.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Remotion 工程和 npm，真实页面镜头必须起本地 dev server 用无头浏览器截图。剪映导出走 pyJianYingDraft，Mac 剪映 11.2 实测过，Windows 那支没真机验证。
skills.limit_en: Needs a Remotion project and npm; real-page shots require a local dev server plus headless-browser capture. Jianying export runs on pyJianYingDraft: the Mac path was tested against Jianying 11.2, the Windows one never was.
skills.title_en: Product films built from 106 shot recipes

skills.name: ecommerce-visual-copywriting
skills.title_zh: 先判断什么带来转化，再出电商主图的分镜和文案
skills.tagline_zh: 电商主图与详情页的视觉策划 SOP：先判断转化驱动力锁定风格，再出分镜、图内文案和生图 Prompt。
skills.tagline_en: An e-commerce visual SOP — diagnose the conversion driver, lock the campaign style, then storyboard, on-image copy and prompts.
skills.desc_en: 电商主图与详情页视觉策划 Skill。根据产品资料、资质边界、目标平台和视觉参考，先判断转化驱动力并锁定 Campaign Style Lock，再输出主图/详情页 Storyboard；用户确认后，交付画面描述、图内文案、设计说明和生图 Prompt。 适用于淘宝、天猫、京东、拼多多、抖音小店等平台的商品主图、详情页、listing、商品卖点、视觉脚本、合规改写和广告法风险审查。 触发词包括：主图文案、详情页文案、电商视觉策划、卖点提炼、视觉脚本、转化率、点击率、合规审查、广告法、平台审核、设计师执行稿。 不用于最终法律意见、医疗或保健功效背书、自动上架发布、编造检测报告/专利/批准文号/销量/评价，或和电商视觉落图无关的普通营销长文。
skills.why_zh: 「设计小白做出五年资深的商品图」不是吹牛，SOP 把资深设计师的判断顺序写死了。
skills.why_en: The senior-designer-in-a-box claim holds because the SOP hard-codes a senior's decision order.
skills.limit_zh: 它只交画面描述、图内文案和生图 Prompt，图得你另找工具生成。策划案和 Storyboard 两道门必须你回话才继续。资质、检测、销量缺了就标缺失，它不补也不出法律结论。
skills.limit_en: It delivers scene descriptions, in-image copy and image-generation prompts - you still need a separate tool to render anything. Two gates (plan, then storyboard) pause for your reply; missing certifications, test reports or sales figures are flagged, never invented, and it draws no legal conclusions.
skills.title_en: Works out what converts before designing the image

skills.name: caveman
skills.title_zh: 让 Claude 用原始人腔说话，据称省下 65% 的 token
skills.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 像原始人一样说话：「为什么用很多 token，少 token 就行」——据称实测省 65% token，还越用越上头。
skills.tagline_en: Claude talks caveman — "why use many token when few token do trick." Claimed 65% token savings in practice, and weirdly addictive.
skills.desc_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is reques
skills.why_zh: 一个玩笑做成了真产品：token 账单实打实地降（据称 65%），还顺手治好了 AI 的啰嗦病。
skills.why_en: A joke that became a product — real token savings (claimed 65%), and it cures verbosity as a side effect.
skills.limit_zh: 65% 是作者自己标注的实测，正文没给测法。凡是写到聊天之外的字——代码注释、commit、文档、issue、记忆文件——一律恢复正常散文，那部分省不到。安全警告也自动切回。
skills.limit_en: The 65% is the author's own "(measured)" claim with no method shown in the file. Anything persisted outside chat (code comments, commits, docs, issues, memory files) reverts to normal prose. Security warnings drop the style too.
skills.title_en: Claude speaks caveman, your token bill drops

skills.name: ponytail
skills.title_zh: 先问「这真的需要做吗」，能不写的代码一行不写
skills.tagline_zh: 请一位「躺平但靠谱」的资深工程师进驻：话少、主意正、先问清楚再动手，能不写的代码一行都不会写。
skills.tagline_en: An unbothered senior engineer moves in — few words, strong opinions, asks before acting, and writes not one line of code that needn't exist.
skills.desc_en: Lazy senior dev mode for any coding task (write, refactor, fix, review): YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Not for non-coding requests.
skills.why_zh: 反内卷的工程精髓——它总在问「这真的需要做吗」，治过度设计比写代码更省钱。
skills.why_en: Its favorite question is "do we even need this?" — killing overengineering saves more than writing code.
skills.limit_zh: 它是常驻人格：ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE，要说 stop ponytail 才关。作者写明非编码请求不适用，而且只管「建什么」不管「怎么说话」，文风得另配 Caveman。
skills.limit_en: A persistent persona: ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE until you say "stop ponytail" or "normal mode". The author states it is not for non-coding requests, and it governs what you build, not how you talk - prose style needs a separate skill (Caveman).
skills.title_en: A senior engineer who talks you out of code

skills.name: understand-figma
skills.title_zh: 接上 Figma API，把设计稿拆成一张设计系统知识图谱
skills.tagline_zh: 接上 Figma API，把设计稿拆成页面、组件、变体、设计令牌的知识图谱，设计系统长什么样一张图看明白。
skills.tagline_en: Hooks the Figma REST API and maps a file into pages, components, variants and tokens — the whole design system legible in one graph.
skills.desc_en: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.
skills.why_zh: 设计交接的痛点被它按住了：设计系统长什么样，一张图谱看明白。
skills.why_en: Design handoff, solved visually — the whole system in one graph.
skills.limit_zh: 要自备 FIGMA_TOKEN，还要 Node ≥22、pnpm ≥10 并先 build 出 core 才跑得动。正文明说它会外连 api.figma.com，不像 /understand 那样离线。分析批次失败只记警告不重试。
skills.limit_en: You supply your own FIGMA_TOKEN, plus Node >= 22, pnpm >= 10 and a core build before it runs. The text states it calls out to api.figma.com and is not offline like /understand. Failed analysis batches are logged as warnings, not retried.
skills.title_en: Maps a Figma file into one design-system graph

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.title_zh: 截图变代码时先对齐设计意图，不做像素级复刻
skills.tagline_zh: 丢一张截图，还原成有品味的代码而不是像素堆：它优先还原设计意图和层级关系，不死磕像素级复刻。
skills.tagline_en: Drop a screenshot, get tasteful code back — it recovers design intent and hierarchy first instead of grinding for pixel parity.
skills.desc_en: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping o
skills.why_zh: 难点在还原「设计意图」而非像素级复刻，它在这个取舍上做得很聪明。
skills.why_en: Recovers design intent rather than chasing pixel parity — the smart trade-off.
skills.limit_zh: 正文讲的是它自己先生成设计图再照着实现，通篇没写怎么读你手上的截图。环境必须能生图，Codex 里每段单独出一张大图，八段落地页就是八张图的钱。范围只到落地页、hero、作品集这类营销页。
skills.limit_en: It generates its own design image and then implements that — nowhere does it describe reading a screenshot you already have. Needs image generation available; in Codex that means one large image per section, so an eight-section page costs eight images. Scope stops at landing, marketing and portfolio pages.
skills.title_en: Screenshot to code that chases intent, not pixels

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 13 个子代理组队做研究，互相审稿和事实核查
skills.tagline_zh: 13 个子代理组队做严肃研究：综述、快报、审稿、事实核查、三路文献扫描，8 种模式按需开团。
skills.tagline_en: A 13-agent research team with 8 modes — full studies, quick briefs, paper review, fact-checks and three-way literature scans on demand.
skills.desc_en: Universal deep research agent team. 13-agent pipeline for rigorous academic research on any topic. 8 modes: full research, quick brief, paper review, lit-review, fact-check, three-way literature scan, Socratic guided research dialogue, and systematic review with optional meta-analysis. Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, sourc
skills.why_zh: 这是「把 deep research 开源自建」的认真尝试，分工和交叉验证的设计相当讲究。
skills.why_en: A serious open-source take on deep research — the division of labor and cross-checks are well designed.

install.note_zh: 两件不同的 skill 在 frontmatter 里都叫 deep-research —— 生态是扁平命名空间，同名就会互相静默覆盖。这里加了作者前缀消歧，跟作者仓库里的原名不一致是故意的。

skills.limit_zh: 单件装不起来：路由靠仓库根的 .claude/CLAUDE.md 和 shared/，默认由 academic-pipeline 调度。改稿最多两轮，剩下的问题直接写进「已知局限」交差。
skills.limit_en: Not installable alone: routing depends on the repo-root .claude/CLAUDE.md and shared/, and the default mode is dispatched by academic-pipeline. Revision is capped at two loops; what remains is filed under "acknowledged limitations".
skills.title_en: Thirteen research agents that cross-check each other

skills.name: design-harness
skills.title_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，产出一份你能答辩的系统设计
skills.tagline_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，它连成一套你能答辩的系统设计：来源→观点→产出三层，全程 Markdown 留痕。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it papers and half-formed ideas; it links them into a defensible system design — sources, ideas, output, all on record.
skills.desc_en: A decision board for evidence-based calls — the human adjudicates, the agent runs the errands. Three layers (sources → ideas → output) in plain markdown, synced on the human's command, projected onto a visual canvas. Use for vendor/tool selection, literature reviews, due diligence, competitive analysis, or any contested call that must stand on traceable evidence — triggers like "file these papers"
skills.why_zh: 「人拍板、agent 跑腿」的分工设计得很清醒，证据链留痕让结论真能答辩。
skills.why_en: Human adjudicates, agent runs errands — and the evidence trail makes conclusions actually defensible.
skills.limit_zh: 它一条判断都不替你下：想法要你先说出口才转写成卡，output 只在你下令时才动。建图全靠 python3 脚本，两个校验器不过就一张 HTML 都不出。输出形态目前只有 system-design 一种。
skills.limit_en: It never adjudicates: a judgment becomes a card only after you voice it, and output changes only on your command. Canvas builds run on python3 scripts gated by two validators — a failure emits no HTML. Only one output form: system-design.
skills.title_en: Turns papers and half-ideas into a defensible design

skills.name: experimental-design
skills.title_zh: 在收第一条数据之前，把随机化和分块设计定下来
skills.tagline_zh: 在收数据之前把实验设计好：选设计、做随机化、设分块、排处理组合，保证结果在统计上真正站得住。
skills.tagline_en: Design the study before data exists — choose the design, randomize, block, lay out treatments so results hold statistically.
skills.desc_en: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening m
skills.why_zh: 设计错了数据就废了，这一步的价值在事后无法弥补，只能事前做对。
skills.why_en: A flawed design can't be rescued in analysis; this is the only stage where rigor is cheap.
skills.limit_zh: 只管收数据前那一步：样本量交给 statistical-power，数据分析交给 statistical-analysis，本件两样都不做。脚本要 Python 3.10 以上，外加 numpy、pandas 和 pyDOE3。
skills.limit_en: It covers only the step before data exists: sample size is handed off to the statistical-power skill and analysis to statistical-analysis, neither of which it does. Scripts need Python 3.10+ with numpy, pandas and pyDOE3 installed.
skills.title_en: Designs the experiment before any data exists

skills.name: hallmark
skills.title_zh: 把一眼就看出是 AI 做的页面，改回像人做的
skills.tagline_zh: Nutlope 出品的 anti-slop 设计 skill：把「一眼 AI」的页面救回来。
skills.tagline_en: Nutlope's anti-slop design skill — rescues pages from that instant-AI look.
skills.desc_en: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots. Use when the user asks to build a new app or landing page, wants to redesign something, invokes Hallmark by name, or uses audit/redesign/study.
skills.why_zh: 作者是产出过一堆爆款开源应用的老手，这份审美清单是他 ship 出来的经验，不是理论。
skills.why_en: From a builder with a string of viral open-source apps — shipped taste, not theory.
skills.limit_zh: 只管网页与组件这一层的视觉。防重复靠项目根目录的 .hallmark/log.json，换个项目就从头轮，组件级的活压根不记账。study 读网页走 WebFetch，碰到要登录或纯 JS 的 SPA 只能改让你截图。
skills.limit_en: Scope is web page and component visuals. Anti-repetition memory is .hallmark/log.json at the project root, so a new project restarts the rotation and component runs log nothing. study reads URLs via WebFetch, else asks for a screenshot.
skills.title_en: Rescues a page from looking obviously AI-made

skills.name: prompt-master
skills.title_zh: 把糙 prompt 重写成带反例和边界条件的专业版
skills.tagline_zh: 把你的糙 prompt 重写成专业级：补结构、配示例、加边界条件和反例，改完直接沉淀进团队提示词库。
skills.tagline_en: Rewrites your rough prompt into a professional one — structure, examples, edge cases and counter-examples added; library-ready on arrival.
skills.desc_en: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.
skills.why_zh: 相当于内置一位提示词工程师；改完的 prompt 复用价值高，适合沉淀成团队词库。
skills.why_en: A prompt engineer on call; the rewrites are reusable enough to seed a team library.
skills.limit_zh: 一次只出一条可粘贴的 prompt，正文里没有保存或沉淀词库的机制。作者明说只有你点名要写/改 prompt 才激活。各家模型的要点是写死的版本（Opus 4.8、o3、Gemini 3 Pro、MiniMax M2.7），换代就得改文件。

skills.title_en: Rewrites your prompt with the edge cases you forgot

skills.why_en: Guizang is a top Chinese AI-design creator; this editorial-Swiss layout system is his signature.

skills.limit_en: Rendering needs a local browser screenshot pass plus node validate-social-deck.mjs. Live Photo cards must be packed into .pvt with makelive and AirDropped to an iPhone; desktop upload can't publish. OOTD and food-styling posts are refused.

skills.name: claude-ai-music-skills

skills.tagline_zh: 人机协作的 Suno 音乐生产流：风格模板、歌词工作流、混音清单，把「玩 Suno」升级成「做音乐」。

skills.why_en: Plenty of Suno players, few finished tracks — this pack covers exactly that gap.
