skills.limit_en: It does not make the audio — you generate on Suno and bring the stems back; it covers concept, lyrics, Suno prompts, mastering and release prep. Of its 52 skills, 8 are plugin housekeeping (about/help/setup/test/health-check); 44 are actually usable.
skills.title_en: Turns Suno noodling into finished, mixed tracks
skills.limit_brief_zh: 歌不是它生成的，音频要你去 Suno 出。
skills.limit_brief_en: It does not make the audio; you generate that on Suno.

skills.name: pixel2motion
skills.title_zh: 把 PNG 的 Logo 转成 SVG 再动起来，附动效 QA 证据
skills.tagline_zh: 把位图 Logo（PNG/截图都行）转成干净的极简 SVG，再做成丝滑动画：HTML 演示、GIF、视频全出。
skills.tagline_en: Raster logo in — clean minimal SVG out, then animated: HTML demos, GIFs and video previews, with motion QA evidence.
skills.desc_en: Turn a raster logo (PNG/JPG/WebP/screenshot) into a clean minimal SVG with edge smoothness as the primary hard gate and IoU optimized as high as reasonably possible without a fixed global threshold, then into a choreographed logo animation delivered as standalone JS-rendered HTML, applying Disney's 12 animation principles. Use when asked to animate a logo, build a logo reveal / splash screen / bra
skills.why_zh: 「位图转矢量再动起来」是设计师收费不菲的活，它连动效 QA 证据都一起交付。
skills.why_en: Vectorize-then-animate is a billable designer job; this even ships motion QA receipts.
skills.limit_zh: 交付是 logo.svg、独立 HTML 和 PNG 帧条——正文没有 GIF 或视频导出这一步。要 python3 配 Pillow/numpy、无头 Chrome，动效取证还要 Playwright。拟合有 10 轮上限，超了就挑最好一版交。
skills.limit_en: Deliverables are logo.svg, a standalone HTML showcase and PNG frame strips - no GIF or video export appears in the body. Needs python3 with Pillow/numpy, headless Chrome, and Playwright for frame capture. Fitting caps at 10 iterations.
skills.title_en: Your PNG logo, vectorized, animated, and QA'd

skills.name: i-have-adhd
skills.title_zh: 把注意力当稀缺资源，让 Claude 一次只说一件事
skills.tagline_zh: 给 ADHD 大脑定制的相处模式：短句、一次只说一件事、绝不啰嗦，把注意力当稀缺资源来设计整场对话。
skills.tagline_en: Claude tuned for ADHD brains — short lines, one thing at a time, zero rambling; conversation designed around attention as a scarce resource.
skills.desc_en: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".
skills.why_zh: 少见的认真对待神经多样性的 skill，交互约束写得很体贴；非 ADHD 用户拿来治 AI 话痨也好用。
skills.why_en: A rare skill that takes neurodivergence seriously — and its anti-rambling rules help everyone.
skills.limit_zh: frontmatter 写了 disable-model-invocation：它不会自己触发，要你敲 /i-have-adhd 才开、说 stop adhd mode 才关。它只改输出形状，在 agent 里系统提示词还压它一头。
skills.limit_en: Marked disable-model-invocation: it never self-triggers. You type /i-have-adhd and it runs until you say "stop adhd mode", per session. It only reshapes output, and it says the harness system prompt outranks it inside an agent.
skills.title_en: Claude that treats your attention as scarce

skills.name: hue
skills.title_zh: 学一次你的品牌，之后 agent 做的每个界面都照着来
skills.tagline_zh: 学习任何品牌并输出完整设计系统：装一次，之后 agent 做的每个界面都长在你的品牌基因上。
skills.tagline_en: Learns any brand and emits a full design system — install once, and every UI your agent builds matches your identity.
skills.desc_en: Meta-skill that generates new design language skills. Works on Claude Code and Codex. Use when the user says 'create a design skill', 'generate design language', 'new design system skill', 'design skill inspired by X', 'design skill from this screenshot', '/hue', or 'use hue'. Also triggers for 'remix my design skill' or 'make my skill more X'.
skills.why_zh: 「品牌一致性」从人肉盯改变成系统保证，小团队也能有大厂级的视觉纪律。
skills.why_en: Brand consistency goes from manual policing to systemic guarantee — big-co discipline for small teams.
skills.limit_zh: 它产的是一件新 skill，不是界面；而且生成的 description 硬写 NEVER trigger automatically，之后每次都得点名叫它。没接 Chrome DevTools MCP 就降级取色并自报低可信。
skills.limit_en: It outputs a new skill, not a UI - and the generated description must contain "NEVER trigger automatically", so you invoke it by name every time. Without Chrome DevTools MCP it falls back to WebFetch and flags reduced confidence.
skills.title_en: Install your brand once, every screen obeys

skills.name: draw-your-font
skills.title_zh: 拍一张手写字母，本地生成能装进系统的 TTF 字体
skills.tagline_zh: 拍一张你的手写字母，产出真正可安装的字体（TTF/WOFF）：免费、开源、本地跑，不上传任何东西。
skills.tagline_en: Photograph your handwriting, get a real installable font (TTF/WOFF) — free, open source, fully local, nothing uploaded.
skills.desc_en: Turn a photo of handwriting into a real installable font (TTF/WOFF/WOFF2). Use when the user shares a photo of handwritten letters and wants a font, asks to "make my font", "handwriting font", "turn my handwriting into a font", "font from this photo/image", asks for a handwriting font template, or wants to refine a font made earlier (smoother, thicker, fix a letter). Not for choosing, recommending
skills.why_zh: 「拥有自己笔迹的字体」是很多人想过没做过的浪漫，本地处理这点尤其体面。
skills.why_en: A font of your own hand is a romance most people never act on; the local-only processing is the classy touch.
skills.limit_zh: 只做拉丁字母：字符集就 minimal 和 spanish 两套，汉字做不了。要 Node ≥18 先跑 scripts/resolve-cli.js，CLI 只认文件路径，聊天里粘的图它看得见却用不了。
skills.limit_en: Latin only: the charsets are minimal and spanish (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, punctuation, accents) - no CJK. Needs Node >= 18 and scripts/resolve-cli.js first, and the CLI takes file paths only, so an image pasted into chat cannot be processed.
skills.title_en: Photograph your handwriting, install it as a font

skills.name: humanities-writing-companion
skills.title_zh: 用苏格拉底式追问磨论证，最后替你写 AI 使用声明
skills.tagline_zh: 人文学者的思考伙伴：从苏格拉底式追问研究问题到 AI 使用声明，11 种模式陪你把论证磨锋利。
skills.tagline_en: A thinking partner for humanities scholars — 11 modes from Socratic question-sharpening to AI-use disclosure statements.
skills.desc_en: Thinking partner for humanities scholars — history, philosophy, literature, art history, religious studies, classics, and adjacent fields where prose IS the argument. Covers the full arc of a paper: research-question sharpening, literature mapping, plan-only outlining, conception and drafting, four-layer chapter critique, calibratable devil's-advocate review, bottleneck unsticking, revision with v
skills.why_zh: 少见的认真服务文科的 skill：它磨的是论证而不是格式，还懂学术伦理的新规矩。
skills.why_en: A rare skill that takes the humanities seriously — sharpening arguments, not formatting, and fluent in new AI-ethics norms.
skills.limit_zh: 它不替你找文献、也不当文献管理器，只查你稿子里已有的引注，验真伪要连 Crossref。那几个脚本得有 shell 才能跑，纯聊天环境只能把学科档案口头记着。学科锁在文史哲、语言、艺术、宗教。
skills.limit_en: It runs no literature search and is no reference manager — it only audits citations already in your draft, and verification calls the Crossref API. Its scripts need a shell; chat-only sessions keep profiles verbal. Humanities fields only.
skills.title_en: Sharpens your argument, then writes the AI disclosure

skills.name: archify
skills.title_zh: 画出来的架构图要和代码对得上，导出自带动效的 HTML
skills.tagline_zh: 产出可验证的架构、时序、数据流、生命周期图：自包含 HTML 自带动效，导出清晰锐利可直接交付。
skills.tagline_en: Validated architecture, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams — self-contained HTML with motion, crisp exports.
skills.desc_en: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. U
skills.why_zh: 「可验证」是关键词：图和描述对得上号，不是好看但骗人的装饰画。
skills.why_en: "Verifiable" is the keyword — diagrams that match reality, not pretty fiction.
skills.limit_zh: 靠 node bin/archify.mjs 出图；收尾的 visual-check 要本机有 Chrome，没有就退出码 2 给张 skipped 收据。只做架构、流程、时序、数据流、生命周期五类，主节点建议不超过 12 个。
skills.limit_en: Everything runs through node bin/archify.mjs, and the closing visual-check needs local Chrome — without it you get exit code 2 and a skipped receipt. Five diagram types only, ~12 primary nodes max, and the layout targets desktop widths.
skills.title_en: Architecture diagrams that get checked against the code

skills.name: understand-chat
skills.title_zh: 按调用结构而不是搜字符串，回答改这里会牵动谁
skills.tagline_zh: 对着代码库的知识图谱直接提问：这段逻辑在哪、谁调用谁、改这里会牵动什么——按结构找答案，不是搜字符串。
skills.tagline_en: Ask the codebase graph directly — where's this logic, who calls whom, what breaks if I touch this; answers by structure, not grep.
skills.desc_en: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph
skills.why_zh: 比全文搜索聪明一档——它按结构找答案，不是按字符串。
skills.why_en: A tier above grep: answers by structure, not string match.
skills.limit_zh: 它只读 .ua/knowledge-graph.json，那张图得先跑 /understand 生成，没有就只能劝你去跑。图按 git commit 记时，代码一改它只能警告你答案可能是旧的。
skills.limit_en: It only reads .ua/knowledge-graph.json, which the sibling /understand skill must build first - without it, all it can do is tell you to run that. The graph is stamped with a git commit, so after code edits it only warns of staleness.
skills.title_en: Ask what breaks if you touch this function

skills.name: academic-paper-reviewer
skills.title_zh: 投稿前先把你的论文当正式来稿逐节挑刺一遍
skills.tagline_zh: 把你的论文当正式投稿来审：方法、论证、引用逐节挑刺，投出去之前先在家被虐一遍，比收到真审稿意见体面。
skills.tagline_en: Reviews your paper like a submission: methods, argument, citations, section by section.
skills.desc_en: Multi-perspective academic paper review with dynamic reviewer personas. Simulates 5 independent reviewers (Journal-Fit Reviewer + 3 peer reviewers + Devil's Advocate) with field-specific expertise. Supports full review, re-review (verification), quick assessment, methodology focus, Socratic guided, and calibration modes. Triggers on: review paper, peer review, manuscript review, referee report, re
skills.why_zh: 投稿前先被它虐一遍，比收到真审稿意见时才发现问题体面得多。
skills.why_en: Get savaged here first — cheaper than discovering it in the real reviews.
skills.limit_zh: 五个审稿位同出一个模型，正文自己写明「角色分离不等于独立的出错过程」；现行评审一律标 NOT_CALIBRATED。它是 ARS 全家桶一环，要仓库根的 .claude/CLAUDE.md 和 shared/。
skills.limit_en: The five seats come from one model, and the text states outright that role separation is not independence. Live reviews all declare NOT_CALIBRATED. It is one piece of the ARS suite, needing the repo-root .claude/CLAUDE.md and shared/.
skills.title_en: Get savaged before the real reviewers do

skills.name: humanizer
skills.title_zh: 照一份句式级的臭味清单删掉「值得注意的是」
skills.tagline_zh: 一键去 AI 味：删掉「值得注意的是」、排比腔和空洞总结——那份「AI 写作臭味清单」具体到了句式级别。
skills.tagline_en: Strip the AI-isms — "it's worth noting", triple parallelism and hollow wrap-ups gone; the smell-list is specific down to sentence patterns.
skills.desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive voice, negative
skills.why_zh: 它列的「AI 写作臭味清单」具体到句式级别，反过来读就是一堂写作课。
skills.why_en: Its catalog of AI writing smells is specific down to the sentence pattern — read it backwards and it's a writing course.
skills.limit_zh: 35 条特征和全部例句都来自英文维基的 Signs of AI writing，破折号、弯引号、标题大小写那几条挪到中文基本落空。文件模式会直接把原文件改写成最终稿。
skills.limit_en: All 35 patterns and every example come from English Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing"; the em-dash, curly-quote and title-case rules do not carry over to Chinese. In file mode it rewrites your file in place, leaving only the final version.
skills.title_en: Deletes every "it's worth noting" you wrote

skills.name: citation-management
skills.title_zh: 每条引用都回数据库核验，揪出 AI 编造的参考文献
skills.tagline_zh: 检索 OpenAlex、PubMed、Google Scholar，抽取准确元数据、校验引用、格式化文献——引用错误终结者。
skills.tagline_en: Searches OpenAlex, PubMed and Scholar, extracts clean metadata, validates and formats citations — the reference-error killer.
skills.desc_en: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.
skills.why_zh: AI 编造引用是学术圈最怕的事，它反其道而行：每条引用都可验证、有出处。
skills.why_en: Fabricated citations are academia's nightmare; this does the opposite — every reference verifiable.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Python 3.9+ 和 requests，还要连得上 openalex、crossref、pubmed。Google Scholar 没有 API，靠 scholarly 爬，每条歇 2 到 5 秒还常被封，作者自己说只能当补充。
skills.limit_en: Needs Python 3.9+ with requests plus network access to openalex, crossref and pubmed. Google Scholar has no API: scholarly scrapes it, sleeps 2-5s per result and is blocked often, so the skill itself calls it a supplement.
skills.title_en: Kills the fabricated citation before your reviewer finds it

skills.name: planning-with-files
skills.title_zh: 把计划写成磁盘文件，/clear 和上下文压缩都不丢进度
skills.tagline_zh: 把计划写成 Markdown 文件常驻磁盘：崩溃、/clear、上下文压缩都不丢进度，随时从断点接着施工。
skills.tagline_en: Plans live as Markdown on disk — surviving crashes, /clear and compaction; work resumes from the exact checkpoint every time.
skills.desc_en: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.
skills.why_zh: 长任务的命根子是「状态不丢」，它用最朴素的文件方案解决，比花哨的记忆系统皮实。
skills.why_en: Long tasks live or die on durable state; plain files beat fancy memory systems for robustness.
skills.limit_zh: 装法决定功能：npx skills add 装的没有 /plan-goal 和 /plan-loop。「没做完不许停」的门也只在 Claude Code、Codex CLI 真拦得住，OpenCode、Gemini CLI 只弹提示。
skills.limit_en: The install route decides what you get: `npx skills add` ships no /plan-goal or /plan-loop; only the plugin route does. The completion gate hard-blocks on Claude Code, Codex CLI and Continue.dev; OpenCode and Gemini CLI just get a notice.
skills.title_en: Plans that survive a crash, a clear, a compaction

skills.name: book-to-skill
skills.title_zh: 把一本书拆成框架和原则，装进 agent 而不是你的脑子
skills.tagline_zh: 把一本书（PDF/EPUB/DOCX 都行）拆成框架、模型、原则，装进 agent 当技能。
skills.tagline_en: Turns a book (PDF/EPUB/DOCX…) into frameworks and principles your agent can use.
skills.desc_en: Converts books and documents (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, plain text, RTF, MOBI/AZW with Calibre) into structured agent skills, extracting frameworks, mental models, principles, techniques, and anti-patterns. Use when the user wants to study a document through GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code, apply an author's frameworks while working, or build a reusable knowledge base from a file.
skills.why_zh: 「书读完就忘」的解法：知识不进脑子没关系，进 agent 也行——这个立意本身就值一颗星。
skills.why_en: If the book won't stay in your head, put it in your agent — the premise alone earns a star.
skills.limit_zh: MOBI/AZW 要先装 Calibre，技术书走 Docling 每页约 1.5 秒，EPUB 里的插图直接丢掉。两百页的书约 7.5 万 token，钱按你自己的模型价算。第三方版权书生成的技能只准建私有仓库。
skills.limit_en: Runs scripts/extract.py under Python; MOBI/AZW need Calibre, technical mode uses Docling at ~1.5s a page, EPUB images are dropped. A 200-page book is ~75k tokens at your own model's rates. Copyrighted sources: private repo only.
skills.title_en: Put the book in your agent's head instead

skills.name: notebooklm
skills.title_zh: 用脚本驱动 NotebookLM，连网页版没有的功能也能调
skills.tagline_zh: NotebookLM 的完整编程接口：建笔记本、喂资料、生成播客，连网页版没有的功能都有。
skills.tagline_en: Full programmatic NotebookLM: notebooks, sources, every artifact — even features the web UI lacks.
skills.desc_en: Complete API for Google NotebookLM - full programmatic access including features not in the web UI. Create notebooks, add sources, generate all artifact types, download in multiple formats. Activates on explicit /notebooklm or intent like "create a podcast about X"
skills.why_zh: 「比官方 UI 能做的还多」是它最狠的卖点，批量喂资料、自动出播客这类活从此可脚本化。
skills.why_en: "More than the web UI" is the killer line — bulk sources and podcast generation become scriptable.
skills.limit_zh: 得先在有显示器的机器上跑 notebooklm login，无头或沙箱环境只能把 storage_state.json 搬过去用。播客、视频、测验、幻灯这几类生成常被 Google 限流失败；电影级视频还要 AI Ultra 订阅。
skills.limit_en: Auth needs `notebooklm login` in a real browser; headless sandboxes must carry a host-made storage_state.json. Audio, video, quiz and slide generation routinely fail on Google rate limits, and cinematic video needs a Google AI Ultra plan.
skills.title_en: NotebookLM scripted, including what the web UI can't

skills.name: Skill_Seekers
skills.title_zh: 把文档站和仓库转成技能，顺手标出互相打架的说法
skills.tagline_zh: 把文档站、GitHub 仓库、PDF 自动转成 Claude 技能，自带冲突检测——团队知识库落进 agent 的最短路径。
skills.tagline_en: Converts doc sites, GitHub repos and PDFs into Claude skills, conflict detection included — the shortest path from team docs to agent.
skills.desc_en: Convert documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDFs into Claude AI skills with automatic conflict detection
skills.why_zh: 团队知识库落进 agent 的最短路径；冲突检测这个细节说明作者真在生产里用。
skills.why_en: The shortest path from team docs to agent skills; conflict detection says the author actually uses it.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

skills.limit_zh: 26 份 SKILL.md 有 24 份是 tests/golden/phase2 的测试夹具，真能装的只有 skill-seekers 和 skill-builder 两件。本体是 PyPI 上的 Python 包（3.10+），跑命令行，不是复制个目录就能用的 skill。
skills.limit_en: 24 of the repo's 26 SKILL.md files are test fixtures under tests/golden/phase2 — only skill-seekers and skill-builder are real. The product itself is a PyPI Python package (3.10+) driven from the command line, not a directory you copy in.
skills.title_en: Turns your docs into skills, conflicts flagged

skills.name: obsidian-second-brain
skills.title_zh: 让新资料改写旧笔记，而不是在 Obsidian 里越堆越多
skills.tagline_zh: 把 Obsidian 库运营成会自我改写的第二大脑：新资料改写旧页面而不是堆新笔记，越用越干净。
skills.tagline_en: Runs your Obsidian vault as a self-rewriting second brain — new sources revise existing pages instead of piling notes.
skills.desc_en: Operate any Obsidian vault as a living, self-rewriting second brain (an evolution of Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: sources rewrite existing pages, contradictions reconcile automatically, scheduled agents maintain the vault while you sleep). Use this skill whenever the user asks Claude to read, write, update, search, or manage their Obsidian vault - including saving notes from conversation, creating
skills.why_zh: 「改写而非堆积」师承 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 思路，直击笔记软件越用越乱的死穴。
skills.why_en: Rewrite-don't-accumulate, à la Karpathy's LLM Wiki — aimed at the exact reason vaults rot.
skills.limit_zh: 脚本层要 Python 3.10+ 和 uv，/x-read、/x-pulse 必须自备 xAI Grok key。正文自认在 1000+ 笔记库首跑 recall@10 是 0%——raw/ 与 log.md 会压垮词频排序。
skills.limit_en: The script layer needs Python 3.10+ with uv, and /x-read and /x-pulse require your own xAI Grok key. The text reports a first retrieval run on a 1,000+ note vault scoring 0% recall@10 - long raw/ transcripts and log.md dominate ranking.
skills.title_en: Notes that rewrite themselves instead of piling up

skills.name: pinme
skills.title_zh: 一条命令把前端发上 IPFS，不买服务器不注册账号
skills.tagline_zh: 一条命令把前端发上 IPFS：不买服务器、不配域名、不注册托管账号，构建完直接把链接甩给人看。
skills.tagline_en: One command deploys your frontend to IPFS — no server, no domain, no hosting signup; build it and hand out the link.
skills.desc_en: Use this skill when the user mentions "pinme", or needs to upload files, store to IPFS, create/publish/deploy websites or full-stack services (including frontend pages, backend APIs, database storage, email sending, etc.), or any feature requiring backend database/server support.
skills.why_zh: 「写完就想给人看」的最短路径；发去中心化网络这点还免了托管账号那套麻烦。
skills.why_en: The shortest path from built to shareable — and decentralized hosting skips the account dance.
skills.limit_zh: 不是免账号：upload 之前必须 pinme login 或 set-appkey，绑子域名还要钱包余额。全栈那条路锁死 React+Vite + Cloudflare Worker + D1 模板，Worker 没有持久磁盘。
skills.limit_en: Not account-free: `pinme login` or `set-appkey` comes before any upload, and a subdomain needs wallet balance. The full-stack path is locked to its React+Vite + Cloudflare Worker + D1 template, whose Worker has no persistent disk.
skills.title_en: Ship a site to IPFS without an account

skills.name: md2wechat
skills.title_zh: 把 Markdown 排成公众号版式，内联样式不再莫名崩掉
skills.tagline_zh: Markdown 一键排成微信公众号格式：内联样式全自动处理，代码块、图片、引用的样式从此不再莫名崩掉。
skills.tagline_en: Markdown to WeChat official-account layout in one shot — inline styles fully automated; code blocks, images and quotes stop breaking.
skills.desc_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.
skills.why_zh: 被公众号编辑器折磨过的人都懂：它把内联样式这种脏活全自动化了，中文创作者刚需。
skills.why_en: Automates the inline-style misery of WeChat's editor — a must for Chinese creators.
skills.limit_zh: 它只是驱动 md2wechat 这个 npm CLI，得先装。API 模式要 MD2WECHAT_API_KEY，建草稿另要公众号凭证和封面；AI 模式不解析 :::module，高级排版卡片那条路不渲染。
skills.limit_en: It only drives the md2wechat npm CLI, installed separately. API mode needs MD2WECHAT_API_KEY; drafts need WeChat credentials plus a cover. AI mode never parses :::module, so advanced layout cards don't render there.
skills.title_en: Markdown into WeChat layout, inline styles and all

skills.name: agent-skill-creator
skills.title_zh: 把工作流只写一次，装进 Claude、Cursor 等 17 个平台
skills.tagline_zh: 把任何工作流写成一次、装到 17 个平台：Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini 全兼容的 skill 铸造机。
skills.tagline_en: Write a workflow once, install it on 17 platforms — a skill foundry compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more.
skills.desc_en: Create cross-platform agent skills from workflow descriptions. Activates when users ask to create an agent, automate a repetitive workflow, create a custom skill, or need advanced agent creation. Triggers on phrases like create agent for, automate workflow, create skill for, every day I have to, daily I need to, turn process into agent, need to automate, create a cross-platform skill, validate thi
skills.why_zh: 跨平台是 skill 生态的下一站，这件把「一处编写到处运行」提前做出来了。
skills.why_en: Cross-platform is the ecosystem's next stop; this ships write-once-run-anywhere early.
skills.limit_zh: 17 个平台里只有 12 个原样能装，Cursor、Windsurf 等 4 个要转格式，Zed、Aider 等 4 个得你手抄进配置。校验和安全扫描都是 python3 脚本，过了它会直接装进你的配置目录。
skills.limit_en: Of 17 platforms only 12 install SKILL.md as-is; 4 (Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Junie) are auto-rewritten and 4 (Zed, Augment, Aider, Continue) need manual copying. Validation and security scan are python3 scripts; it auto-installs on pass.
skills.title_en: Write the skill once, install on 17 platforms

skills.name: nihaisha
skills.title_zh: 检索倪海厦课上讲的方证与穴位，每条都回到板书截图
skills.tagline_zh: 倪海厦中医课程的随身助教：检索课程内容、辨析方证与穴位、整理学习笔记，还带板书截图做证据索引。
skills.tagline_en: A study companion for Ni Haisha's TCM courses: search lectures, look up formulas and acupoints, organize notes.
skills.desc_en: Use this skill when the user asks about Ni Haisha / 倪海厦 TCM course material, especially Shang Han Lun / 伤寒论, Jingui / 金匮要略, Zhongjing Xinfa / 仲景心法, clinical cases / 临床案例 / 倪师医案, Bagang Bianzheng / 八纲辨证, Fuyang Forum / 扶阳论坛, Yijinjing / 易筋经, Liang Dong dialogue / 梁冬对话倪师, Stanford lecture / 斯坦福大学演讲, Tianji / 天纪 / 易经 / 阳宅 / 紫微斗数, Huangdi Neijing / 黄帝内经, Shennong Bencao / 神农本草, acupuncture / 针灸, merid
skills.why_zh: 垂直领域 skill 的好样本：把一套课程资料做成可检索、有截图证据的学习系统，思路可以照搬到任何课上。
skills.why_en: A model vertical skill — one course corpus turned into a searchable, evidence-linked study system. Steal the pattern for any course.
skills.limit_zh: RAG 加知识图谱那套已经下架，你明说要它也不给，只能走轻量 Markdown 模块。八纲辨证、梁冬对话、斯坦福演讲三块没有板书截图。剂量、煎服法、进针深度一律不落到可执行。
skills.limit_en: The RAG + knowledge-graph mode is withdrawn and refuses even when you insist, leaving only the lightweight Markdown modules. Bagang, the Liang Dong dialogue and the Stanford talk carry no board screenshots. No dosages or needle depths.
skills.title_en: Search Ni Haisha's lectures by formula and acupoint

skills.name: gpt-image2-ppt
skills.title_zh: 让 gpt-image-2 照着别人的 pptx 仿版式，你只换内容
skills.tagline_zh: 把任何 .pptx 模板「抄」成你的 PPT：gpt-image-2 模仿版式、你换内容，另附 10 套现成风格。
skills.tagline_en: Clone any .pptx template into your own deck — gpt-image-2 mimics the layout, you swap the content; 10 styles bundled.
skills.desc_en: Generate visually striking PPT slides via OpenAI's gpt-image-2 -- use any style in styles/<collection>/STYLE_ID.md or mimic a user-supplied .pptx template; outputs high-res slide PNGs and a 16:9 .pptx. Use when the user asks to make a presentation, slides, deck, pitch deck, investor PPT, magazine-style PPT, or 做一份 PPT / 生成幻灯片 / 用 gpt-image 生成 PPT / 按这个模板生成 PPT.
skills.why_zh: 「就要做成那套模板的样子」是真实高频需求，仿版式这个切入点极其聪明。
skills.why_en: "Make it look like that deck" is a real, frequent ask — layout mimicry is the clever cut-in.
skills.limit_zh: gpt-image-2 按张计费，不含在 ChatGPT 订阅里。仿模板要本机跑得起 LibreOffice/Keynote/PowerPoint 渲染，否则得自己把每页导成 PNG。默认成品整页是图，文字改不了。
skills.limit_en: gpt-image-2 bills per image and a ChatGPT subscription does not cover it. Template cloning needs a working local LibreOffice/Keynote/PowerPoint renderer, or you export each page to PNG yourself. Default decks are full-page images.
skills.title_en: Steal that deck's layout, keep your content

skills.name: bazi-ziwei
skills.title_zh: 排盘交给算法库算，不让模型瞎编的八字与紫微斗数
skills.tagline_zh: 八字 + 紫微斗数精准排盘：算法库计算杜绝 AI 瞎排，三种分析模式，还能出水墨风 HTML 命盘海报。
skills.tagline_en: Bazi and Zi Wei charts computed by real algorithms (no LLM guessing), three analysis modes, plus ink-wash HTML chart posters.
skills.desc_en: 八字 + 紫微斗数 AI 排盘与综合分析。当用户提供生辰（阳历/农历日期、时辰、性别）询问八字、紫微、命理、命盘、流年大运相关问题时使用。基于 Yiqi 算法库 + enrichBazi 补全层精准排盘（杜绝 LLM 自行排盘出错），支持按需独立分析八字 / 独立分析紫微 / 两盘交叉印证。
skills.why_zh: 命理内容的死穴是排盘出错，它用算法库把这步锁死了——玩得认真，才好玩。
skills.why_en: Fortune content dies on wrong charts; algorithmic casting locks that down. Taking the fun seriously is the fun.
skills.limit_zh: 排盘走 node dist/run-chart.js，先得在 calculator/ 装依赖，日期只吃 1900–2100。不问出生地、直接用钟表时间，不做真太阳时校正。HTML 海报只对综合印证开放。
skills.limit_en: Charting runs node dist/run-chart.js, so calculator/ needs its deps installed, and dates outside 1900-2100 error. It never asks for birthplace and uses clock time with no true-solar-time correction. The HTML poster is combined-mode only.
skills.title_en: Bazi charts cast by algorithm, not by vibes

skills.name: social-post
skills.title_zh: 学你的语气排好 14 天日历，再替你按下发布键
skills.tagline_zh: 学你的 Facebook 语气，按 14 天内容日历自动写并发到 FB/IG/Threads/X——实测单帖 8 万触达。
skills.tagline_en: Learns your Facebook voice, then writes and posts to FB, IG, Threads and X on a 14-day calendar — 80K-reach validated.
skills.desc_en: 學使用者的 Facebook 個人貼文語氣，依 14 天內容策略日曆，自動產出並發佈到 FB / Instagram / Threads / X。使用時機：使用者說「發文」、「幫我寫一篇貼文」、「用我的風格發」、「今天發一篇」、「PO 一下」、「學我的語氣」、「分析我的貼文風格」、「重新規劃內容」、「排貼文」、「查流量」、「review」時一律觸發；即使只說「發一篇」、「PO 文」、「PO 個廢文」也要觸發。
skills.why_zh: 「学语气 + 排日历 + 真发布」三步闭环，是个人 IP 运营少见的全自动解。
skills.why_en: Voice-learning, calendaring and actual posting in one loop — rare full automation for personal brands.
skills.limit_zh: 正文是繁体。真发帖要 chrome:control-chrome 和已登录的浏览器，每篇都得你当场确认，没有 IG 图片素材它就停。成效全落本地 data/*.jsonl，换台机器归零。
skills.limit_en: Traditional Chinese. Publishing needs `chrome:control-chrome` and an already-signed-in browser, with in-session confirmation per post; no IG image and it stops. Performance data lives in local data/*.jsonl, so a new machine starts empty.
skills.title_en: Learns your voice, then actually hits post

skills.name: compose-expert
skills.title_zh: 回答 Compose 问题时，每条建议都附上 androidx 源码出处
skills.tagline_zh: Jetpack Compose 全平台专家：给的每条建议都附 androidx 源码出处，Android/桌面/iOS/Web 都在行。
skills.tagline_en: A Compose Multiplatform expert whose every recommendation ships with androidx source receipts — Android, desktop, iOS, web.
skills.desc_en: Compose and Compose Multiplatform expert for UI development across Android, Desktop, iOS, and Web. Use whenever the user mentions Compose APIs (@Composable, remember, LaunchedEffect, NavHost, MaterialTheme, LazyColumn, Modifier, recomposition), Compose Multiplatform (commonMain, expect/actual, Res.*, ComposeUIViewController, UIKitView, ComposeViewport), Android TV (tv-material, D-pad, focus, Carou
skills.why_zh: 「带源码回执」是这件的灵魂：不是凭训练记忆答题，是翻着官方源码给你讲。
skills.why_en: Source receipts are the soul here — answers cited from androidx itself, not training-data vibes.
skills.limit_zh: 作者已改成插件分发，手动拷进 ~/.claude/skills/ 属于不再维护的装法、收不到更新，v3.0 还会加码警告。源码回执是 androidx-main / jb-main 打包那一刻的快照，上游一动就旧。
skills.limit_en: It now ships as a plugin — a manual copy into ~/.claude/skills/ is the unmaintained path and gets no updates, with the banner escalating in v3.0. The bundled androidx-main / jb-main source receipts are a snapshot frozen at packaging time.
skills.title_en: Every Compose answer comes with androidx receipts

skills.name: vibe-check
skills.title_zh: 带纯新手把模糊点子变成计划，顺手教会他用 GitHub
skills.tagline_zh: 由 12 年产品老兵带路：把纯新手的模糊点子变成能开工的计划，边建边教 GitHub 和干净代码习惯。
skills.tagline_en: A 12-year PM walks a total beginner from vague idea to buildable plan, teaching GitHub basics and clean habits along the way.
skills.desc_en: Turn a complete beginner's app idea into a buildable plan, then keep them oriented while they build. Use it whenever someone who has never coded wants to build or "vibe code" an app, has an idea but no idea where to start, or wants it turned into a plan, MVP scope, tech stack, user flows, or blueprint. It has three on-ramps: the full journey, a validate-only pass ("is my idea worth building", "rea
skills.why_zh: vibe coding 时代最缺的是「有人扶一把」，这件就是那只手，姿势还很专业。
skills.why_en: The vibe-coding era's missing ingredient is a steady hand; this is that hand, professionally trained.
skills.limit_zh: 调研这步靠抓 Reddit 和 G2 评论，抓不动就退成把网址和搜索词交给你自己去粘。作图引擎要浏览器和临时文件，跑不起来退回 mermaid。正文全英文，且明说不管有经验开发者的调试、重构和 CI/CD。
skills.limit_en: Discovery depends on fetching Reddit and review sites; when the environment blocks that, it hands you the sites and search phrases to paste yourself. The diagram engine needs a browser and temp files or falls back to mermaid. English only.
skills.title_en: A veteran PM walks your first build

skills.name: manim-skill
skills.title_zh: 用 Manim 做 3Blue1Brown 那种数学动画，从分镜到渲染
skills.tagline_zh: 用 Manim 做 3Blue1Brown 风格的数学动画：agent 自己规划分镜、写代码、渲染、按反馈修，出片有辨识度。
skills.tagline_en: 3Blue1Brown-style math animations via Manim — the agent plans scenes, writes code, renders and refines on feedback.
skills.desc_en: Create mathematical animations with Manim Community Edition(manimce). Generates distinctive, production-grade animations that avoid generic "AI slop" aesthetics. Use when user wants to animate concepts, equations, illustrate proofs, visualize algorithms, create math explainers, or produce 3Blue1Brown-style videos.
skills.why_zh: 数学可视化是教学内容的王牌，它把 Manim 陡峭的学习曲线整个铲平了。
skills.why_en: Math visualization is teaching's trump card; this bulldozes Manim's learning curve flat.
skills.limit_zh: 本机要装 Manim CE 和 ffmpeg，分镜逐个渲染再 concat 拼。默认只出 480p15，1080p 得点名。写码前强制先调 manimce-best-practices。旁白只写进 plan.md，不生成配音。
skills.limit_en: Manim CE and ffmpeg must be installed locally; scenes render one by one and are stitched with ffmpeg concat. Default output is 480p15, 1080p only on request. Phase 2 requires a separate manimce-best-practices skill. No audio.
skills.title_en: 3Blue1Brown-grade math animations without learning Manim
